title.zh: MCP Server 说“我有这个工具”，Host 为什么不能直接信？
title.en: Why Can’t a Host Trust Every Tool an MCP Server Advertises?

text: mcp server 说“我有这个工具”，host 为什么不能直接信？ why can’t a host trust every tool an mcp server advertises? tools 与 extensibility 内核 tools and extensibility internals mcp tool discovery capability negotiation trust boundary tool catalog 今日命题 today's proposition 动态 discovery 解决的是“运行时有哪些能力”，却同时引入新的供应链和控制面。mcp server 返回的 tool name、description 和 inputschema 是远端声明：它可以过时、恶意、相互冲突，或描述一个当前用户根本无权执行的 effect。host 若把 tools/list 原样塞给模型，就把 server 的自我描述误当成授权决定，还会让 catalog refresh 在对话中途改变模型动作语言。 可靠 host 必须维护三套不同集合：server-advertised catalog、host-authorized catalog、model-exposed working set。初始化只协商协议版本与通用 capabilities；每个 tool 仍需 provenance、namespace、schema validation、policy classification、credential binding 和用户 consent。动态变更生成新 catalog snapshot，不能静默改写已经规划或正在执行的 call。 核心判断： mcp 标准化 discovery 和调用，不替 host 决定信任、授权或最小暴露。server 声明“我能做 x”只是 capability claim；host 证明“这个 principal 在这个任务此刻可使用 x”后，才形成可交给模型的 action。 dynamic discovery answers “what capabilities exist at runtime,” but it also creates a new supply chain and control plane. tool names, descriptions, and input schemas returned by an mcp server are remote claims. they may be stale, malicious, conflicting, or describe an effect the current user cannot perform. if a host copies tools/list directly into model context, it mistakes server self-description for authorization and lets catalog refresh change the model's action language in the middle of a conversation. a reliable host maintains three distinct sets: the server-advertised catalog, the host-authorized catalog, and the model-exposed working set. initialization negotiates protocol version and broad capabilities only. every tool still needs provenance, namespace, schema validation, policy classification, credential binding, and user consent. dynamic changes create a new catalog snapshot rather than silently rewriting calls that are planned or in flight. core judgment: mcp standardizes discovery and invocation; it does not make trust, authorization, or least exposure decisions for the host. “i can do x” is a server capability claim. only after the host proves that this principal may use x for this task now does it become a model action. 承接 tool contract：动态来源不会降低 contract 标准 dynamic origin does not weaken the tool contract 1/4 已建立 schema、semantic/policy validation、runtime context 注入和 typed results。mcp 只改变 contract 从哪里获得、如何协商和刷新，不改变这些安全要求。远端 inputschema 仍只能约束语法；tenant、principal、approval、deadline 与 idempotency 仍由 host 注入；effect owner 仍需重新授权。 更关键的是，mcp 的 protocol identity、server process identity、oauth resource identity 和业务 data identity 不是一回事。连接到 finance-server 不等于当前 tool 自动继承全部财务权限；server 获得 access token 也不等于模型有权选择 token 覆盖的所有操作。host 要把连接 credential 的 audience/scope 与每个 tool 的风险和当前 task purpose 对齐。 因此 discovery pipeline 与 compiler 类似：untrusted metadata 是 source language，host policy 进行 type checking/capability reduction，model-facing catalog 是编译产物。只有编译产物进入 context，原始 server 描述保留用于审计，不获得 instruction authority。 part 1 established schema, semantic and policy validation, runtime-context injection, and typed results. mcp changes where a contract comes from and how it is negotiated and refreshed; it does not weaken these requirements. a remote input schema still constrains syntax only. tenant, principal, approval, deadline, and idempotency remain host-injected, and the effect owner still reauthorizes. more importantly, mcp protocol identity, server-process identity, oauth resource identity, and business-data identity are distinct. connecting to a finance server does not grant every financial operation. a server possessing an access token does not mean the model may select every operation covered by that token. the host aligns token audience and scope with each tool's risk and the current task purpose. the discovery pipeline resembles a compiler. untrusted metadata is source language, host policy performs type checking and capability reduction, and the model-facing catalog is the compiled artifact. only that artifact enters model context. original server descriptions remain available for audit but gain no instruction authority. 机制：从 initialize 到稳定的 model-facing catalog mechanism: from initialize to a stable model-facing catalog mcp discovery 的三阶段 catalog 多个 server 通过 initialize 和 tools/list 声明能力。host 验证协议与 schema，命名空间化并做授权风险过滤，生成版本化 catalog snapshot。task selector 只把小型 working set 暴露给模型。listchanged 生成新 snapshot，不改变进行中调用。 mcp servers initialize · tools/list advertised catalog untrusted descriptions host policy compiler validate · namespace · acl catalog snapshot vn authorized · versioned task selector relevance · risk · budget model working set small · stable per turn listchanged → vn+1 原创示意：server metadata 先进入 untrusted catalog，经 host policy 编译后形成 snapshot；模型每轮只见与任务相关的稳定子集。 1. initialize 建立 protocol session client 发送支持的 protocolversion、clientinfo 与 capabilities；server 回应选定版本、serverinfo 与 capabilities。双方完成 initialized 后才进入正常操作。version negotiation 失败应终止连接，不应“尽量解析”；server capabilities 表示 protocol feature support，不表示每项业务 tool 已授权。 2. 绑定连接 provenance host 给连接分配 serverinstanceid、transport、binary/package digest、launch config、remote origin、credential binding 和 trust tier。相同 display name 的两个 server 不是同一 principal；重连后 instance 可变，但稳定 server identity 与配置版本必须可审计。 3. 拉取 advertised catalog tools/list 可分页，host 读取完整快照，记录 server-provided name/description/inputschema/outputschema/annotations 与获取时间。description 和 schema 是 untrusted data；先做 json/schema size/depth、recursive refs、unknown dialect、duplicate name 与 executable-content 检查。超大 catalog 受 page/tool/token budget 限制。 4. namespace 与 stable identity 模型可见名称至少绑定 server namespace，例如 github.create_issue 与 ado.create_issue ，防止同名覆盖。内部 toolidentity 使用 serverid+toolname+schemadigest+contractversion；display alias 只用于 ui。refresh 后同名 schema 改变产生新 identity/version，旧 call 按旧 snapshot 解码。 5. host capability reduction policy engine 按 principal、tenant、connection trust、oauth scopes、tool risk、task purpose、environment 与 user consent 过滤。server annotations 可作为提示，不能作为授权事实。write/destructive/external-message tools 需要更强 confirmation 或 approval；host 也可重写 description、收窄 enum、移除危险 optional fields，但必须保存原始与有效 schema 的 lineage。 6. catalog snapshot 授权结果写成 immutable snapshot：catalogversion、server sessions、tool identities、effective schemas、policy decision、expiry 与 consent refs。一次 model turn 和由它产生的 plan 固定 snapshot id。执行时再做实时授权，但不会因 catalog refresh 把旧 tool name 指向另一个 effect。 7. working-set selection 几百个 tools 全部放 prompt 会增加 token、selection confusion 和恶意描述曝光。host 先根据 task、conversation state、required resource、risk 和 historical selection quality 召回候选，再保留小型 working set；必要时提供 meta-search capability，让模型请求某类能力，而不是直接看到全 catalog。hard-required tools 与 policy constraints 不由 semantic similarity 排除。 8. listchanged 与 invalidation 支持 listchanged 的 server 可发 tools/list_changed notification。host debounce 后重新分页拉取、验证并生成 vn+1，计算 added/removed/changed。removed tool 对新 turns 不可见；in-flight call 依据 captured identity 决定允许完成、取消或标 contract_unknown。缓存以 server session、catalog digest 和 policy version 为 key，不能只按 url。 9. call routing 模型返回 effective tool alias 与 args；host 用 snapshot 解析 internal identity，再做 schema+semantic+authorization validation，调用对应 server。call result 绑定 server/session/tool/schema digest 与 observedat。若 server 在执行期间断线，runtime 使用上一篇的 outcome_unknown/reconciliation contract，不把 mcp transport error 自动当 effect failure。 10. audit 与撤销 trace 串起 initialize、catalog pages、policy reduction、working-set selection、model choice、validation 与 call result。用户撤销 server/credential/consent 后，新 snapshot 立即移除 capabilities，并取消未 dispatch calls；已 dispatch effect 按业务 contract reconcile。host ui 应显示 capability 来源和风险，而不是只显示友好 tool name。 three catalog stages in mcp discovery servers advertise through initialize and tools/list. the host validates protocol and schema, namespaces and filters by authorization and risk, then creates a versioned catalog snapshot. a task selector exposes only a small working set. listchanged creates a new snapshot without changing in-flight calls. mcp servers initialize · tools/list advertised catalog untrusted descriptions host policy compiler validate · namespace · acl catalog snapshot vn authorized · versioned task selector relevance · risk · budget model working set small · stable per turn listchanged → vn+1 original diagram: server metadata enters an untrusted catalog, host policy compiles a snapshot, and each model turn sees only a stable task-relevant subset. 1. initialize a protocol session the client sends protocol versions, client information, and capabilities; the server responds with the selected version, server information, and capabilities. normal operations begin only after initialization completes. failed version negotiation closes the connection instead of using best-effort parsing. server capabilities indicate protocol feature support, not authorization for every business tool. 2. bind connection provenance the host assigns a server instance id and records transport, binary or package digest, launch configuration, remote origin, credential binding, and trust tier. two servers with the same display name are not the same principal. a reconnect may create a new instance, while stable server identity and configuration version remain auditable. 3. fetch the advertised catalog tools/list may be paginated. the host reads a complete snapshot and records server-provided name, description, input schema, output schema, annotations, and observation time. description and schema are untrusted data. validate json and schema size, depth, recursive references, dialect, duplicate names, and executable content. large catalogs obey page, tool, and token budgets. 4. namespace and identify tools model-visible names bind a server namespace, such as github.create_issue versus ado.create_issue , preventing collisions. internal identity combines server id, tool name, schema digest, and contract version; a display alias is ui only. if a refresh changes schema under one name, it creates a new identity or version. old calls decode under the old snapshot. 5. reduce capabilities at the host a policy engine filters by principal, tenant, connection trust, oauth scopes, tool risk, task purpose, environment, and user consent. server annotations are hints, never authorization facts. write, destructive, and external-message tools require stronger confirmation or approval. the host may rewrite descriptions, narrow enums, or remove dangerous optional fields, while preserving lineage between original and effective schemas. 6. create a catalog snapshot the authorization result becomes an immutable snapshot containing catalog version, server sessions, tool identities, effective schemas, policy decisions, expiry, and consent references. a model turn and its resulting plan capture a snapshot id. runtime reauthorizes at execution, but refresh cannot redirect an old tool name to a different effect. 7. select a working set putting hundreds of tools in one prompt increases tokens, selection confusion, and exposure to hostile descriptions. the host retrieves candidates by task, conversation state, required resource, risk, and historical selection quality, then exposes a small working set. a meta-search capability can let the model request a class of tools without seeing the whole catalog. semantic similarity cannot remove policy constraints or tools required by workflow state. 8. handle listchanged and invalidation a server supporting listchanged can emit a tools-list-changed notification. the host debounces, refetches all pages, validates, creates vn+1, and computes additions, removals, and changes. removed tools disappear from new turns. an in-flight call uses its captured identity to complete, cancel, or enter contract unknown. cache keys include server session, catalog digest, and policy version, not url alone. 9. route calls through the snapshot the model returns an effective alias and arguments. the host resolves internal identity through the snapshot, repeats schema, semantic, and authorization validation, then calls the corresponding server. results bind server, session, tool and schema digest, and observation time. if transport fails during execution, runtime uses outcome-unknown and reconciliation rules; a transport error does not prove the effect failed. 10. audit and revoke a trace links initialization, catalog pages, policy reduction, working-set selection, model choice, validation, and result. revoking a server, credential, or consent removes capabilities from new snapshots and cancels calls not yet dispatched. dispatched effects follow business reconciliation. host ui exposes capability origin and risk instead of displaying only a friendly tool name. 必要数学：catalog 规模、选择错误与快照一致性 essential mathematics: catalog size, selection error, and snapshot consistency 选择规模 若一次 turn 暴露 n 个 tools，单个 tool description/schema 平均 t tokens，catalog 成本约 c≈n·t 。但风险不仅线性 token cost：近义工具 pair 约为 n(n−1)/2 ，潜在 confusion 随 n² 增长。working set 从 200 缩到 20，pair 从 19,900 降到 190。 两阶段召回 假设 task 所需 tool 在 catalog selector 的 recall 为 r ，模型在候选集内选择正确率为 a(k) ，其中 k 是 working-set 大小，则端到端选择概率约 p≈r(k)·a(k) 。增加 k 往往提高 recall，却降低 accuracy 并增加 token。应在 eval 上寻找乘积最优，不是固定 top-k。 快照一致性 call 绑定 i=(serverid, toolname, schemadigest, catalogversion) 。执行前解析出的 identity 必须等于计划捕获 i；若当前 catalog 已是 vn+1，也不能用同名新 schema 替换。这个 tuple 是 optimistic concurrency token：不匹配则重新规划或显式 migration。 selection scale if a turn exposes n tools and the average description plus schema costs t tokens, catalog cost is roughly c≈n·t . risk is not merely linear token cost. the number of potentially confusing tool pairs is n(n−1)/2 . shrinking a working set from two hundred to twenty reduces pairs from 19,900 to 190. two-stage retrieval suppose the catalog selector recalls the required tool with probability r(k) , and the model chooses correctly within a working set of size k with probability a(k) . end-to-end selection is approximately p≈r(k)·a(k) . increasing k often improves recall while reducing choice accuracy and increasing tokens. tune the product on evaluations rather than fixing an arbitrary top-k. snapshot consistency a call binds i=(serverid, toolname, schemadigest, catalogversion) . the identity resolved before execution must equal the identity captured by the plan. even if the current catalog is vn+1, the host cannot substitute a new schema under the same name. the tuple acts as an optimistic-concurrency token; mismatch requires replanning or explicit migration. 对 agent 系统的影响 implications for agent systems 能力： 新 server 可在不重训模型的情况下扩展动作词汇，但 capability 只有经过 host 编译才进入当前任务。meta-discovery 使大型生态保持小 context。 可靠性： catalog snapshot 将动态 discovery 与 durable plan 解耦；schema drift、server reconnect 和 listchanged 不会静默改变 in-flight semantics。trace 能复原模型当时看见的准确工具集合。 安全： server description 是不受信 metadata，oauth scope 不是用户意图，annotations 不是 policy。namespace、effective schema、least exposure、dispatch-time authorization 与 consent 共同构成 defense。 成本： 分页、validation、policy compilation、embedding/index、refresh 和 catalog cache 增加 control-plane 工作。指标应拆 initialize failure、catalog latency/size、schema reject、policy reduction、selector recall、model confusion、stale snapshot 与 call result。 freshness slo： 分别监控 notification-to-fetch、fetch-to-authorize、authorize-to-model-visible 的延迟，并记录 stale snapshot age。安全撤销走高优先级 deny path，不等待普通 catalog refresh；新增 capability 可以最终一致，但撤销必须立即阻断新 dispatch。 capability: a new server can extend the action vocabulary without retraining the model, but a capability enters the current task only after host compilation. meta-discovery keeps model context small even in a large ecosystem. reliability: catalog snapshots decouple dynamic discovery from durable plans. schema drift, server reconnect, and listchanged cannot silently alter in-flight semantics. traces reconstruct the exact tool set visible to the model at the decision. security: server descriptions are untrusted metadata, oauth scope is not user intent, and annotations are not policy. namespaces, effective schemas, least exposure, dispatch-time authorization, and consent provide defense in depth. cost: pagination, validation, policy compilation, catalog indexing, refresh, and caching add control-plane work. metrics separate initialization failure, catalog latency and size, schema rejection, policy reduction, selector recall, model confusion, stale snapshots, and call results. freshness slo: monitor notification-to-fetch, fetch-to-authorize, and authorize-to-model-visible latency separately, plus stale-snapshot age. security revocation uses a high-priority deny path rather than waiting for ordinary catalog refresh. new capability may be eventually consistent; revoked capability must immediately stop new dispatch. 设计取舍与失败模式 trade-offs and failure modes 原样暴露 catalog： 恶意 description 获得 prompt influence，越权 tools 可被选择；先 compile effective catalog。 仅按 server name namespace： 重连或同名配置混淆 identity；绑定 stable config/server id 与 schema digest。 无限动态刷新： 每个 notification 触发重拉形成 storm；debounce、rate limit、atomic snapshot。 缓存只按 url： 不同 credential/policy 共用错误 catalog；key 包含 session、principal/policy version。 相信 annotations： server 自称 readonly/destructive false 不构成证明；host 自行分类并以 effect contract 验证。 全 catalog 给模型： token 和 confusion 爆炸；task selector + meta-search，但保留 required capability recall eval。 同名热替换： 计划与执行语义不同；snapshot identity mismatch 必须 replan。 transport error 等于失败： 副作用可能已发生；进入 outcome_unknown/reconciliation。 expose raw catalog: hostile descriptions gain prompt influence and unauthorized tools become selectable. compile an effective catalog first. namespace by display name only: reconnects and duplicate configurations confuse identity. bind stable configuration and server ids plus schema digest. unbounded dynamic refresh: every notification triggers a refetch storm. debounce, rate-limit, and publish atomic snapshots. cache only by url: different credentials and policies share the wrong catalog. include session, principal, and policy version. trust annotations: a server claiming readonly or non-destructive is not proof. the host classifies risk and validates against effect contracts. give the model every tool: tokens and confusion explode. use task selection and meta-search while evaluating recall of required capabilities. hot-swap under one name: planning and execution semantics diverge. snapshot identity mismatch requires replanning. transport error means failure: an effect may have happened. enter outcome unknown and reconciliation. 可复用的技术判断 reusable technical judgments mcp server 返回 capability claims；host policy 决定 authorized catalog；task selector 决定 model working set。 initialize negotiation 不等于业务授权，oauth scope 也不等于当前用户意图。 tool identity 绑定 server、name、schema digest 与 catalog version；display alias 不是 identity。 listchanged 生成原子新 snapshot；in-flight call 保留旧 identity，并在 dispatch 重新授权。 大型 catalog 用两阶段 selection，优化 selector recall×model accuracy，而不是盲目暴露全部 tools。 mcp servers return capability claims. host policy decides the authorized catalog, and a task selector decides the model working set. initialization negotiation is not business authorization, and oauth scope is not current user intent. tool identity binds server, name, schema digest, and catalog version. a display alias is not identity. listchanged produces an atomic new snapshot. in-flight calls retain old identity and reauthorize at dispatch. large catalogs use two-stage selection, optimizing selector recall times model accuracy instead of exposing every tool. 一手资料 primary sources mcp lifecycle — initialization、version/capability negotiation 与 shutdown 规范。 mcp tools — tools/list、pagination、listchanged、tools/call 与结果规范。 mcp authorization — http transport authorization 框架与 token/resource 边界。 mcp security best practices — confused deputy、token passthrough、ssrf 与 session hijacking 风险指南。 json-rpc 2.0 — request/response/notification 与错误对象规范。 json schema core — input/output schema 的规范基础。 三阶段 catalog、snapshot identity、host capability reduction 与 working-set selector 是本文基于协议边界的编辑性系统综合。 mcp lifecycle — initialization, version and capability negotiation, and shutdown. mcp tools — tools/list, pagination, listchanged, tools/call, and result semantics. mcp authorization — the http-transport authorization framework and token/resource boundaries. mcp security best practices — guidance on confused deputy, token passthrough, ssrf, and session hijacking. json-rpc 2.0 — request, response, notification, and error-object semantics. json schema core — the schema foundation for inputs and outputs. the three catalog stages, snapshot identity, host capability reduction, and working-set selector are editorial systems synthesis from the protocol boundaries. 已建立与下一篇起点 what is established and where we continue 今天已建立： mcp discovery 先产生 untrusted advertised catalog，host 以 provenance、namespace、schema validation、policy/consent 编译 immutable authorized snapshot，再按任务暴露小型 working set。listchanged 生成新快照，不静默改变旧 plan；dispatch 仍实时重验授权与 contract。 尚未讲完： skills/plugins 与 tools 的边界是什么？当扩展包含 instruction、workflow、code、assets 与多个 tools 时，如何做 packaging、依赖、权限、sandbox、版本与组合，避免“安装即全信任”？ 下一篇： tools 与 extensibility 3/4 深挖 skill/plugin packaging 与 composition：instruction/data/code trust、依赖图、permission manifest、sandbox 和冲突解析。 established today: mcp discovery first creates an untrusted advertised catalog. the host compiles an immutable authorized snapshot using provenance, namespaces, schema validation, policy, and consent, then exposes a small task-specific working set. listchanged creates a new snapshot without silently changing old plans; dispatch still revalidates authorization and contracts. still unresolved: where is the boundary between skills or plugins and tools? when an extension contains instructions, workflows, code, assets, and several tools, how are packaging, dependencies, permission, sandboxing, versioning, and composition managed without turning installation into total trust? next: tools and extensibility 3/4 examines skill and plugin packaging and composition: instruction, data, and code trust; dependency graphs; permission manifests; sandboxes; and conflict resolution.

title.zh: Tool schema 如何决定 Agent 能做什么？
title.en: How Does a Tool Schema Define What an Agent Can Do?

text: tool schema 如何决定 agent 能做什么？ how does a tool schema define what an agent can do? tools 与 extensibility 内核 tools and extensibility internals tool schema json schema capability design validation tool contracts 今日命题 today's proposition 给 llm 一个 tool，不只是告诉它“有个函数可以调用”。tool name、description、parameter schema 和 result/error shape 共同定义模型可生成的动作语言。若 schema 允许任意 filesystem path、sql 或 http url，模型动作空间接近通用解释器；若只允许 resourceid、批准过的 operation enum 和有界参数，许多危险动作在生成层面就不可表达。 但 schema-valid 不等于安全或正确。json schema 能证明 amount 是正数、currency 属于枚举，却不能证明账户属于当前 tenant、余额足够、审批仍有效、请求可安全重试或 effect 尚未发生。这些属于语义契约和 runtime policy。工具系统至少有三层：模型可见语法、runtime 验证的语义与授权、effect owner 真正执行的业务边界。 核心判断： tool schema 是 agent action space 的编译接口，不是 api 文档的自动复制。好的 schema 让合法意图容易表达、危险歧义无法表达；好的 contract 再保证同一结构在权限、时间、重试和结果上具有稳定语义。 giving an llm a tool is not merely telling it that a function exists. tool name, description, parameter schema, and result or error shape jointly define the action language the model can generate. a schema allowing arbitrary filesystem paths, sql, or http urls approaches a general interpreter. a schema limited to resource ids, approved operation enums, and bounded parameters makes many dangerous actions inexpressible at generation time. yet schema-valid does not mean safe or correct. json schema can prove that amount is positive and currency belongs to an enum. it cannot prove that an account belongs to the current tenant, funds are available, approval remains valid, retry is safe, or the effect has not already happened. those properties belong to semantic contracts and runtime policy. a tool system therefore has at least three layers: model-visible syntax, runtime-validated semantics and authorization, and the business boundary where an effect owner executes. core judgment: a tool schema is the compilation interface for an agent's action space, not an automatic copy of api documentation. a good schema makes valid intent easy to express and dangerous ambiguity impossible to express. a good contract then gives the structure stable meaning across permission, time, retry, and result handling. 承接 runtime 与 memory：command 必须可判定 from runtime and memory to decidable commands agent runtime 已区分 typed command、callid、attemptid 与 lifecycle；memory 系列又要求 authority、scope、valid time 和 provenance 显式化。tool schema 是两条线的连接点：模型提出的自然语言意图必须在 dispatch 前编译成可验证 command。runtime 将 principal、tenant、approval、deadline 与 idempotency key 作为可信 execution context 注入，而不是允许模型填写。 例如 send_email(to, body) 把 recipient resolution、sender identity、sensitivity、模板、附件和确认策略藏在自由文本里。更强的 contract 可以是 send_approved_notification(notificationdraftid, recipientgroupid, approvalid) ：模型选择已存在 capability，runtime 解析真实地址并重新验证 approval。它牺牲通用性，换来更小动作空间和更强审计。 tool 与底层 api 因此不必一一对应。一个模型工具可编排多个内部 api；一个底层 endpoint 也可暴露成多个按风险分层的 capabilities。设计目标不是减少 wrapper，而是把模型负责的认知选择与系统负责的确定性控制切开。 agent runtime distinguished typed commands, call ids, attempt ids, and lifecycle. the memory series made authority, scope, valid time, and provenance explicit. a tool schema connects the two: natural-language intent must compile into a verifiable command before dispatch. runtime injects trusted execution context such as principal, tenant, approval, deadline, and idempotency key rather than allowing the model to fill them. a tool named send_email(to, body) hides recipient resolution, sender identity, sensitivity, template, attachments, and confirmation policy inside free text. a stronger contract might be send_approved_notification(notificationdraftid, recipientgroupid, approvalid) . the model selects an existing capability; runtime resolves actual addresses and revalidates approval. generality decreases, but action space and audit become tractable. tools therefore need not map one-to-one to backend apis. one model tool may orchestrate several internal apis; one backend endpoint may be exposed as multiple capabilities by risk tier. the objective is not fewer wrappers. it is separating cognitive choice assigned to the model from deterministic control assigned to the system. 机制：从 schema 到一次可安全执行的 call mechanism: from schema to a safely executable call tool call 的三层 contract 模型根据 catalog 生成 schema-valid arguments。runtime 注入 identity 和 policy context，做 semantic validation 和 canonicalization。adapter 调用 effect owner，返回 typed result 并记录 provenance。 model intent tool selection + args syntax layer json schema validate no unknown fields semantic layer acl · state · approval canonical fingerprint effect owner commit / query idempotency typed result status · version · refs runtime state lifecycle · provenance 原创示意：schema 只守语法边界；runtime 与 effect owner 必须继续验证身份、状态、副作用和结果语义。 1. 从 decision 建 action vocabulary 先列 workflow 必须做的业务动作，而不是把 service swagger 全量暴露。每个 tool 对应可审计 capability：query、draft、validate、commit、revoke 分开；read/write 分开；preview/commit 分开；高风险 action 先生成 draft 或 plan。 2. name/description 是检索接口 模型通常先根据 name/description 选 tool，再生成 arguments。名称使用稳定动词+对象，description 明确何时使用、何时不用、前置条件和副作用。多个近义工具若只以团队缩写区分，selection error 在参数 validation 前已经发生。 3. 用 schema 缩小语法空间 优先 enum、oneof/discriminator、bounded number、format、pattern、min/max items 与 additionalproperties:false。用 resource id 代替任意 url/path，用 structured filter 代替 sql，用 iso timestamp+timezone policy 代替含糊自然语言。optional 字段区分 absent、null 与 empty；默认值由 runtime 填，不能让模型猜。 4. 可信 context 不进入模型参数 tenantid、principalid、roles、credential、approval scope、traceid、deadline、idempotency key 由 runtime/session 注入。若 schema 暴露 tenantid，prompt injection 可诱导模型跨租户；即使 authorization 最终拒绝，也扩大攻击面和日志噪声。 5. 两阶段 validation 第一阶段做 schema validation：类型、必填、枚举、长度、未知字段。第二阶段做 semantic validation：resource 是否存在且属于 tenant、状态是否允许 transition、approval 是否覆盖当前 args、policy 是否允许 purpose、乐观版本是否仍匹配。错误码分开，模型才能修复参数而不反复挑战权限。 6. normalize 后再 fingerprint 时区、大小写、空白、id alias 和默认值先规范化，再生成 canonical command 与 request hash。相同业务意图获得同一 fingerprint；amount 或 recipient 变化必须产生不同 hash。schema/tool version 进入 fingerprint，防止升级后同 key 表示不同语义。 7. dispatch contract adapter 映射到 effect owner，传递 deadline、cancellation、idempotency/fencing context。runtime 不把 http 200 自动当业务成功，而解码 accepted/ completed/ rejected/ pending/ outcome_unknown union。异步 operation 返回 operationid 和 query capability，而不是让模型轮询自由文本。 8. error taxonomy 至少分 validation_error、authorization_denied、precondition_failed、rate_limited、transient_unavailable、outcome_unknown、business_rejected 与 internal_contract_error。每类声明 retryable、user-actionable、safe-to-rephrase、requires-reconciliation。不要只返回 “something went wrong”，也不要把 stack trace 交模型。 9. result schema 与 provenance 结果只返回下一决策所需字段，包括 resource/version、status、observedat、source、warnings 与 nextactions。避免庞大 backend object 挤占 context，也不能省略版本导致 stale update。tool output 仍是 untrusted data；返回文本不能借 tool 身份获得 system instruction authority。 10. contract evolution breaking change 创建新 tool/schema version；旧 execution pin 旧语义。增加 optional 字段也影响模型选择和 token cost。部署前用 recorded calls 做 compatibility replay，检查 old args、new validator、result decoder 和 retry policy。撤销 tool 时返回 typed unavailable/deprecated，不得静默复用名称指向新 effect。 11. 分层评测 contract tool eval 不能只统计最终 task success。先用只有 name/description 的样本测 selection confusion；再固定正确 tool 测 arguments exactness、schema validity 与 repair turns；随后用资源状态和 policy fixtures 测 semantic reject/allow；最后用 fake effect owner 测 idempotency、timeout、typed result 和 replay。mutant tests 故意交换两个近义 description、放宽 additionalproperties 或删掉 version 字段，验证评测能否捕获 contract regression。 12. dispatch 前重验 capability catalog 中可见不代表执行时仍获授权。selection 与 dispatch 之间可能发生 role revocation、approval expiry、resource version change 或 tool disable。runtime 在最后边界以当前 policy 和 normalized args 重验；approval digest 必须覆盖 material fields。这个 toctou gate 失败时返回 typed precondition/authorization error，不能让模型“解释一下”后绕过。 three contract layers in a tool call the model selects from a catalog and generates schema-valid arguments. runtime injects identity and policy context, performs semantic validation and canonicalization. an adapter invokes the effect owner, returns a typed result, and records provenance. model intent tool selection + args syntax layer json schema validate no unknown fields semantic layer acl · state · approval canonical fingerprint effect owner commit / query idempotency typed result status · version · refs runtime state lifecycle · provenance original diagram: schema guards syntax only. runtime and effect owner must continue validating identity, state, side effects, and result semantics. 1. derive an action vocabulary from decisions list business actions required by the workflow rather than exposing an entire service swagger document. each tool represents an auditable capability. query, draft, validate, commit, and revoke are modeled separately. reads and writes remain distinct; preview and commit remain distinct; high-risk actions first create a draft or plan. 2. names and descriptions form a retrieval interface the model often selects a tool from name and description before generating arguments. use stable verb-object names. descriptions state when to use the tool, when not to use it, prerequisites, and side effects. near-duplicate tools distinguished only by team acronyms cause selection failure before argument validation can help. 3. shrink syntax with schema prefer enums, oneof with discriminators, bounded numbers, formats, patterns, item bounds, and additionalproperties false. use resource ids instead of arbitrary urls or paths, structured filters instead of sql, and iso timestamps with timezone policy instead of ambiguous language. optional fields distinguish absent, null, and empty. runtime supplies defaults; the model does not guess them. 4. keep trusted context out of model arguments tenant id, principal id, roles, credentials, approval scope, trace id, deadline, and idempotency key are injected by runtime or session. if tenant id appears in the schema, prompt injection can ask the model to cross tenants. authorization may reject it eventually, but exposure still expands attack surface and log noise. 5. validate in two stages schema validation covers types, required fields, enums, lengths, and unknown properties. semantic validation checks whether a resource exists and belongs to the tenant, state permits the transition, approval covers the exact arguments, policy permits the purpose, and optimistic version still matches. separate error codes let the model repair malformed arguments without repeatedly challenging authorization. 6. normalize before fingerprinting normalize timezone, case, whitespace, id aliases, and defaults before creating a canonical command and request hash. the same business intent should produce the same fingerprint; changing amount or recipient must change it. schema and tool versions enter the fingerprint so an upgrade cannot give one key a new meaning. 7. define dispatch semantics an adapter maps the command to the effect owner and carries deadline, cancellation, idempotency, and fencing context. runtime does not equate http 200 with business success. it decodes a result union such as accepted, completed, rejected, pending, or outcome unknown. an asynchronous operation returns an operation id and query capability rather than asking the model to poll free-form text. 8. define an error taxonomy distinguish validation error, authorization denied, precondition failed, rate limited, transient unavailable, outcome unknown, business rejected, and internal contract error. each class declares whether it is retryable, user-actionable, safe to rephrase, or requires reconciliation. do not return only “something went wrong,” and do not send raw stack traces to the model. 9. shape results and provenance return only fields needed for the next decision, including resource and version, status, observed time, source, warnings, and next actions. avoid flooding context with backend objects, but do not omit versions needed to prevent stale updates. tool output remains untrusted data inside a content boundary; returned text does not gain system authority merely because it came from a tool. 10. evolve contracts deliberately a breaking change creates a new tool or schema version, while old executions remain pinned to old semantics. even optional fields can affect model choice and token cost. before deployment, replay recorded calls through the new validator, decoder, and retry policy. a revoked tool returns a typed unavailable or deprecated result instead of silently reusing its name for a different effect. 11. evaluate the contract by layer tool evaluation cannot report final task success alone. first test selection confusion using only names and descriptions. then hold the correct tool fixed and measure argument exactness, schema validity, and repair turns. next use resource-state and policy fixtures to test semantic allow and reject. finally use a fake effect owner to exercise idempotency, timeout, typed results, and replay. mutant tests deliberately swap two similar descriptions, relax additionalproperties, or remove a version field to prove that evaluation detects contract regression. 12. revalidate capability at dispatch visibility in a catalog does not prove authorization still exists at execution time. between selection and dispatch, a role may be revoked, approval may expire, a resource version may change, or the tool may be disabled. runtime revalidates current policy against normalized arguments at the final boundary, and the approval digest covers every material field. a time-of-check to time-of-use failure returns a typed precondition or authorization error; the model cannot explain its way around it. 必要数学：动作空间与错误放大 essential mathematics: action space and error amplification 组合空间 若 schema 字段 i 有 nᵢ 个可选值，粗略动作组合数 |a|≈∏nᵢ 。三个 free-form strings 实际近似无界；operation 5 个 enum、授权 resource 20 个、mode 2 个时约 200 种。估算忽略依赖约束，却说明 enum/oneof 不只是 validation，也是搜索空间压缩。 流水线成功率 工具选择正确率 pₛ 、syntactic validity pᵥ 、semantic validity pₘ 、execution success pₑ 、result interpretation pᵣ ，简化端到端 p≈pₛpᵥpₘpₑpᵣ 。各层 0.95 时约 0.774。structured output 只提高 pᵥ，不能替代 selection、semantic validation 或 result handling。 contract utility 可比较 u=tasksuccess− λ·risk− μ·latency− ν·tokencost 。更细 schema 可能提高 success、降低 risk，却增加 description tokens 和选择负担。过多微工具也会降低 pₛ。目标不是字段越多越好，而是在风险约束下最大化任务效用。 combinatorial action space if schema field i has nᵢ possible values, a rough action count is |a|≈∏nᵢ . three free-form strings are effectively unbounded. restricting operation to five enums, resource to twenty authorized ids, and mode to two values yields about two hundred combinations. the estimate ignores dependent constraints, but shows that enum and oneof compress search, not merely validate output. pipeline success let correct tool selection be pₛ , syntactically valid arguments pᵥ , semantic validity pₘ , execution success pₑ , and correct result interpretation pᵣ . a simplified end-to-end rate is p≈pₛpᵥpₘpₑpᵣ . five layers at 0.95 yield about 0.774. structured output improves pᵥ only; it does not replace selection, semantic validation, or result handling. contract utility compare designs using u=tasksuccess− λ·risk− μ·latency− ν·tokencost . a finer schema may improve success and reduce risk while increasing description tokens and selection burden. too many micro-tools can lower pₛ. the objective is not maximal field count but maximal task utility subject to risk constraints. 对 agent 系统的影响 implications for agent systems 能力： capability-oriented tools 把 backend 组合成模型可可靠选择的业务动作。agent 不需理解 oauth、tenant routing 或 transaction internals，却能在受控范围完成任务。 可靠性： typed results/error taxonomy 让 retry、reconciliation、human escalation 由 runtime 决定，不靠模型猜 error string。schema version 与 fingerprint 把 tool evolution 纳入 durable execution。 安全： 最强控制不是 prompt 说“不要做 x”，而是 schema 无法表达 x、runtime 不注入 capability、effect owner 再验证 principal/policy。三层 defense 避免单点。 成本： 更窄工具增加 adapter 和 contract tests，但减少无效调用、重试与 context noise。指标分 selection error、schema invalid、semantic reject、authorization deny、effect failure、outcome unknown、result decode；总 tool success 无法定位设计问题。 capability: capability-oriented tools package backend complexity into business actions the model can select reliably. the agent need not understand oauth, tenant routing, or transaction internals, yet completes work inside a controlled boundary. reliability: typed results and error taxonomies let runtime decide retries, reconciliation, and human escalation rather than asking a model to interpret strings. schema versions and fingerprints integrate tool evolution with durable execution. security: the strongest control is not a prompt saying “do not do x.” the schema cannot express x, runtime does not inject the capability, and the effect owner revalidates principal and policy. three layers prevent a single point of failure. cost: narrower tools require more adapters and contract tests, but reduce invalid calls, retries, and context noise. metrics separate selection error, schema invalid, semantic rejection, authorization denial, effect failure, outcome unknown, and result decoding. one overall tool-success rate cannot diagnose design. 设计取舍与失败模式 trade-offs and failure modes swagger 直出： 大量 endpoint/字段使选择困难且暴露内部控制；先设计业务 capability。 万能 execute： 自由 sql/shell/url 动作空间无界；仅在强 sandbox 和人工边界使用。 过度微工具： 几十个近义函数降低 selection；按认知决策而非每个 endpoint 切分。 schema-valid 幻觉： resourceid 类型正确但不存在或越权；semantic/policy validation 必须存在。 默认值歧义： 缺省 recipient/mode 可能危险；高风险字段 required，默认由可信 runtime 决定。 错误全重试： authorization/business reject 被当 transient；typed taxonomy 与唯一 retry owner。 结果过大： backend payload 挤 context 并携 injection；裁剪、分页、引用 artifact。 静默版本漂移： 同名改语义使 replay/idempotency 失效；显式 version 与 compatibility replay。 raw swagger export: too many endpoints and fields make selection difficult and expose internal controls. design business capabilities first. universal execute: arbitrary sql, shell, or urls create an unbounded action space. use only inside strong sandboxes and human boundaries. too many micro-tools: dozens of near-synonyms reduce selection. split by cognitive decision, not every endpoint. schema-valid hallucination: a resource id has the correct type but does not exist or is unauthorized. semantic and policy validation remain mandatory. ambiguous defaults: default recipient or mode may be dangerous. require high-risk fields; trusted runtime supplies defaults. retry every error: authorization and business rejection are treated as transient. use typed taxonomy and one retry owner. oversized results: backend payloads consume context and carry injection. trim, paginate, and reference artifacts. silent version drift: changing semantics under one name breaks replay and idempotency. use explicit versions and compatibility replay. 可复用的技术判断 reusable technical judgments tool schema 定义模型可表达的动作语法；tool contract 定义权限、状态、重试和结果语义。 不要复制 backend api；按业务 capability 切分 read/draft/validate/commit。 tenant、principal、credential、approval、deadline、idempotency 由 runtime 注入。 schema validation 与 semantic/policy validation 分层；error/result 使用 typed union。 tool evolution 需要 version、canonical fingerprint、recorded-call replay 与旧 execution 兼容。 a tool schema defines the syntax of model-expressible actions; the contract defines permission, state, retry, and result semantics. do not copy backend apis. split read, draft, validate, and commit by business capability. runtime injects tenant, principal, credentials, approval, deadline, and idempotency. separate schema validation from semantic and policy validation. use typed unions for errors and results. tool evolution needs versions, canonical fingerprints, recorded-call replay, and compatibility for old executions. 一手资料 primary sources json schema 2020-12 core — schema vocabulary 核心规范。 json schema validation — validation keywords 规范。 openapi 3.1.1 — api description 规范。 mcp tools specification — discovery、inputschema、调用与结果协议；host policy 不由协议自动保证。 rfc 9457 problem details — machine-readable http error details。 rfc 9110 http semantics — method、idempotency 与状态语义。 nist sp 800-162 — attribute-based access control 框架。 capability-oriented 拆分、可信 context 注入、两阶段 validation、result union 与 compatibility replay 是本文编辑性综合。 json schema 2020-12 core — the core specification for schema vocabularies. json schema validation — the validation-keyword specification. openapi 3.1.1 — the api-description specification. mcp tools specification — protocol semantics for discovery, inputschema, calls, and results; host policy is not automatically guaranteed. rfc 9457 problem details — machine-readable http error details. rfc 9110 http semantics — methods, idempotency, and status semantics. nist sp 800-162 — an attribute-based access-control framework. capability-oriented decomposition, trusted-context injection, two-stage validation, result unions, and compatibility replay are editorial synthesis. 已建立与下一篇起点 what is established and where we continue 今天已建立： schema 缩小 action syntax，semantic/policy contract 决定调用是否合法，adapter/effect owner 决定业务语义。可信 identity/approval/idempotency 由 runtime 注入；typed errors/results 支撑 recovery 与审计。 尚未讲完： 当 tools 来自动态 server、mcp registry、skills 或 plugins 时，如何发现、筛选、命名空间化、授权和缓存？host 如何防止恶意 description、schema drift 与 capability confusion？ 下一篇： tools 与 extensibility 2/4 进入 discovery/mcp：初始化与 capability negotiation、tool catalog、动态刷新、trust boundary、namespace 和选择规模。 established today: schemas shrink action syntax, semantic and policy contracts determine whether calls are permitted, and adapters or effect owners define business meaning. runtime injects trusted identity, approval, and idempotency. typed errors and results support recovery and audit. still unresolved: when tools come from dynamic servers, mcp registries, skills, or plugins, how are they discovered, filtered, namespaced, authorized, and cached? how does a host resist malicious descriptions, schema drift, and capability confusion? next: tools and extensibility 2/4 covers discovery and mcp: initialization and capability negotiation, tool catalogs, dynamic refresh, trust boundaries, namespaces, and selection scale.

title.zh: Agent 说“我记得”，你怎么证明它真的记对了？
title.en: When an Agent Says “I Remember,” How Do You Prove It?

text: agent 说“我记得”，你怎么证明它真的记对了？ when an agent says “i remember,” how do you prove it? context 与 memory 系统 context and memory systems memory evaluation temporal testing failure attribution online guardrails production readiness 今日命题 today's proposition 一个 agent 在 demo 中正确提到用户偏好，不证明 memory system 有效。偏好可能仍在当前 prompt，测试数据可能泄漏到 index，top-k 可能偶然命中，模型也可能靠常识猜中。反过来，一次答案错误也不能直接归咎于 retrieval：候选可能正确，却被 acl 过滤、token budget 截断、摘要改写，或被模型忽略。 memory eval 必须把完整数据流作为被测系统：source event → extraction → admission/versioning → indexes → query/filter/rank → context assembly → model decision → lifecycle/delete。既要给各边界可判定的局部 oracle，也要用真实 downstream task 检查组合效果；同时用时间切分保证被测系统只能使用当时可知的信息。 核心判断： memory 的成功不是“召回了类似文本”，而是在给定 principal、decision time 与 risk policy 下，使用当时有效且获授权的证据作出正确行动，并在证据不足、冲突或已删除时安全 abstain。 an agent mentioning a preference correctly in a demo does not prove its memory system works. the preference may still be present in the current prompt, test data may leak into the index, top-k may hit accidentally, or the model may guess from common sense. conversely, one wrong answer is not automatically a retrieval defect: the correct candidate may have been filtered by acl, truncated by token budget, distorted by summary, or ignored by the model. memory evaluation treats the complete data flow as the system under test: source event, extraction, admission and versioning, indexes, query and ranking, context assembly, model decision, and lifecycle or deletion. each boundary needs a local oracle, while realistic downstream tasks test their composition. temporal splits ensure that the system uses only information available at the historical decision time. core judgment: memory success is not retrieving similar text. for a given principal, decision time, and risk policy, the agent uses authorized evidence valid at that time, takes the correct action, and safely abstains when evidence is absent, conflicting, or deleted. 把前三篇变成可检验合同 turn the first three parts into testable contracts 1/4 要求 context、event log、working state、index 与 durable record 分层；2/4 要求 lossy summary 可回源、invariant 绕过压缩；3/4 要求 candidate admission、hard gates、hybrid ranking 和可验证删除。今天把每条架构判断翻译成 eval contract：给定 source 与 policy，系统应写什么、不写什么；给定历史时点和 principal，应返回哪些 record versions；给定 token budget，哪些 invariant 必须仍在 context；给定 tombstone，任何派生 index 都不得再次暴露正文。 这也决定数据集不能只是 question/answer pairs。一个 case 至少包含事件时间线、source authority、scope、acl principal、memory operations、decision query、expected evidence set、forbidden evidence set、expected action/abstention，以及每个阶段的 trace oracle。只有这样，失败才可定位而不是笼统记为“答案不对”。 part 1 separated context, event log, working state, indexes, and durable records. part 2 required lossy summaries to remain source-reversible while invariants bypass compression. part 3 introduced candidate admission, hard gates, hybrid ranking, and verifiable deletion. today turns each architectural judgment into an evaluation contract: given source and policy, what should be written or rejected; given historical time and principal, which record versions may be returned; given a token budget, which invariants must remain in context; given a tombstone, which derivatives must stop exposing content. the dataset cannot be merely question-answer pairs. a case needs an event timeline, source authority, scope, acl principal, memory operations, decision query, expected and forbidden evidence sets, expected action or abstention, and trace oracles for each stage. only then can a failure be localized rather than labeled generically “wrong answer.” 机制：一个能归因的端到端 eval harness mechanism: an attributable end-to-end evaluation harness 1. freeze a temporal world fixture 用 append-only events 构造世界，在多个 cutoff t₁/t₂/t₃ 运行。t₁ 查询不得看见 t₂ 才写入的更新；迟到事件同时测试 valid time 与 transaction time。index snapshot、policy version、assembler version、model version 固定，避免重跑时偷用未来状态。 2. 写入 eval 给 extraction/admission 成对样本：明确事实、推断、临时 tool noise、pii、跨租户文本、重复、冲突和更新。测 field exactness、source attribution、write precision/recall、duplicate rate、conflict-set creation、supersession correctness 与 forbidden-write rate。高 write recall 若伴随大量推断污染并非成功。 3. retrieval eval 每个 query 定义 relevant set、required authoritative set、forbidden set 和 acceptable alternatives。分别测 lexical/vector/graph recall，再测 hard-filter leakage=0、temporal correctness、conflict coverage、ndcg/mrr 和最终 evidence precision。没有 exhaustive source 时，正确结果可能是 unknown。 4. compression/assembly eval 用包含否定、数字、open effects、approval 与冲突的长 episode 压缩。检查 invariant fidelity、source-reference validity、summary hallucination、stale invalidation 和 rehydration trigger。然后给固定 budget，比较 expected context manifest：policy/state 是否保留，禁止证据是否缺席，关键 source 是否因 risk rule 展开。 5. model-use eval 固定 assembled evidence 后单独调用模型，避免把 retrieval 与 reasoning 混在一起。任务要求引用 recordid、区分事实/推断、解释 conflict，并按 contract action/abstain。测 citation entailment、unsupported claim、correct action、calibrated abstention 和对 adversarial instructions 的抵抗。 6. counterfactual pairs 只改变一个 memory fact 或 acl，其他输入完全相同：地址 a→b 后输出必须改变；将 record 标 tombstone 后不得继续引用；把 authoritative update 换成低权威 rumor 后应 conflict/abstain。若输出不变，可能未使用 memory；若无关变化也影响输出，说明 context contamination。 7. deletion eval 先证明 record 可从 canonical、bm25、vector、graph、summary、cache 召回，再发删除。立即检查 query deny，等待 propagation slo 后重新枚举所有 projections，并从冷启动重建 index 证明 tombstone 不会复活。backup 依 retention policy 检查不可在线恢复，而非声称瞬间物理擦除。 8. failure attribution harness 保存 source events、candidate、admission result、record versions、retriever lists、filter reasons、scores、context manifest、model output 与 verifier result。first-divergence classifier 找到最早偏离 oracle 的边界：source missing、extract、write、index lag、filter、rank、compress、serialize、model-use 或 lifecycle。 9. online shadow 与 canary 新 pipeline 先 shadow：读取同一请求但不影响行动，比较 evidence set、latency、cost、leakage。canary 按 tenant/task/risk 分层，小比例启用，并设 rollback 条件：forbidden retrieval、abstention collapse、deletion slo breach 或高风险 action regression 立即停。线上 implicit feedback 不能替代标注 eval，因为用户不纠正不等于正确。 10. production checklist 上线前回答：canonical truth 在哪；每个 record 是否有 provenance/acl/time/version；summary 是否可回源；index 是否可重建；hard gate 是否在模型前；冲突是否显式；unknown 是否可表达；删除是否覆盖派生；trace 是否可 replay；每个 high-risk action 是否有 authoritative verifier。任何一项“否”都不是调 top-k 能修复的问题。 11. baseline 与 ablation 至少比较四个 baseline：无 memory、仅 recent window、oracle evidence、完整 pipeline。无 memory 衡量模型本身能猜多少；recent window 衡量持久 memory 的增益；oracle evidence 给出 retrieval 上限；完整 pipeline 显示真实组合表现。再逐一关闭 summary、vector、authority feature、conflict exposure 或 rehydration 做 ablation。若复杂系统不优于 recent window，就不应以架构漂亮为理由上线；若 oracle evidence 仍失败，继续调 retriever 没有意义，应修 model-use 或 task contract。 12. 人工 adjudication 与 corpus 治理 authority 冲突、隐私用途和“合理 abstain”常没有单一自动答案。双人独立标注加第三方 adjudication，记录 disagreement reason，而不是强行隐藏分歧。dataset 本身需要 version、source license、pii handling、case owner、last review 和 retirement policy；模型或 policy 变化后重新抽样。测试集不能由生产 trace 无限制积累，否则会把敏感数据和用户错误永久固化。每次 release 保存 eval manifest：dataset version、code/model/index snapshot、thresholds 与逐 case evidence，确保结果可复现。 1. freeze a temporal world fixtures construct a world from append-only events and execute at cutoffs t1, t2, and t3. a t1 query cannot see an update written at t2. late-arriving events test valid time separately from transaction time. index snapshot, policy version, assembler version, and model version remain fixed so replay cannot borrow future state. 2. evaluate writes give extraction and admission paired examples: explicit facts, inferences, transient tool noise, pii, cross-tenant text, duplicates, conflicts, and updates. measure field exactness, source attribution, write precision and recall, duplicate rate, conflict-set creation, supersession correctness, and forbidden-write rate. high write recall accompanied by inference pollution is not success. 3. evaluate retrieval each query defines a relevant set, required authoritative set, forbidden set, and acceptable alternatives. measure lexical, vector, and graph recall separately, then zero hard-filter leakage, temporal correctness, conflict coverage, ndcg or mrr, and final evidence precision. where no exhaustive source exists, unknown may be the only correct result. 4. evaluate compression and assembly compress long episodes containing negation, numbers, open effects, approval, and conflicts. check invariant fidelity, source-reference validity, summary hallucination, stale invalidation, and rehydration triggers. under a fixed token budget, compare the context manifest with an oracle: policy and state remain, forbidden evidence is absent, and high-risk sources expand when policy requires them. 5. evaluate model use call the model with fixed assembled evidence to separate reasoning from retrieval. the task requires record-id citations, distinctions between fact and inference, conflict explanation, and action or abstention according to contract. measure citation entailment, unsupported claims, correct action, calibrated abstention, and resistance to adversarial instructions in retrieved data. 6. use counterfactual pairs change exactly one memory fact or acl while keeping all other input constant. when address a changes to b, the action must change. after a tombstone, the record cannot be cited. replacing an authoritative update with a low-authority rumor should cause conflict or abstention. unchanged output suggests memory was unused; changes from irrelevant mutations reveal contamination. 7. evaluate deletion first prove a record is retrievable from canonical store, bm25, vector, graph, summary, and cache. issue deletion, check immediate query denial, wait for the propagation slo, and enumerate projections again. rebuild an index from cold state to prove the tombstone prevents resurrection. backup tests follow retention policy and verify the record cannot return online rather than claiming instantaneous physical erasure. 8. attribute failures the harness retains source events, candidate, admission result, record versions, retriever lists, filter reasons, scores, context manifest, model output, and verifier result. a first-divergence classifier finds the earliest boundary that differs from oracle: source missing, extraction, write, index lag, filter, rank, compression, serialization, model use, or lifecycle. 9. shadow and canary online a new pipeline first runs in shadow: it reads the same request without affecting action, comparing evidence sets, latency, cost, and leakage. canary rollout is stratified by tenant, task, and risk. forbidden retrieval, abstention collapse, deletion-slo breach, or high-risk action regression triggers rollback. implicit feedback never replaces labeled evaluation; lack of user correction does not prove correctness. 10. production checklist before launch ask: where canonical truth lives; whether every record has provenance, acl, time, and version; whether summaries are source-reversible; whether indexes rebuild; whether hard gates precede the model; whether conflicts and unknown are explicit; whether deletion covers derivatives; whether traces replay; and whether every high-risk action has an authoritative verifier. a “no” is not repairable by tuning top-k. 11. baselines and ablations compare at least four baselines: no memory, recent window only, oracle evidence, and the complete pipeline. no memory measures how much the model can guess. a recent window measures the marginal benefit of persistence. oracle evidence provides the upper bound when retrieval is perfect. the complete pipeline shows actual composition. then disable summaries, vector search, authority features, conflict exposure, and rehydration one at a time. if the complex system does not beat a recent window, architectural sophistication is not a reason to ship. if oracle evidence still fails, further retriever tuning is irrelevant; repair model use or the task contract. 12. human adjudication and corpus governance authority conflicts, privacy purpose, and reasonable abstention often lack one automatic answer. use two independent annotators with third-party adjudication and preserve disagreement reasons instead of hiding ambiguity. the dataset itself needs a version, source license, pii handling rule, case owner, last-review date, and retirement policy. resample after model or policy changes. production traces cannot accumulate without limit as test data, or the corpus permanently stores sensitive information and user mistakes. every release retains an evaluation manifest: dataset version, code, model and index snapshots, thresholds, per-case evidence, and adjudication revision. this makes a score reproducible and reveals when an apparent gain comes from changing cases or labels rather than improving the memory system. regression triage starts from newly failing cases and first divergence, while periodic challenge sets test unseen conflict, deletion, and temporal patterns. 必要数学：端到端成功与分层诊断 essential mathematics: end-to-end success and layered diagnosis 端到端不是单项指标 设写入正确率 w、检索含 required evidence 的概率 r、assembly 保真率 a、模型正确使用概率 u，则简化端到端成功近似 p(success)=w·r·a·u 。这不是独立性事实，而是诊断直觉：即使每层 0.95，乘积只有约 0.814；优化已经 0.99 的 retrieval，可能不如修复 0.80 的 model-use。 安全要单列 forbidden leakage rate l=forbidden retrieved/forbidden opportunities 的目标通常是 0，不能被平均 task accuracy 抵消。abstention precision 衡量 abstain 中真正证据不足的比例，abstention recall 衡量所有应 abstain case 被捕获的比例。只提高 recall 会让 agent 过度拒绝；只提高 precision 会让它在未知时冒进。 时间切分 对 decision time t，只允许使用 k(t)={r | transactiontime(r)≤t 且 validat(r,t)} 。这个集合定义防止未来更新泄漏，并区分“当时知道什么”与“现在回看什么”。每个 eval case 必须记录 cutoff 和 index snapshot，而不是在最新数据库上重放旧问题。 end-to-end is not one metric let w be correct write probability, r the probability retrieval contains required evidence, a assembly fidelity, and u correct model use. a simplified diagnostic is p(success)=w·r·a·u . this is not a claim of statistical independence; it shows compounding. four layers at 0.95 yield about 0.814. improving retrieval from 0.99 may matter less than repairing model use at 0.80. measure safety separately forbidden leakage rate l=forbidden retrieved/forbidden opportunities commonly targets zero and cannot be averaged away by task accuracy. abstention precision measures how often an abstention truly lacked evidence; abstention recall measures how many cases requiring abstention were caught. optimizing recall alone makes an agent refuse too much, while precision alone encourages unsafe action under uncertainty. temporal splits for decision time t, permit only k(t)={r | transactiontime(r)≤t and validat(r,t)} . this prevents future updates from leaking and distinguishes “what was known then” from “what is known now.” every case records cutoff and index snapshot rather than replaying historical questions against the latest database. 对 agent 系统的影响 implications for agent systems 开发： memory 变更必须带 eval fixtures，就像数据库 migration 带兼容测试。改 embedding、chunking、summary prompt、acl filter 或 quota 都可能改变 evidence set，需 replay historical traces。 运营： dashboard 分层展示 write rejection、conflict、index lag、hard-filter leakage、required-evidence recall、context truncation、unsupported claim、abstention 与 deletion slo。总成功率只用于结果，不用于定位。 产品： 高风险回答展示来源时间和 conflict；unknown/manual review 是一等状态。用户可以查看、更正、删除 durable profile，但不能直接改 control-plane audit history。 成本： eval corpus、shadow traffic、trace retention 与人工 adjudication 昂贵。按风险分层：低风险 preference 可抽样，高风险 authorization/deletion 做全量 deterministic gate。成本目标不是少测，而是把强验证放在错误损失最高处。 development: memory changes ship with evaluation fixtures just as database migrations ship with compatibility tests. changing embeddings, chunking, summary prompts, acl filters, or quotas can alter evidence sets and requires replay of historical traces. operations: dashboards separate write rejection, conflicts, index lag, hard-filter leakage, required-evidence recall, context truncation, unsupported claims, abstention, and deletion slos. overall success measures outcomes but cannot diagnose. product: high-risk answers expose source time and conflicts. unknown and manual review are first-class states. users may inspect, correct, and delete durable profiles without rewriting control-plane audit history. cost: evaluation corpora, shadow traffic, trace retention, and human adjudication are expensive. stratify by risk: sample low-risk preferences, while authorization and deletion use exhaustive deterministic gates. the objective is not less testing but stronger evidence where failure loss is highest. 设计取舍与失败模式 trade-offs and failure modes 数据泄漏： 用最新 index 回答历史问题让指标虚高；冻结 cutoff/snapshot。 合成数据过净： 真实 memory 有迟到、重复、冲突、拼写和越权；fixture 必须保留脏边界。 只测 retrieval： 候选命中但模型不用仍失败；固定 evidence 单测 model-use。 只测 final answer： 无法归因且模型常识可猜中；保存 stage oracles 和 counterfactual。 llm-as-judge 循环： judge 可能共享偏见；高风险用 deterministic verifier/人工 adjudication，judge 只扩展覆盖。 线上点击率： 用户接受可能因懒惰，非正确；implicit signal 不作为 truth label。 平均数掩盖安全： 跨租户 leakage 即使罕见也不可被 accuracy 抵消；单列 zero-tolerance gates。 测试删除但不重建： 现有 index 无结果不证明未来 rebuild 不复活；必须 cold rebuild。 temporal leakage: answering historical questions with the latest index inflates metrics; freeze cutoff and snapshot. over-clean synthetic data: real memory contains late, duplicate, conflicting, misspelled, and unauthorized records; fixtures preserve dirty boundaries. retrieval-only testing: candidate hits do not matter if the model ignores them. test model use with fixed evidence. final-answer-only testing: it cannot attribute failure, and common sense can guess answers. keep stage oracles and counterfactuals. llm-judge loop: judges share biases. use deterministic verifiers or human adjudication for high risk; judges expand coverage only. online click-through: user acceptance may reflect effort, not correctness. implicit signals are not truth labels. averages hide safety: rare cross-tenant leakage cannot be offset by accuracy. track zero-tolerance gates separately. deletion without rebuild: absence from a current index does not prove future rebuild will not resurrect data. perform a cold rebuild. 可复用的技术判断 reusable technical judgments memory eval 的单位是带 timeline、principal、policy、evidence oracle 与 expected action 的 case。 局部测 extraction/admission/retrieval/assembly/model-use/lifecycle，端到端测组合行动。 temporal cutoff、counterfactual pair 与 forbidden set 防止泄漏、猜中和安全平均化。 first divergence 比最终分数更可操作；每层必须留下可 replay trace。 shadow/canary/rollback 与 deletion cold rebuild 是生产 guardrail，不是离线 benchmark 的附属品。 a memory-evaluation case includes timeline, principal, policy, evidence oracle, and expected action. test extraction, admission, retrieval, assembly, model use, and lifecycle locally; test composed action end to end. temporal cutoffs, counterfactual pairs, and forbidden sets prevent leakage, guessing, and safety averaging. first divergence is more actionable than final score; every layer leaves a replayable trace. shadow, canary, rollback, and deletion cold rebuild are production guardrails, not benchmark accessories. 一手资料 primary sources longmemeval — 长期 memory 的 extraction、multi-session、temporal、update、abstention benchmark。 ragas — rag evaluation 的作者框架与实验。 ares — 自动化 rag evaluation 的作者方法与报告结果。 freshllms — freshness-aware qa 与时间变化评测。 nist privacy framework — 隐私风险和数据生命周期框架。 rfc 9110 — cache validation/invalidation 语义背景。 分层 oracle、first-divergence、deletion cold rebuild 与生产检查表是本文综合设计；论文指标与作者报告结果不自动等于生产保证。 longmemeval — a benchmark for extraction, multi-session and temporal reasoning, updates, and abstention. ragas — an author framework and experiments for rag evaluation. ares — an author method with reported results for automated rag evaluation. freshllms — freshness-aware question answering and evaluation under changing information. nist privacy framework — a privacy-risk and data-lifecycle framework. rfc 9110 — background for cache validation and invalidation semantics. layered oracles, first-divergence analysis, deletion cold rebuild, and the production checklist are editorial synthesis. paper metrics and author-reported results do not automatically establish production guarantees. 本系列收束与下一条主线 series synthesis and next track 今天已完成： memory eval 用 temporal world、stage oracles、counterfactual、forbidden evidence、downstream action 与 deletion rebuild 验证完整 pipeline；first-divergence 归因失败，shadow/canary/rollback 控制线上风险。 四篇合起来： context 是临时 view；history/state/index/record 分层；compression 是可回源 cache；retrieval 以 admission、authority、time 和 lifecycle 管理；evaluation 证明组合后的 agent 在该用、该停和该忘时都正确。 本系列状态： context 与 memory 系统 4/4 已完成。下一条系统主线进入 tools & extensibility，从“schema 如何决定模型可表达的动作空间”开始，深挖 tool contracts、mcp、skills/plugins 的发现、权限与组合边界。 completed today: memory evaluation validates the pipeline with temporal worlds, stage oracles, counterfactuals, forbidden evidence, downstream actions, and deletion rebuilds. first divergence attributes failure; shadow, canary, and rollback control online risk. across four parts: context is a temporary view; history, state, index, and records are separate; compression is a source-reversible cache; retrieval manages admission, authority, time, and lifecycle; evaluation proves the composed agent uses, stops, and forgets correctly. series status: context and memory systems 4/4 is complete. the next systematic track is tools and extensibility, beginning with how schemas determine the model's action space and then examining tool contracts, mcp, skills and plugins, discovery, authorization, and composition boundaries.

title.zh: “最相似”为什么经常不是“最该记、最该用”？
title.en: Why Is “Most Similar” Often Not the Right Memory?

text: “最相似”为什么经常不是“最该记、最该用”？ why is “most similar” often not the right memory? context 与 memory 系统 context and memory systems memory retrieval hybrid search consolidation supersession forgetting 今日命题 today's proposition 向量数据库回答“哪些表示在 embedding space 中靠近”，不回答“哪些事实对当前任务最权威、仍有效且允许这个 principal 使用”。过期偏好可能比最新政策更相似；另一租户案例可能语义完美；模型自己的旧猜测可能因重复写入占据多个近邻。把 top-k 直接塞进 prompt，会把相似度伪装成真值。 可靠 memory system 同时控制写与读。写入时，只有有复用价值、可归因、可授权且通过冲突检查的 candidate 才成为 durable record。读取时，hybrid retrieval 先召回，再按 tenant、subject、time、authority、scope 与 task utility 过滤排序。记录还能被 supersede、合并、降权、过期和删除，index 只是可重建投影。 核心判断： memory 是带生命周期的 evidence system，不是无限 append 的向量集合。最相似只是一项召回信号；最终使用权来自 provenance、有效时间、authority、scope 和当前 decision contract。 a vector database answers which representations are nearby in embedding space, not which facts are authoritative for this task, still valid, and accessible to this principal. an obsolete preference may be more similar than current policy. another tenant's example may be semantically perfect. a model's old guess may occupy several neighbors after repeated writes. feeding top-k directly into a prompt turns similarity into counterfeit truth. a reliable memory system controls both writes and reads. on write, only candidates with reuse value, attribution, authorization, and conflict handling become durable records. on read, hybrid retrieval generates candidates and then filters and ranks by tenant, subject, time, authority, scope, and task utility. records can also be superseded, consolidated, decayed, expired, and deleted; an index is merely a rebuildable projection. core judgment: memory is lifecycle-managed evidence, not an endlessly appended vector collection. similarity is one recall signal. permission to use a record comes from provenance, valid time, authority, scope, and the current decision contract. 承接压缩：summary 导航，record 承担事实 from compression to record lifecycle 2/4 把 raw history 定义为事实层、summary 定义为可重算导航 cache。summary node 可以参与召回，但若决策需要当前预算、批准范围或最新偏好，assembler 必须沿 source refs 找 durable record 或 authoritative system，不能把摘要措辞当最终值。 consolidation 也不是把十条记录压成一段后删除原记录。它创建新的 derived record，声明 inputs、规则、时间窗、sample size 与 confidence；输入仍由 retention policy 管理。supersession 表示新记录在特定 scope/time 取代旧记录，不表示旧记录从未存在。agent 因而能回答“现在是什么”和“为什么改变”。 part 2 defined raw history as the fact layer and summaries as recomputable navigation caches. a summary node may generate candidates, but when a decision needs the current budget, approved scope, or latest preference, the assembler follows source references to a durable record or authoritative system. summary wording is not the final value. consolidation does not mean turning ten records into prose and deleting the originals. it creates a derived record declaring inputs, rule, time window, sample size, and confidence; input retention remains policy-controlled. supersession means a newer record replaces an older one within a scope and time, not that the old record never existed. the agent can answer both “what is true now?” and “why did it change?” 机制：从 candidate 到可遗忘 record mechanism: from candidate to forgettable record 1. candidate extraction user statement、tool result、episode summary 只产生 candidate。schema 包含 subject、predicate、value、scope、eventtime、sourceref/type、confidence、sensitivity 与 retention。抽取模型不得填缺失字段；“用户可能偏好简短”标 inference，明确说法标 assertion。 2. admission 判断未来是否复用、属于事实/偏好/procedure/episode pointer 还是 working state，再做 acl、pii/secret、tenant、schema、authority 与重复检查。临时 tool error 留在 execution；高风险身份/财务事实需 authoritative source 或人工确认。 3. conflict-aware upsert 查相同 subject/predicate/scope 的 active versions，比较 authority、specificity 与 valid time。明确更新则旧版写 validto 和 supersedes edge；不可判定则建立 conflict set，不按相似度覆盖。append-only versions 支持审计与 time travel。 4. 多 index projection canonical typed store 承载 records；bm25 处理精确词、id、数字、rare term；vector 处理语义改写；metadata 处理 tenant/subject/time/type/acl；graph 表达 entity、supports、contradicts、supersedes。每个 entry 保留 recordid/version，不成为独立 truth。 5. query decomposition assembler 从 decision contract 生成 lexical terms、semantic query、filters、relation 与 time point。retrievers 并行返回 ids 和 raw scores。bm25、cosine、graph distance 量纲不同，先用 rank fusion 合并，再 calibrated rerank。 6. hard gates 任何 learned ranking 前移除越权 tenant/acl、错误 subject、无效 interval、tombstone、schema incompatible 与禁止用途。查询历史决定使用 event time；询问现在如何行动只取 current active version。敏感候选不能先交模型再要求忽略。 7. utility reranking 特征包括 relevance、lexical match、authority、scope specificity、freshness、task type、conflict coverage、novelty 与 cost。高风险任务强制纳入 authoritative constraints/conflict set；低风险 brainstorming 可提高 diversity。evidence block 提供 source/type/time/confidence。 8. consolidation 与 decay 重复 episodes 可产生 derived pattern，但保存 supporting ids、sample size、rule、exceptions。decay 只降低 episodic record 默认权重，不修改事实；policy/consent 用 explicit expiry。访问频次不是 truth，模型反复自引不能提高 authority。 9. tombstone 与传播 删除先写 canonical tombstone/version，再通过 lineage queue 删除或屏蔽 bm25 posting、vector、graph edge、summary、cache 和 backup lifecycle。传播期间 query 层以 tombstone set 即时 deny。删除完成需 coverage evidence。 10. observability write 保存 admission decision/reason；read 保存 query plan、各路 candidates、filter reasons、fusion/rerank scores 与 citations。错误才能定位到 extraction、admission、index lag、filter、ranking 或 model use。 11. authority lattice 与 scope resolution authority 不能简化成全局数字。组织 policy 在合规约束上高于个人偏好，但项目 owner 对该项目目标可能比全局 profile 更具体；用户对自己的偏好有 authority，却不能覆盖系统安全规则。record 保存 authoritydomain、issuerrole、scope selector 与 purpose。resolution 先找适用 scope，再在同一 domain 比 authority/time；不同 domain 若不可比较就保留 conflict，让 decision policy 决定是否 abstain。这样可以避免一个“高分”把结构化治理关系压平。 12. bitemporal query 长期 memory 常需同时记录 valid time（事实在现实世界何时成立）与 transaction time（系统何时知道并写入）。用户周一改地址、周三系统才同步：查询“周二寄到哪里”按 valid time，审计“周二 agent 当时知道什么”按 transaction time。只存 createdat 会把迟到事件误当最新事实，也无法公平 replay 当时决策。supersession 因而更新 interval，不原地覆盖旧 value。 13. negative evidence 与 abstention “没有召回记录”不等于“事实不存在”。retrieval miss 可能来自索引延迟、权限过滤、错误 query 或 source 尚未接入。decision contract 应声明何时需要 completeness guarantee：例如检查是否已付款要查询 authoritative payment ledger，不能用向量库无结果推断未付款。若系统只有非完备 memory，它应返回 unknown 并说明检查范围。abstention 是正确输出，不是召回失败后的语言模型兜底。 1. candidate extraction user statements, tool results, and episode summaries create candidates only. the schema includes subject, predicate, value, scope, event time, source reference and type, confidence, sensitivity, and retention. extraction cannot fill missing fields. “the user may prefer brevity” is inference; an explicit statement is assertion. 2. admission decide whether future tasks will reuse it and whether it is fact, preference, procedure, episode pointer, or working state. then check acl, pii and secrets, tenant, schema, authority, and duplicates. a transient tool error stays local. high-risk identity or financial facts require an authoritative source or human confirmation. 3. conflict-aware upsert find active versions with the same subject, predicate, and scope, then compare authority, specificity, and valid time. an explicit update closes the old valid interval and adds a supersedes edge. if sources cannot be ordered, create a conflict set rather than overwriting by similarity. append-only versions support audit and time travel. 4. several index projections the canonical typed store owns records. bm25 handles exact words, ids, numbers, and rare terms. vectors handle paraphrase. metadata handles tenant, subject, time, type, and acl. a graph represents entities, supports, contradicts, and supersedes. every entry carries record id and version; no projection becomes independent truth. 5. query decomposition from the decision contract, the assembler produces lexical terms, semantic query, filters, relation, and time point. retrievers return ids and raw scores in parallel. bm25, cosine, and graph distance have incompatible scales, so rank fusion combines lists before calibrated reranking. 6. hard gates before learned ranking, remove unauthorized tenants and acls, wrong subjects, invalid intervals, tombstones, incompatible schemas, and prohibited purposes. historical questions use event time; “what should we do now?” uses current active versions. sensitive candidates cannot cross the model boundary and then be ignored. 7. utility reranking features include relevance, lexical match, authority, scope specificity, freshness, task type, conflict coverage, novelty, and cost. high-risk tasks force authoritative constraints and conflict sets into evidence. low-risk brainstorming may reward diversity. evidence blocks expose source, type, time, and confidence. 8. consolidation and decay repeated episodes may create a derived pattern, but it retains supporting ids, sample size, rule, and exceptions. decay only lowers the default weight of episodic records; it does not alter truth. policy and consent use explicit expiry. access frequency is not truth, and repeated model self-citation cannot raise authority. 9. tombstones and propagation deletion first writes a canonical tombstone or version. a lineage queue removes or blocks bm25 postings, vectors, graph edges, summaries, caches, and backup lifecycle copies. during propagation, a query-time tombstone set denies access immediately. completion requires evidence of derivative coverage. 10. observability writes retain admission decisions and reasons. reads retain query plans, candidates from every path, filter reasons, fusion and reranking scores, and citations. failures can be assigned to extraction, admission, index lag, filtering, ranking, or model use. 11. authority lattices and scope resolution authority cannot be reduced to one global number. organizational policy outranks personal preference for compliance constraints, while a project owner may be more specific about that project's goal than a global profile. users are authoritative about their preferences but cannot override system safety rules. a record stores authority domain, issuer role, scope selector, and permitted purpose. resolution first selects applicable scope, then compares authority and time within a domain. if domains are incomparable, retain the conflict and let decision policy require abstention or review. a single high score must not flatten governance relationships. 12. bitemporal queries long-term memory often needs both valid time, when a fact held in the world, and transaction time, when the system learned and recorded it. if a user changed address monday but synchronization occurred wednesday, “where should a tuesday shipment go?” uses valid time, while “what did the agent know on tuesday?” uses transaction time. storing only createdat makes late events look like new facts and prevents fair replay of the historical decision. supersession therefore updates intervals rather than overwriting the old value in place. 13. negative evidence and abstention “no record retrieved” does not mean the fact is false. a miss may result from index lag, authorization filtering, a malformed query, or a source that was never connected. the decision contract states when a completeness guarantee is required. for example, checking whether a payment occurred must query the authoritative payment ledger; absence from vector memory cannot prove nonpayment. if only non-exhaustive memory is available, the result is unknown with an explicit statement of searched scope. abstention is therefore a correct system output, not a language-model fallback after weak retrieval. the evidence block can distinguish found, not found in an exhaustive authoritative source, and not observed in a partial index. these three states drive different actions. tests should include adversarial absence cases because fluent agents otherwise convert “i did not retrieve it” into “it never happened,” creating exactly the sort of false certainty that durable memory was intended to prevent. 必要数学：融合、时效与多目标 utility essential mathematics: fusion, freshness, and utility rank fusion 对 retriever 集合 r ，候选 d 可用 rrf(d)=σᵣ1/(k+rankᵣ(d)) 。rank 是某路名次，k 降低第一名极端优势。它用名次而非不可比 raw scores 合并 bm25/vector/graph，但不包含 acl 或 authority，只能在 hard gate 后使用。 时效衰减 对允许 decay 的 episodic record，可设 f(δt)=e −λδt ，半衰期 t₁/₂=ln2/λ 。这是 ranking feature，不是删除。policy、consent、价格按 validto/explicit expiry，不能套统一指数。 utility u=wᵣr+wₐa+wₛs+w_ff+w_cc−w_dd ：相关性 r、authority a、scope s、freshness f、conflict coverage c、duplication/cost d。权重按 task class 校准且受 hard constraints 限制。意义不是万能分数，而是防止 cosine 成为唯一目标，并支持 ablation。 rank fusion for retrievers r , score candidate d with rrf(d)=σᵣ1/(k+rankᵣ(d)) . rank is position in one list, and k reduces domination by the first item. rankings combine incomparable bm25, vector, and graph raw scores. rrf knows nothing about acl or authority and runs only after hard gates. freshness decay for episodic records eligible for decay, use f(δt)=e −λδt , with half-life t₁/₂=ln2/λ . this is a ranking feature, not deletion. policy, consent, and price use validto or explicit expiry rather than one exponential curve. utility u=wᵣr+wₐa+wₛs+w_ff+w_cc−w_dd : relevance r, authority a, scope s, freshness f, conflict coverage c, and duplication or cost d. weights are calibrated per task class and remain constrained by hard gates. the formula prevents cosine from becoming the sole objective and supports feature ablation. 对 agent 系统的影响 implications for agent systems 能力： agent 可记稳定偏好，同时让 project-specific instruction 临时覆盖；既回答当前事实，又沿 versions 解释变化。hybrid retrieval 让 id、数字、稀有术语与语义类比各走合适路径。 可靠性： 冲突不再被 top-1 隐藏，旧记录不会因相似而复活。authority/scope 成为 schema 后，模型只在 evidence 内推理，不负责发明来源优先级。 安全： acl、tenant、purpose、tombstone 在 model boundary 前执行。删除传播成为有 completion evidence 的 workflow，敏感数据不会从残留 vector/cache 再出现。 成本： 多 index、reranker、version history、lineage queue 增加写放大。按 query class 选路径：current-state lookup 不需 embedding/reranker，开放研究才多路召回。分别监控 write acceptance、index lag、recall、filter precision、citation use、deletion lag。 一致性与 slo： canonical commit 与各 index projection 无法总在一个事务内完成。write path 应产生 monotonically increasing recordversion/outbox event；indexer 幂等消费，query 返回 indexedversion，并以 canonical/tombstone filter 拒绝过期结果。分别定义 index freshness slo、tombstone deny latency 和 full deletion completion slo。用户安全取决于即时 deny，运营完整性取决于最终清理，两者不能混成一个“删除成功”指标。 在线降级： vector service 不可用时可退化到 metadata+bm25，但要暴露 retrieval mode；authority store 或 acl service 不可用时则 fail closed，不能为了可用性跳过 hard gate。reranker timeout 可使用 fusion order，同时降低 confidence 并禁止高风险自动行动。可靠 memory 的降级策略按组件语义区分，而不是统一 catch 后继续。 capability: an agent
