retains a stable preference while a project-specific instruction overrides it temporarily. it answers current facts and explains change through versions. hybrid retrieval assigns ids, numbers, rare terms, and semantic analogy to suitable paths. reliability: conflicts are not hidden by top-1, and obsolete records do not revive merely because they are similar. once authority and scope are schema, the model reasons over evidence instead of inventing source priority. security: acl, tenant, purpose, and tombstone checks run before the model boundary. deletion propagation becomes a workflow with completion evidence; sensitive data cannot reappear from surviving vector or cache projections. cost: multiple indexes, reranking, version history, and lineage queues increase write amplification. query classes choose paths: current-state lookup needs no embedding reranker, while open research may justify parallel recall. monitor write acceptance, index lag, recall, filter precision, citation use, and deletion lag separately. consistency and slos: canonical commit and every index projection rarely fit one transaction. the write path emits a monotonically increasing record version and outbox event. indexers consume idempotently; queries return indexed version and use canonical or tombstone filters to reject stale results. define index-freshness slo, tombstone-deny latency, and full-deletion-completion slo separately. user safety depends on immediate deny, while operational completeness depends on eventual physical cleanup; one “delete succeeded” metric cannot represent both. online degradation: if vector search is unavailable, the system may degrade to metadata plus bm25 while exposing retrieval mode. if the authority store or acl service is unavailable, it fails closed rather than skipping a hard gate for availability. a reranker timeout may fall back to fusion order, but confidence drops and high-risk automatic action is prohibited. reliable memory degrades according to component semantics rather than applying one catch-and-continue rule. 设计取舍与失败模式 trade-offs and failure modes 过度写入： 每轮输出入库造成 duplication/self-contamination；默认 candidate，不默认 durable。 只用 vector： id、数字、否定、时间、rare term 脆弱；保留 lexical/structured paths。 过滤太晚： 先召回敏感正文再要求 llm 忽略已经越界；acl/purpose 下推 query 层。 last-write-wins： 新聊天覆盖正式 policy；用 authority/scope/time 和 conflict set。 consolidation 伪规律： 小样本重复变普遍偏好；记录 sample、exceptions、derived status。 decay 等于遗忘： 降 rank 不是删除；删除需 tombstone 与传播验证。 index lag： canonical 更新而 vector 旧；version/tombstone filter 阻断并监控 lag。 反馈回路： 召回越多越提升 importance；访问频率与 authority 分离并做 diversity cap。 over-writing: persisting every turn creates duplication and self-contamination. default to candidate, not durable record. vector only: ids, numbers, negation, time, and rare terms are brittle. retain lexical and structured paths. filtering too late: retrieving sensitive text and asking an llm to ignore it already crosses the boundary. push acl and purpose into query execution. last write wins: casual chat replaces formal policy. use authority, scope, time, and conflict sets. false consolidation: a small repeated sample becomes universal preference. store sample size, exceptions, and derived status. decay equals forgetting: lower rank is not deletion. deletion requires tombstones and verified propagation. index lag: canonical data changes while vectors remain stale. block with version and tombstone filters and monitor lag. feedback loop: frequent retrieval raises importance. separate access frequency from authority and cap duplicates. 可复用的技术判断 reusable technical judgments 抽取结果先是 candidate；admission 决定持久性、scope、authority、retention。 canonical typed record 承担事实，bm25/vector/graph/cache 是可重建 projection。 先 hard-filter tenant/acl/time/tombstone，再 fusion/rerank；相似度不覆盖权限。 consolidation 创建 derived record；supersession 保留历史；decay 降权不删除。 forgetting 是 tombstone、即时 deny、传播和 coverage verification 的 workflow。 extraction produces a candidate. admission decides durability, scope, authority, and retention. canonical typed records carry facts; bm25, vector, graph, and cache structures are rebuildable projections. hard-filter tenant, acl, time, and tombstones before fusion and reranking. similarity cannot override permission. consolidation creates derived records; supersession preserves history; decay lowers weight without deleting. forgetting is a workflow of tombstone, immediate deny, propagation, and coverage verification. 一手资料 primary sources lewis et al., rag — dense external index 原始工作。 park et al., generative agents — memory stream、recency/importance/relevance 与 reflection。 wu et al., longmemeval — extraction、temporal、update、abstention benchmark。 rfc 9110 — cache validators/invalidation 规范背景；本文仅类比 projections。 nist privacy framework — 数据处理和隐私风险生命周期框架。 candidate schema、conflict set、multi-index projection、tombstone deny set 与 deletion coverage 是本文编辑性综合。 lewis et al., rag — original work combining generation with a dense external index. park et al., generative agents — an author system using memory streams, recency, importance, relevance, and reflection. wu et al., longmemeval — a benchmark for extraction, temporal reasoning, updates, and abstention. rfc 9110 — cache validator and invalidation background; projections are only an analogy here. nist privacy framework — a framework for data-processing and privacy-risk lifecycles. the candidate schema, conflict sets, multi-index projections, tombstone deny sets, and deletion coverage are editorial synthesis. 已建立与下一篇起点 what is established and where we continue 今天已建立： candidate 经 admission 成为 canonical versioned record；bm25/vector/metadata/graph 只是 projections。读取先做 acl/time/tombstone gates，再融合并暴露 conflict。consolidation、supersession、decay、deletion 分别处理归纳、更新、降权和遗忘。 尚未讲完： 如何证明 memory 让 agent 更好，而不是只让 demo 更像“记得”？需要怎样的 temporal split、counterfactual、conflict、privacy 与 downstream task eval？ 下一篇： 4/4 完成本系列：端到端 memory eval、failure attribution、online guardrails 与生产架构检查表。 established today: a candidate becomes a canonical versioned record through admission; bm25, vector, metadata, and graph structures are projections. reads apply acl, time, and tombstone gates before fusion and conflict exposure. consolidation, supersession, decay, and deletion separately handle generalization, update, downweighting, and forgetting. still unresolved: how do we prove that memory improves the agent rather than making a demo appear to remember? what temporal splits, counterfactuals, conflicts, privacy checks, and downstream-task evaluations are required? next: part 4 completes the series with end-to-end memory evaluation, failure attribution, online guardrails, and a production architecture checklist.

title.zh: 摘要会撒谎：Agent 如何安全压缩长历史？
title.en: Summaries Lie: How Can an Agent Compress Long History Safely?

text: 摘要会撒谎：agent 如何安全压缩长历史？ summaries lie: how can an agent compress long history safely? context 与 memory 系统 context and memory systems context compression summarization state abstraction provenance error budget 今日命题 today's proposition 长运行 agent 必须压缩历史，但任何摘要都是 lossy transform。它会选择什么重要、合并相似事件、删除重复细节，并用新措辞重写原文。危险不在于它偶尔少一句，而在于摘要常被下一轮模型当成事实：一次遗漏的否定词、过期约束或未决副作用，会在后续反复 summary-of-summary 中变成稳定但错误的 working reality。 安全设计不能要求摘要“绝不出错”。它要把不可丢的 control state 从自由文本中抽离，让摘要只服务检索与推理；每个 summary 声明覆盖的 event range、生成器版本、source references 与已知 omissions；遇到高风险决策、冲突或低 confidence 时，runtime 回到原始 event/artifact 重建，而不是继续相信压缩文本。 核心判断： compression 的 correctness contract 不是“读起来像原对话”，而是：invariants 保真、provenance 可追、信息损失可度量、派生视图可丢弃重算。原始 history 是事实层；summary 是有版本的 cache。 a long-running agent must compress history, but every summary is a lossy transform. it decides what matters, merges similar events, removes repetition, and rewrites source language. the danger is not merely omitting an occasional sentence. a summary is often treated as fact by the next model call: a dropped negation, expired constraint, or unresolved side effect can become stable but false working reality through repeated summaries of summaries. a safe design cannot require summaries never to fail. it removes non-negotiable control state from free text and uses summaries only for navigation and reasoning. each summary declares its event range, generator version, source references, and known omissions. high-risk decisions, conflicts, or low confidence cause the runtime to return to original events or artifacts and rebuild, rather than continuing to trust compressed prose. core judgment: the correctness contract for compression is not “sounds like the conversation.” invariants remain faithful, provenance remains traceable, information loss is measurable, and derived views are disposable and recomputable. raw history is the fact layer; a summary is a versioned cache. 承接四层边界：只压缩该压缩的层 continue the four-layer model: compress only the right layer 1/4 已把 event log、working state、retrieval index 与 durable records 分开。这个边界直接决定压缩方式：event log 可以归档、分段和索引，但不应被 summary 替换；working state 由 typed reducer 更新，不应让模型从摘要猜 open calls、deadline 或 approval；durable record 通过 supersession/versioning 演化；只有供模型消费的 transcript view 与导航性 memory 可以有损压缩。 因此“达到 80% context 后做一次摘要”太粗。它把 token pressure 当作唯一触发条件，却忽略语义边界：tool transaction 未完成、审批范围尚未确定、两份来源冲突时，恰恰不能把它们揉成一个顺畅段落。正确触发器还包括 episode 结束、state checkpoint、topic shift、artifact 完成和风险等级变化。 压缩也不是单方向删除。摘要首先是目录：告诉 assembler 哪个时间段发生了什么、哪些 source 需要在当前任务中展开。只要保留 source span 与 stable record id，系统就能按需 rehydrate 原文，把小 context window 与大持久历史连接起来。 part 1 separated the event log, working state, retrieval index, and durable records. that boundary directly determines compression. the event log may be archived, segmented, and indexed, but a summary does not replace it. typed reducers update working state; a model must not infer open calls, deadlines, or approval from prose. durable records evolve through versions and supersession. only the transcript view and navigational memory presented to the model should undergo lossy compression. therefore, “summarize when context reaches eighty percent” is too crude. it treats token pressure as the only trigger while ignoring semantic boundaries. an incomplete tool transaction, unsettled approval scope, or conflict between sources is exactly where a fluent paragraph must not merge distinctions. better triggers include episode completion, state checkpoint, topic shift, artifact completion, and a change in risk level. compression is not one-way deletion. a summary is first an index: it tells the assembler what happened during a time range and which source spans should be expanded for the present task. stable record ids and source spans let the system rehydrate originals on demand, connecting a small context window to a large durable history. 机制：三层压缩与可逆引用 mechanism: three compression layers with reversible references 可回源的三层 context compression 原始事件和 artifacts 是不可替代的事实层。typed working state 保存不变量，rolling summaries 覆盖近期 episodes，hierarchical summaries 提供长期目录。context assembler 可以沿引用重新展开原文。 raw events + artifacts lossless · addressable spans typed working state invariants · open work rolling summaries recent episodes · source refs hierarchical summaries long-range navigation tree context assembler select · rehydrate · label budget one model call llm context view ephemeral and replaceable 原创示意：向上压缩用于导航，向下 rehydrate 用于验证；working state 与原始事实不由自由文本摘要取代。 1. 先抽取 invariant lane 每次压缩前，runtime 从 typed state 读取必须精确保留的字段：goal、hard constraints、授权范围、open operations、unresolved outcomes、deadlines、accepted artifact ids、用户明确决定。这些字段由 schema/reducer 管理，summary 只能引用，不能改写。若摘要说“部署完成”而 state 仍是 verification_pending，assembler 必须以 state 为准并显式暴露矛盾。 2. 按 episode 建 rolling summary episode 是语义闭合单元，如一次调查、一个 tool transaction 或一轮审批。summary record 包含 summaryid、source event range、artifact refs、createdat、generator model/prompt version、covered facts、open questions、decisions、discarded categories 和 confidence。增量更新读取“旧 summary + 新 episode”，但隔若干轮必须从原 source 重建，阻断误差无限继承。 3. 构建 hierarchical summary tree 当 rolling summaries 仍太多时，按项目阶段或 topic 生成父节点。父摘要不复制全部子摘要，而是保存时间范围、主题、关键转折、active child pointers 与检索关键词。树允许 coarse-to-fine retrieval：先选相关阶段，再展开 episode，最后必要时读取 event/artifact。不同层使用独立版本，重算一个叶子只使祖先节点 stale，不改写源。 4. 定义 summary contract prompt 要求结构化输出而非一段漂亮散文：confirmed facts 必须带 refs；decisions 区分 proposed/approved/executed/verified；open loops 永不因“没有新消息”而消失；negative constraints 和数字原样引用；uncertainty 不能被补全。validator 检查所有 refs 落在 source range、关键 state 字段被提及、没有陌生 entity，并把失败摘要丢弃。 5. context assembly 选择摘要还是原文 低风险 continuation 可读 working state + 最新 rolling summary。涉及付款、权限、发布、法律措辞或冲突事实时，policy 强制 rehydrate 引用 span。若 summary confidence 低、source 已更新、父子摘要不一致或问题询问精确原话，assembler 也展开 source。summary 的 token savings 从不覆盖 risk policy。 6. 新信息到达时 invalidate 事件追加后，所有覆盖该 range 或引用被 supersede record 的 summary 标为 stale。后台可异步重算；在重算前，assembler 不得把 stale summary 当 active fact。对删除请求，先 tombstone 原记录，再使所有摘要、embedding 与 cache 派生项失效；不能只在下一次摘要中“忘掉”。 7. 保存 compression manifest manifest 记录每个 source span 去向：verbatim reserved、typed-state represented、summary represented、pointer only 或 intentionally dropped，并写 drop reason。它让离线评测能回答“关键事实在哪一层丢失”，也让事故调查知道当时模型究竟看到了摘要还是原文。 compress(events, state): invariants = projecttypedstate(state) episode = closesemanticunit(events) summary = summarizewithrefs(episode) if !validate(summary, episode, invariants): reject(summary) persist(summary, manifest, sourceversion) assemble(decision): nodes = retrievesummarytree(decision) return riskpolicy.requiressource(decision, nodes) ? rehydrate(nodes.sourcerefs) : nodes three compression layers with source recovery raw events and artifacts are the irreplaceable fact layer. typed working state preserves invariants, rolling summaries cover recent episodes, and hierarchical summaries provide long-range navigation. the assembler can follow references back to source. raw events + artifacts lossless · addressable spans typed working state invariants · open work rolling summaries recent episodes · source refs hierarchical summaries long-range navigation tree context assembler select · rehydrate · label budget one model call llm context view ephemeral and replaceable original diagram: compression supports navigation upward and rehydration supports verification downward. free-text summaries replace neither typed state nor raw facts. 1. extract an invariant lane first before compression, the runtime reads fields that require exact preservation from typed state: goal, hard constraints, authorization scope, open operations, unresolved outcomes, deadlines, accepted artifact ids, and explicit user decisions. schemas and reducers own these fields. a summary may reference them but cannot rewrite them. if prose says deployment completed while state remains verification pending, the assembler follows state and exposes the conflict. 2. build rolling summaries by episode an episode is a semantically closed unit such as an investigation, tool transaction, or approval round. its summary record contains an id, source event range, artifact references, creation time, generator model and prompt version, covered facts, open questions, decisions, discarded categories, and confidence. incremental updates may read an old summary plus a new episode, but periodic reconstruction from source prevents inherited error from growing without bound. 3. build a hierarchical summary tree when rolling summaries become numerous, create parent nodes by project phase or topic. a parent does not copy every child; it stores time range, themes, pivotal changes, active child pointers, and retrieval terms. the tree enables coarse-to-fine retrieval: choose a phase, expand an episode, and finally read an event or artifact when needed. layers version independently. recomputing a leaf marks ancestors stale but never rewrites source. 4. define a summary contract request structured output rather than elegant prose. confirmed facts carry references. decisions distinguish proposed, approved, executed, and verified. open loops never disappear merely because no new event mentioned them. negative constraints and numbers remain verbatim. uncertainty is not filled in. a validator checks that references belong to the source range, critical state fields appear, and no unknown entity was invented; failed summaries are discarded. 5. choose summary or source during assembly a low-risk continuation may use working state plus the latest rolling summary. payments, permissions, releases, legal text, and conflicting facts trigger policy-mandated rehydration. the assembler also expands source when confidence is low, a source changed, parent and child disagree, or the question asks for exact wording. token savings from a summary never override risk policy. 6. invalidate when new information arrives after an event append, summaries covering that range or referencing a superseded record become stale. background work may recompute them asynchronously; until then, the assembler cannot treat them as active fact. a deletion request first tombstones source, then invalidates summaries, embeddings, and cache derivatives. merely omitting the item from the next summary is not deletion. 7. persist a compression manifest the manifest records the disposition of every source span: reserved verbatim, represented in typed state, represented by summary, retained as pointer only, or intentionally dropped with a reason. offline evaluation can locate the layer where a decisive fact disappeared. incident review can also determine whether the model saw source, a summary, or neither. compress(events, state): invariants = projecttypedstate(state) episode = closesemanticunit(events) summary = summarizewithrefs(episode) if !validate(summary, episode, invariants): reject(summary) persist(summary, manifest, sourceversion) assemble(decision): nodes = retrievesummarytree(decision) return riskpolicy.requiressource(decision, nodes) ? rehydrate(nodes.sourcerefs) : nodes 必要数学：压缩率、误差预算与重建成本 essential mathematics: compression ratio, error budget, and rebuild cost 压缩率不是单独目标 设 source 长度为 l tokens，summary 长度为 l ，则压缩率 ρ=l/l 。ρ=20 表示 20:1，但不说明保留了什么。对一组 required invariants i ，定义加权保真度 f=σwᵢ·preserved(i)/σwᵢ ；authorization、未决副作用等高风险项的权重远高于寒暄。工程目标是满足 f 的阈值后最大化 ρ，而不是先追求最短摘要。 递归摘要的误差会复合 若每一层对某关键事实的独立保留概率为 q ，经过 k 次 summary-of-summary 后保留概率理想化为 qᵏ 。即使 q=0.98，10 层后也只有约 0.817。现实错误还相关，可能更差。这个公式不是模型质量估计，而是说明为何必须限制递归深度、周期性从 source rebuild，并让 invariant 绕过有损链路。 何时值得 rehydrate 设展开 source 的额外 token/latency 成本为 cᵣ ，不展开导致错误的概率为 pₑ ，错误业务损失为 lₑ ，则当 pₑ·lₑ cᵣ 时应展开。虽然单位通常需货币化或归一化，这个期望损失框架解释了为何同一摘要在闲聊中可接受，在付款或权限变更前却必须回源。 compression ratio is not the sole objective let source length be l tokens and summary length be l . the compression ratio is ρ=l/l . a ratio of twenty means twenty-to-one, but says nothing about what survived. for required invariants i , define weighted fidelity as f=σwᵢ·preserved(i)/σwᵢ . authorization and unresolved effects receive much higher weights than greetings. the engineering objective is to maximize ρ only after meeting a fidelity threshold, not to minimize prose first. recursive summarization compounds error if each layer independently preserves a critical fact with probability q , then after k summary-of-summary layers the idealized survival probability is qᵏ . even q=0.98 yields only about 0.817 after ten layers. real errors are correlated and may be worse. this is not an estimate of a particular model; it demonstrates why systems limit recursion depth, periodically rebuild from source, and route invariants around the lossy chain. when is rehydration worth its cost? let the extra token and latency cost of source expansion be cᵣ , the probability of error without expansion be pₑ , and business loss from error be lₑ . rehydrate when pₑ·lₑ cᵣ . units must be monetized or normalized in practice, but the expected-loss frame explains why one summary can be acceptable for casual conversation and unacceptable before a payment or permission change. 对 agent 系统的影响 implications for agent systems context latency 变成可控曲线 rolling summary 把每步输入从随总历史线性增长，变成由 working state、recent window 和少量 summary nodes 决定。稳定 prefix 还提高 prompt/kv cache 命中。但后台 summarization、validation 与 rehydration 会增加异步工作量；系统应分别记录 source tokens、summary tokens、rehydrated tokens、cache hit 与 time-to-first-token。 状态正确性不依赖语言模型文风 open calls、deadline、approval 和 artifact digest 位于 typed lane 后，换 summarizer 或改变语言不会改变控制状态。摘要可以更短、更适合特定模型，却不能把 proposed 变成 approved。这个边界也使模型迁移更安全：新模型只重建派生 summary，不迁移事实。 审计从“看 prompt”升级为 lineage 一次错误决定可以沿 context manifest 追到 summary node，再追到 source span 和 generator version。团队可以问：事实根本没被召回，还是被压缩丢失？摘要包含了它，还是 serialization 截断？模型看到后仍误用？这些是不同 defect owner 与修复路径。 用户可控的遗忘成为可能 当 summary 被视作 derived cache，删除源记录就能通过 lineage 找到所有派生节点并 invalidate。若摘要是唯一保存层，系统反而无法证明敏感信息是否已被彻底移除，也无法在删除非敏感片段后准确重算剩余内容。 context latency becomes a controlled curve rolling summaries change per-step input from linear growth with total history to a function of working state, a recent window, and a few summary nodes. a stable prefix also improves prompt or kv-cache reuse. background summarization, validation, and rehydration add asynchronous work, so systems should separately record source tokens, summary tokens, rehydrated tokens, cache hits, and time to first token. state correctness no longer depends on model prose with open calls, deadlines, approvals, and artifact digests in a typed lane, changing summarizers or languages does not alter control state. a summary may become shorter or better suited to a model, but it cannot turn proposed into approved. model migration is safer because a new model rebuilds derived summaries rather than migrating facts. audit becomes lineage rather than prompt inspection a wrong decision can be traced through the context manifest to a summary node, then to source spans and generator version. a team can ask whether the fact was never retrieved, lost during compression, present in the summary but truncated during serialization, or visible to the model and misused. these defects belong to different owners and require different repairs. user-controlled forgetting becomes possible when a summary is a derived cache, deleting a source record can follow lineage to every derived node and invalidate it. if the summary is the only retained layer, the system cannot prove whether sensitive data was fully removed, nor accurately recompute remaining content after deleting one portion. 设计取舍与失败模式 trade-offs and failure modes rolling summary drift： 每次只读旧摘要会把早期误差永久化；定期 source rebuild，并设最大 generation depth。 漂亮但不保真： 流畅段落会消除 proposed/verified、before/after、not/now 等差异；结构化字段和引用验证优先于可读性。 切分边界错误： 在 tool call 与 result 之间关闭 episode，会留下半个因果链；episode closure 由状态机事件而非固定 token 数决定。 摘要成为 prompt injection 放大器： summarizer 可能把外部恶意指令重写成无来源建议；输出必须保持 trust label，且摘要不能产生 instruction authority。 父节点过期： 叶子更新而祖先仍 active，会召回旧结论；用 dependency version 或 merkle-like child digest 标 stale。 原文永不删除： 可回源不等于无限保留。retention、legal hold、用户删除与加密策略作用在 source 层，摘要随 lineage 失效。 validation 自证： 用同一模型“总结后再问是否正确”相关性过高；关键 invariant 用 deterministic checks，事实一致性可用不同模型或抽样人工复核。 只测 rouge： 词面重合不等于 agent correctness；应测试 open-loop retention、constraint fidelity、temporal ordering、source attribution 与 downstream decision。 rolling-summary drift: reading only the previous summary makes early errors durable. periodically rebuild from source and cap generation depth. fluent but unfaithful: smooth prose erases proposed versus verified, before versus after, and not versus now. structured fields and reference validation outrank readability. wrong segmentation: closing an episode between a tool call and its result leaves half a causal chain. state-machine events, not fixed token counts, determine episode closure. summary amplifies prompt injection: a summarizer may rewrite hostile external instructions as unattributed advice. preserve trust labels; a summary never acquires instruction authority. stale parents: a leaf changes while its ancestor remains active and retrieves an obsolete conclusion. dependency versions or merkle-like child digests mark parents stale. source retained forever: reversibility does not mean infinite retention. retention, legal hold, user deletion, and encryption operate on source; summaries invalidate through lineage. self-validating summaries: asking the same model whether its summary is correct creates correlated errors. check invariants deterministically and use another model or sampled human review for factual consistency. rouge-only evaluation: lexical overlap is not agent correctness. test open-loop retention, constraint fidelity, temporal order, source attribution, and downstream decisions. 可复用的技术判断 reusable technical judgments raw history 是可回放事实层，summary 是可丢弃重算的派生 cache；两者不能互换。 hard constraints、授权、open effects 与 deadline 进入 typed invariant lane，绕过有损摘要。 rolling summary 按语义 episode 更新；hierarchical summary 用于导航，必要时沿 source refs rehydrate。 摘要必须携带覆盖范围、generator version、source refs、confidence 和 omissions，并在源更新/删除时 invalidate。 压缩质量不是最短文本或 rouge，而是 invariant fidelity、lineage、downstream decision 与受风险控制的 token savings。 raw history is the replayable fact layer; a summary is a disposable, recomputable derived cache. they are not interchangeable. hard constraints, authorization, open effects, and deadlines enter a typed invariant lane that bypasses lossy summarization. rolling summaries update at semantic episode boundaries. hierarchical summaries navigate; source references rehydrate detail when required. a summary carries coverage, generator version, source references, confidence, and omissions, and becomes invalid when source changes or is deleted. compression quality is not shortest text or rouge. it is invariant fidelity, lineage, downstream decisions, and risk-bounded token savings. 一手资料 primary sources dai et al., transformer-xl — segment-level recurrence 与长依赖建模的原始论文；并非 agent summary 方案。 rae et al., compressive transformers — 学习压缩旧 activation memory 的研究；用于理解 loss/compression 取舍，不等同外部 memory。 zhang et al., summn — 多阶段长输入/对话 summarization 的论文及作者报告结果。 packer et al., memgpt — 分层 memory management 与 context paging 的系统论文。 liu et al., lost in the middle — 长 context 中证据位置影响使用效果的 tacl 实验。 wu et al., longmemeval — 长期交互 memory 中时态、更新与 abstention 的 benchmark。 rfc 6962: certificate transparency — append-only merkle tree 的规范来源；本文仅借其依赖摘要思想说明 stale detection，不声称 memory 系统采用该协议。 三层压缩、invariant lane、compression manifest、风险触发 rehydration 与 error budget 是本文基于这些机制的编辑性综合。 dai et al., transformer-xl — the original segment-level recurrence work for long dependencies; it is not an agent-summary design. rae et al., compressive transformers — research on learned compression of old activation memory, useful for reasoning about loss and compression but distinct from external memory. zhang et al., summn — a multi-stage long-input and dialogue summarization paper with author-reported results. packer et al., memgpt — a systems paper on hierarchical memory management and context paging. liu et al., lost in the middle — tacl experiments showing position-dependent evidence use in long context. wu et al., longmemeval — a benchmark covering temporal reasoning, updates, and abstention in long-term interaction memory. rfc 6962: certificate transparency — the specification source for append-only merkle trees. this article borrows only the dependency-digest idea for stale detection; it does not claim a memory system implements that protocol. the three compression layers, invariant lane, compression manifest, risk-triggered rehydration, and error budget are editorial synthesis from these mechanisms. 已建立与下一篇起点 what is established and where we continue 今天已建立： lossless event/artifact 是事实层；typed working state 保存不可丢 invariants；rolling 与 hierarchical summaries 是带 source refs、版本和 omissions 的派生导航层。压缩按 episode 发生，经过结构验证，并通过 manifest 追踪每个 source span；高风险决策、冲突或低 confidence 强制 rehydrate。 尚未讲完： 候选 memory 到底如何写入、检索、合并和遗忘？embedding、bm25、metadata 与 graph 如何组合？多条冲突记忆如何按 authority、scope 与 time resolution？ 下一篇起点： context 与 memory 系统 3/4 将进入 retrieval 与 lifecycle：hybrid search、memory admission、consolidation、supersession、decay、deletion propagation，以及为什么“最相似”经常不是“最该用”。 established today: lossless events and artifacts form the fact layer. typed working state preserves invariants. rolling and hierarchical summaries are derived navigation layers with source references, versions, and omissions. compression occurs at episode boundaries, passes structural validation, and uses a manifest to trace each source span. high-risk decisions, conflict, or low confidence require rehydration. still unresolved: how should candidate memories be admitted, retrieved, merged, and forgotten? how do embeddings, bm25, metadata, and graphs compose? how are conflicting memories resolved by authority, scope, and time? next starting point: context and memory systems 3/4 will cover retrieval and lifecycle: hybrid search, memory admission, consolidation, supersession, decay, deletion propagation, and why “most similar” is often not “most appropriate.”

title.zh: 把所有历史塞进 prompt，为什么不等于“有记忆”？
title.en: Why Is Putting All History in the Prompt Not Memory?

text: 把所有历史塞进 prompt，为什么不等于“有记忆”？ why is putting all history in the prompt not memory? context 与 memory 系统 context and memory systems context engineering working state retrieval durable memory provenance 今日命题 today's proposition llm 每次生成只直接读取本次请求中的 token，以及推理期间由这些 token 建出的 kv cache。它不会在下一次请求里自动“想起”上一次调用；agent 看起来有连续性，是 runtime 把先前事件、状态与检索结果重新序列化进下一次输入。context window 因而是 当前计算的有限工作面 ，不是持久数据库，也不是模型内部新增了一段可寻址记忆。 把 transcript 原样追加似乎最诚实，却混合了事实、过期计划、工具噪声、失败尝试、恶意内容与重复结论。容量再大也不能解决来源冲突、时间有效性和任务相关性；长输入还增加 prefill 成本，并可能让关键证据在位置与语义干扰中更难被使用。 核心判断： 可靠 memory 不是“保存更多”，而是把 event log、working state、retrieval index 与 durable records 分开管理，再由 context assembler 按任务、权限、时效与 token budget 生成一个带 provenance 的临时视图。 on every generation, an llm directly reads only the tokens in that request and the kv cache produced from them during inference. it does not automatically recall a previous call. an agent appears continuous because the runtime serializes earlier events, state, and retrieved records into the next input. the context window is therefore a finite workspace for the current computation , not a persistent database or newly addressable memory inside the model. appending the full transcript seems maximally faithful, but it mixes facts with obsolete plans, tool noise, failed attempts, hostile content, and repeated conclusions. more capacity does not resolve conflicts, temporal validity, or task relevance. longer input also raises prefill cost and can make decisive evidence harder to use amid positional and semantic interference. core judgment: reliable memory is not “save more.” manage the event log, working state, retrieval index, and durable records separately. at each step, a context assembler creates a provenance-bearing temporary view constrained by task, authorization, freshness, and token budget. history 可重放，不代表应该全喂给模型 replayable history is not model context 上一系列把 durable event history 定义为 control plane 的事实账本：为了 replay 与审计，它应完整且不可随意改写。但模型 context 的目标不同——用有限 token 支持下一次决策。把事实账本等同于 prompt，会把 durability 的正确性要求误移植成输入策略。 一次部署可能产生 8,000 条 heartbeat、三次失败日志、旧审批和最终成功回执。replay 需要全部顺序；下一步判断只需当前目标、已选 commit、最新审批范围、部署结果与相关异常。working state 是事件归约出的“现在”；retrieval 是按问题选出的候选证据；durable memory 是跨任务复用、经过写入策略的记录。它们生命周期和信任等级不同。 因此 context engineering 不是 prompt 文案优化，而是编译过程：从任务和状态生成信息需求，查询多个存储，执行安全过滤，分配稀缺 token，并把不同 trust domains 序列化成模型可读、却不混淆 authority 的输入。 the previous series defined durable event history as the control plane's fact ledger. it remains complete and resistant to casual rewriting for replay and audit. model context has another objective: support the next decision using finite tokens. equating the fact ledger with the prompt mistakenly turns a durability requirement into an input-selection policy. a deployment may accumulate 8,000 heartbeat events, three failed logs, an obsolete approval, and a final success callback. replay needs their order. the next decision may need only the current goal, selected commit, latest approval scope, deployment result, and relevant anomaly. working state is the present reduced from events. retrieval selects candidate evidence for a question. durable memory contains cross-task records admitted by a write policy. their lifetimes and trust levels differ. context engineering is therefore not prompt-copy editing. it is compilation: derive information requirements from task and state, query multiple stores, enforce security filters, allocate scarce tokens, and serialize different trust domains without confusing data with authority. 机制：一次 context assembly 的读写路径 mechanism: one context-assembly read/write path 1. 四类对象 transcript/event log 记录发生过什么，服务 audit、replay、debug，不承诺每条都相关。 working state 是 reducer 产出的结构化当前态：goal、plan version、open calls、constraints、accepted results。 durable record 可跨 execution 读取，必须有 subject、source、valid time、confidence、acl 与 supersedes。 retrieval index 是找候选的派生结构；embedding 命中不是事实认证。 2. 编译 requirements assembler 不应只拿最后一条消息做向量搜索。它先生成 typed requirement：待决策问题、必须引用的 authoritative state、历史先例、时间范围、tenant/subject、允许数据域与 token budget。退款邮件需要当前退款状态与联系方式，不应因语义相似召回另一客户模板。 3. 多路召回与硬过滤 候选可来自 structured query、bm25、dense embedding、graph edge 与 recent-event window。合并后先按 acl、tenant、subject、validfrom/validto、record status、source class、schema compatibility 过滤；这些是 correctness gate，reranker 不能覆盖。superseded 记录默认不作 active fact，但可解释变化。 4. 排序、冲突与去重 按 relevance、authority、freshness、specificity、novelty 排序；重复 chunk 归并到同一 source。冲突的高权威记录不能只选 top-1，应同时暴露差异、时间与 provenance。cross-encoder 或 llm reranker 只产生 selection score，不产生事实。 5. 保留 invariant 再分配 token policy、当前 goal、hard constraints、open side effects 与 authoritative state 属于 reserved region；examples、conversation、retrieved evidence 在剩余预算竞争。每块标来源、时间、可信类型、是否为 instruction。外部文档放在 data boundary，避免“忽略前文”升级为 control instruction。 6. 稳定序列化 模板分开 instruction、current state、evidence、conversation 与 output contract。证据使用 immutable recordid/version，便于 trace。长 artifact 只放 task-specific slice 与可回查 pointer；summary 指向源并声明覆盖范围，不能冒充原文。 7. 写回 admission 模型输出首先是 proposal。tool result 进入 event log；memory candidate 经过 schema、pii/secret、source attribution、conflict、dedup 检查，才 create、update、supersede、reject 或留在本次 execution。用户明确偏好可入库；模型猜“用户可能讨厌表格”不能无标记升格为事实。 8. 每步重组 每个 transition 后重新计算需求与预算，而非永久累积 prompt。相同 state、policy、index snapshot 与 budget 应产生可解释的同一候选集合，即使模型采样仍会变化。 9. assembly 自身也要可观测 每次调用保存 context manifest：assembler/policy version、query、index snapshot、候选 recordid、硬过滤原因、rank score、分区 token 数、最终引用与截断项。manifest 不必复制敏感正文，但要能在授权环境重建选择过程。错误答案才能被分类为 retrieval miss、filter bug、ranking error、serialization loss 或 model-use failure，而不是反复盲调 top-k。 10. 一个冲突实例 profile 说“默认用个人邮箱”，两小时前工单说“本项目只用公司邮箱”，crm 又显示公司邮箱刚被撤销。正确 assembler 不能凭最高 cosine score 选一个：project instruction 更具体，但 revoked 状态阻塞执行，结果应是请求新地址或人工确认。memory 系统的价值不是只召回句子，而是保留 scope、authority、time 与 contradiction，使 agent 能安全 abstain。 1. define four object types the transcript or event log records what happened for audit, replay, and debugging; not every event is relevant. working state is the structured present produced by reducers: goal, plan version, open calls, constraints, and accepted results. a durable record is readable across executions and needs subject, source, valid time, confidence, acl, and supersession links. a retrieval index is a derivative optimized for candidate discovery. an embedding match does not authenticate a fact. 2. compile requirements the assembler should not vector-search only the latest message. it derives a typed requirement: pending decision, mandatory authoritative state, useful historical analogies, time range, tenant and subject, permitted domains, and token budget. a refund-email step needs current refund status and contact details; semantic similarity must not inject another customer's old template. 3. retrieve broadly, then hard-filter candidates may come from structured queries, bm25, dense embeddings, graph edges, and a recent-event window. before reranking, enforce acl, tenant, subject, valid-from and valid-to, record status, source class, and schema compatibility. these are correctness gates; a reranker cannot override them. superseded records normally leave active facts but remain historical evidence for questions about change. 4. rank, expose conflict, and deduplicate rank by task relevance, authority, freshness, specificity, and novelty. merge duplicate chunks under one source. if authoritative records conflict, do not hide disagreement by choosing top-1; expose both with timestamps and provenance. a cross-encoder or llm reranker produces a selection score, not a new authenticated fact. 5. reserve invariants before allocating tokens policy, current goal, hard constraints, open effects, and authoritative state occupy a reserved region. examples, conversation history, and retrieved evidence compete for the remainder. label every block with source, time, trust type, and whether it is instruction. external documents stay inside a data boundary, so “ignore previous instructions” cannot become control authority. 6. serialize stably a template separates instruction, current state, evidence, conversation, and output contract. evidence uses immutable record ids and versions for tracing. a long artifact contributes a task-specific slice plus a dereferenceable pointer. a summary links to its source and declares scope; it cannot impersonate the original. 7. write-back passes admission model output is initially a proposal. tool results enter the event log. a memory candidate passes schema validation, pii and secret checks, source attribution, conflict detection, and deduplication. policy then creates, updates, supersedes, rejects, or keeps it execution-local. an explicit preference may become durable; a model guess that the user dislikes tables must not silently become fact. 8. reassemble at every step after each transition, recompute requirements and budget rather than growing a permanent prompt. given the same state, policy, index snapshot, and budget, the candidate set should be explainable and repeatable even when final model sampling varies. 9. make assembly itself observable persist a context manifest for every call: assembler and policy versions, query, index snapshot, candidate record ids, hard-filter reasons, ranking scores, per-partition token allocation, final citations, and truncated items. it need not duplicate sensitive text, but an authorized environment must reconstruct selection. a wrong answer can then be classified as retrieval miss, filtering defect, ranking error, serialization loss, or model-use failure. without this boundary, teams repeatedly tune top-k and prompt wording without locating the failing subsystem. 10. a conflict example suppose a profile says “use personal email by default,” a ticket two hours ago says “this project must use corporate email,” and the crm says the corporate address was just revoked. a correct assembler cannot pick one by highest cosine score. the project instruction is more specific, but revocation blocks execution, so the result must request a valid corporate address or human confirmation. memory is valuable not merely because it recalls a sentence, but because it preserves scope, authority, time, and contradiction so the agent can abstain safely. this example also separates retrieval from decision. all three records may be correctly retrieved; failure can still occur if serialization removes timestamps, if ranking hides the revocation, or if the model treats a default preference as stronger than project policy. the manifest makes those boundaries testable and lets evaluators compare the assembled evidence with the final action. 必要数学：token 预算与检索价值 essential mathematics: token budgets and retrieval value 容量约束 总 context 为 w tokens，预留输出 o ，固定 policy p ，working state s ，则其余预算 b=w−o−p−s 。若 b≤0，必须压缩 state 表达、换模型或拒绝任务；截断 policy 或未决副作用不是合法优化。输入增加还扩大 prefill 与 kv cache 成本，“容得下”不等于延迟可接受。 受约束选择 候选 i 的 token 成本 cᵢ 、决策价值 uᵢ 、选择变量 xᵢ∈{0,1} ，理想目标为 max σuᵢxᵢ，subject to σcᵢxᵢ≤b 。uᵢ 综合 relevance、authority、freshness、conflict coverage，而非 cosine similarity。权威约束虽不相似也可高价值；重复 chunk 边际价值近零。实践用分区配额、贪心与 rerank 近似。 检索指标拆分 需要的证据为 g 、召回为 r ， recall=|g∩r|/|g| ；最终入 context 为 k ， precision=|g∩k|/|k| 。两者都不证明模型正确使用证据，还要测 citation correctness、temporal correctness、conflict detection 与 task success。 capacity constraint let total context be w tokens, reserved output o , fixed policy p , and working state s . the remaining budget is b=w−o−p−s . if b≤0, reduce state representation, choose a larger-window model, or reject the task. truncating policy or unresolved effects is invalid. more input also expands prefill and kv-cache cost, so fitting does not imply acceptable latency. constrained selection for candidate i , token cost is cᵢ , decision utility uᵢ , and selection xᵢ∈{0,1} . the idealized objective is maximize σuᵢxᵢ subject to σcᵢxᵢ≤b . utility combines relevance, authority, freshness, and conflict coverage; it is not cosine similarity. an authoritative constraint can be valuable despite low similarity, while duplicate chunks add nearly zero marginal value. partition quotas, greedy selection, and reranking approximate the optimization. separate retrieval metrics let g be evidence actually required and r the retrieved set. recall=|g∩r|/|g| . let k be final context; precision=|g∩k|/|k| . neither proves correct evidence use. also test citation correctness, temporal correctness, conflict detection, and task success. 对 agent 系统的影响 implications for agent systems 能力来自 state abstraction 长任务靠把“发生过什么”归约成“现在必须知道什么”，不是靠无限 transcript。typed state 支持换模型、压缩、worker handoff 与 recovery，recordid 保留回查路径。 可靠性来自 provenance 与时态 “预算是 10 万”没有 subject、currency、source、valid time 与 supersedes 就不可安全使用。schema 应表示 unknown、conflicting、expired，并区分 stored evidence 与 model inference。 安全边界进入 retrieval 权限过滤发生在候选交给模型之前；要求模型不泄露已检索越权内容太晚。外部文本是 data 与潜在 prompt injection，instruction 只能来自 trusted control region。 成本与可观测性 成本还包括 embedding、index、reranking、migration、冲突合并、加密与删除传播。trace 应记录候选、过滤原因、token 分配和引用，才能离线 replay 失败，而不是只调 top-k。 latency 与 cache 行为改变架构选择 稳定、较短的 policy/state prefix 更容易复用 provider 或 runtime 的 prefix/kv cache；每步把整个 transcript 重新排序、插入动态摘要会降低 cache 命中，并让 prefill latency 随历史增长。assembler 因而应保持固定分区顺序，把高变化 evidence 放在明确区域，并记录实际 input tokens、cached tokens 与 time-to-first-token。缓存只改善计算，不改变 evidence freshness；命中旧 prefix 也不能绕过重新授权和时态过滤。 context contract 也需要版本 assembler template、record schema、ranking features 与 token quota 的变化会改变 agent 行为，即使模型版本不变。execution trace 应保存 contextschemaversion 和 assemblerversion；离线 replay 要能用旧版本重建当时输入，再与候选新版本做 counterfactual comparison。否则一次上线后的质量变化会被误归因于模型，团队无法判断是检索、过滤、排序还是序列化发生漂移。 capability comes from state abstraction long tasks continue by reducing “what happened” into “what must be known now,” not through an infinite transcript. typed state enables model switching, compression, worker handoff, and recovery, while record ids preserve drill-back. reliability comes from provenance and time “the budget is 100,000” is unsafe without subject, currency, source, valid time, and supersession. schemas represent unknown, conflicting, and expired, and distinguish stored evidence from model inference. the security boundary enters retrieval authorization filters candidates before the model. asking a model not to disclose unauthorized content after retrieval is too late. external text is data and possible prompt injection; instructions come only from a trusted control region. cost and observability costs include embeddings, indexes, reranking, migrations, conflict merging, encryption, and deletion propagation. traces record candidates, filter reasons, token allocation, and citations so failures can be replayed offline instead of blindly tuning top-k. latency and cache behavior change the architecture a stable, relatively short policy-and-state prefix is easier for a provider or runtime to reuse through prefix or kv caching. reordering the entire transcript or inserting a changing summary at every step reduces cache hits and lets prefill latency grow with history. the assembler should keep partitions in stable order, place volatile evidence in an explicit region, and record actual input tokens, cached tokens, and time to first token. caching improves computation only; it does not establish evidence freshness. a cached prefix cannot bypass renewed authorization and temporal filtering. the context contract also needs a version changes to assembler templates, record schemas, ranking features, and token quotas alter agent behavior even when the model version remains constant. execution traces should retain a context schema version and assembler version. offline replay must reconstruct the historical input with the old version, then compare it with a candidate version counterfactually. otherwise a quality change after deployment is misattributed to the model, and the team cannot tell whether retrieval, filtering, ranking, or serialization drifted. versioning also permits staged rollout by task class and fast rollback without rewriting durable records. 设计取舍与失败模式 trade-offs and failure modes 完整 transcript： 易实现、审计多，但成本增长且旧指令污染；适合短 session，不是长期 memory architecture。 只存摘要： 便宜但固化遗漏；summary 应版本化、可回源、区分 confirmed facts、open questions 与 discarded detail。 向量库即 memory： 语义强，但 identifier、否定、数字、时间、权限需 hybrid retrieval 与 metadata filter。 recency 偏置： 最新不等于最权威；freshness 与 authority 分开。 自我污染： 模型猜测写回后又被当证据；derived record 标注 inference、保留 source、提高 admission threshold。 删除不完整： 主记录删除但 embedding/cache/snapshot 仍在；删除是跨派生存储的 tombstone/propagation protocol。 top-1 隐藏冲突： 高风险字段需 conflict set、authority rule 或人工 resolution。 评测错位： hit rate 忽略错误使用、越权和过期；要用时间切片、对抗冲突和遗忘任务做 end-to-end eval。 full transcript: easy and auditable, but cost grows and obsolete instructions contaminate decisions; it suits short sessions, not long-term memory architecture. summary only: cheap, but omissions become durable. version summaries, link sources, and separate confirmed facts, open questions, and discarded detail. vector database as memory: strong semantic recall, but identifiers, negation, numbers, time, and authorization need hybrid retrieval and metadata filters. recency bias: newest is not most authoritative. score freshness and authority separately. self-contamination: model guesses written back return as evidence. mark derived records as inference, retain sources, and raise admission thresholds. incomplete deletion: primary records disappear while embeddings, caches, or snapshots remain. deletion is a tombstone and propagation protocol. top-1 hides conflict: high-risk fields need conflict sets, authority rules, or human resolution. misaligned evaluation: hit rate misses misuse, unauthorized recall, and expiry. use temporal splits, adversarial conflicts, and tasks requiring forgetting. 可复用的技术判断 reusable technical judgments context window 是一次推理的有限工作面；连续性由 runtime 重建。 event log、working state、durable record、retrieval index 的目标与信任等级不同。 先做权限/时态硬过滤，再做相关性排序和 token 分配。 memory 写入是带 provenance、冲突与 supersession 的 admission decision。 评测覆盖 retrieval、selection、正确使用、时间有效性与删除传播，最终看任务质量。 context is finite workspace for one inference; runtime reconstruction creates continuity. event logs, working state, durable records, and retrieval indexes have different goals and trust levels. apply authorization and temporal gates before relevance ranking and token allocation. memory write-back is a provenance-, conflict-, and supersession-aware admission decision. evaluate retrieval, selection, correct use, temporal validity, and deletion propagation, ending with task quality. 一手资料 primary sources vaswani et al., attention is all you need — transformer 序列机制原始论文；不定义 agent memory。 liu et al., lost in the middle — 长 context 中位置影响证据使用的实验，结果依模型任务而变。 lewis et al., retrieval-augmented generation — 参数模型结合外部索引的原始 rag 工作。 packer et al., memgpt — 分层 memory/context management 系统与作者报告实验。 park et al., generative agents — memory stream、retrieval、reflection 实验。 wu et al., longmemeval — 长期 memory 的 extraction、多 session、temporal、update 与 abstention benchmark。 nist privacy framework — 支持生命周期与删除边界的隐私风险框架。 四层对象模型、requirement compiler、record schema 与 admission pipeline 是本文的编辑性综合。 vaswani et al., attention is all you need — original transformer sequence mechanisms; it does not define agent memory. liu et al., lost in the middle — experiments on position-dependent evidence use in long contexts; results vary by model and task. lewis et al., retrieval-augmented generation — original rag work combining parametric generation with an external index. packer et al., memgpt — a hierarchical memory/context system with author-reported experiments. park et al., generative agents — experiments with memory streams, retrieval, and reflection. wu et al., longmemeval — a benchmark for extraction, multi-session and temporal reasoning, updates, and abstention. nist privacy framework — a privacy-risk framework supporting lifecycle and deletion boundaries. the four-layer model, requirement compiler, record schema, and admission pipeline are editorial synthesis. 已建立与下一篇起点 what is established and where we continue 今天已建立： context 是一次推理的临时 token view；runtime 分别维护 event log、typed working state、retrieval index 与 durable records。assembler 从任务需求出发，经权限/时态过滤、排序、冲突暴露和 token 分配生成输入；模型输出经 admission 才能写回。 尚未讲完： 长 history 如何压缩而不丢失未决约束？何时 rolling summary、hierarchical summary 或 state abstraction？摘要错误如何回源、重算和迁移？ 下一篇： 2/4 进入 compression：分离 lossless history 与 lossy summaries，定义 invariant、更新策略、error budget 与可逆引用。 established today: context is a temporary token view. the runtime separately maintains the event log, typed working state, retrieval index, and durable records. starting from task requirements, the assembler applies authorization and temporal filters, ranking, conflict exposure, and token allocation. model output enters memory only through admission. still unresolved: how can long history be compressed without losing open constraints? when should a system use rolling summaries, hierarchical summaries, or state abstraction? how can faulty summaries be traced, recomputed, and migrated? next: part 2 covers compression: separating lossless history from lossy summaries and defining invariants, update policy, error budgets, and reversible references.

title.zh: 一个跑三天的 Agent，凭什么还能安全地继续？
title.en: How Can a Three-Day Agent Resume Safely?

text: 一个跑三天的 agent，凭什么还能安全地继续？ how can a three-day agent resume safely? agent runtime 内核 agent runtime internals durable execution control plane workflow versioning human approval terminal verification 今日命题 today's proposition 一个持续三天的 agent 不是一段运行三天的进程。进程会重启，worker 会滚动升级，凭据会过期，审批可能晚两小时到达，外部系统还会先成功再丢失回执。真正长寿的是一条 可重放的 execution record ：稳定 workflow identity、持久事件历史、等待条件、未决副作用、策略版本与可验证终态。 长运行 agent 因而需要 data plane 与 control plane 分离。data plane 执行模型推理和工具调用；control plane 决定何时调度、等待什么、谁能发 signal、哪个代码版本解释旧历史、失败由谁监督，以及何时有足够证据宣布完成。把这些职责留给 prompt，会让 crash recovery、授权与升级语义随模型输出漂移。 核心判断： durability 不是“保存聊天”，而是让每个外部输入和调度决定在崩溃后得到同一解释；completion 也不是“模型说完成”，而是 terminal verifier 对预先声明的 postconditions 产出带 provenance 的证据。 a three-day agent is not a process that remains alive for three days. processes restart, workers roll forward, credentials expire, approvals arrive late, and an external system may commit while its acknowledgement disappears. what survives is a replayable execution record : stable workflow identity, durable event history, wait conditions, unresolved effects, policy versions, and a verifiable terminal state. long-running agents therefore separate a data plane from a control plane. the data plane runs model inference and tool calls. the control plane decides when work is schedulable, what it awaits, who may signal it, which code version interprets old history, who supervises failure, and when enough evidence exists to declare completion. leaving those duties to a prompt makes recovery, authorization, and upgrades drift with model output. core judgment: durability is not saving a chat. every external input and scheduling decision must retain the same interpretation after a crash. completion is not the model saying “done”; a terminal verifier must produce provenance-bearing evidence for predeclared postconditions. 把前三篇装进一个 control plane place the first three parts inside one control plane 1/4 把 tool call 拆成 command、attempt、result 与 outcome_unknown；2/4 用 structured concurrency 约束 child tasks、deadline、cancellation 和 backpressure；3/4 用稳定 idempotency key、checkpoint、reconciliation 与 compensation 处理副作用的不确定结果。今天给这些机制一个跨天存在的管理层。 workflowid/runid 是最外层 identity；operationid、callid、attemptid 位于其内。event history 记录 transition 的原因，snapshot 只是恢复加速缓存。timer、signal 和 approval 都追加为带 identity、时间与 schema version 的事件。worker 可以消失，因为新 worker 能从 history 恢复；但 replay 时不能重新读 wall clock、重新调用模型或重做副作用。 长运行 agent control plane 命令、审批和回调进入持久事件历史，由确定性状态机产生 timer 和 activity。supervisor 处理停滞，terminal verifier 以外部证据决定完成或修复。 signals / approvals durable event history identity · policy · provenance deterministic state machine durable timers model + tool workers supervisor / verifier 原创示意：history 是事实账本，state machine 是解释器；timer、worker 与 supervisor 都可替换，verifier 以新证据驱动完成或修复。 part 1 decomposed a tool call into command, attempt, result, and outcome unknown. part 2 used structured concurrency to bound children, deadlines, cancellation, and backpressure. part 3 handled uncertain effects through stable idempotency keys, checkpoints, reconciliation, and compensation. today gives these mechanisms a management layer that survives across days. workflow and run ids are outer identities; operation, call, and attempt ids live within them. event history records why state transitioned; a snapshot is only a recovery accelerator. timers, signals, and approvals append events carrying identity, time, and schema version. a worker may disappear because a replacement reconstructs state from history, but replay must not reread wall clock, recall the model, or repeat effects. long-running agent control plane commands, approvals, and callbacks enter durable event history. a deterministic state machine creates timers and activities. a supervisor handles stalls and a verifier uses external evidence to complete or repair. signals / approvals durable event history identity · policy · provenance deterministic state machine durable timers model + tool workers supervisor / verifier original diagram: history is the fact ledger and the state machine is its interpreter. timers, workers, and supervisors are replaceable; new evidence drives completion or repair. 机制：三条闭环，而不是一条超长 loop mechanism: three closed loops, not one enormous loop 1. 事件溯源 record command 先通过 admission：验证 tenant、principal、workflow schema、policy version 与唯一 commandid，再 append history。reducer 以 state+event 计算新 state 和待发 commands。snapshot 可缓存第 n 个 event 的状态，但丢失它只能降低速度，不能改变结果。影响控制流的模型输出也保存 model/version、prompt digest 与 response digest。 2. durable timer 记录 timerscheduled(timerid, fireat) 后释放 worker。timer service 到点追加 timerfired ，重复 fire 由 timerid 去重。其语义通常是“不早于 fireat 被处理”，不是精确时刻执行；拥塞会造成 lateness。业务 deadline、提醒 timer 和授权 expiry 要分开，取消也写事件，不能依赖内存 timeout handle。 3. signal 与 correlation callback 规范化为 signal：workflowid、signalid、type、schemaversion、issuer、payload digest、receivedat。control plane 认证 issuer、按 signalid 去重，再检查当前 wait set 是否接受该 type。早到 signal 可缓冲；晚到或指向已取消 workflow 的 signal 只能审计，不能复活 execution。用自然语言正文匹配任务会把 correlation 错误变成授权漏洞。 4. human approval 审批请求冻结 intent digest ：工具、目标、关键参数、风险、policy version、有效期和允许变更。approval event 绑定 approver identity、decision、digest 与 timestamp。若金额、收件人、代码 diff 或权限范围 material change，旧 approval 失效；超时走 escalation/reject/pause，绝不能默认批准。 5. replay 与 versioning history 包含旧代码作出的选择。新 worker 若对同一 history 走不同分支就产生 non-determinism。安全方案有：旧 execution pin 到旧 build；在 history 写 version marker，replay 永远读取同一 marker；或 continue-as-new，将显式压缩 state 转入新 run/schema。event upcaster 只能确定性转换 schema，不能改写历史事实。 6. lease 与 supervision worker poll task 后获得有限 lease，heartbeat 报告进度和 checkpoint。lease timeout 只表示 owner 失联，不证明 effect 没发生；接管仍遵守上一篇的 idempotency/fencing/reconciliation。supervisor 监控 state age、last progress、timer lateness、budget、open approvals 与 unresolved effects，并按 typed failure 选择 restart child、pause、escalate、compensate 或 fail。 7. terminal verification 模型提交 completion_candidate 后不直接成功。control plane 运行预声明 verifier：查询目标系统、执行测试、检查 artifact digest、policy 与未决 calls。evidence bundle 含 verifier/version、observedat、source identity、query/test、结果与 hash。所有 required postconditions 为 true 且没有 outcome_unknown 才追加 workflowcompleted ，否则 bounded repair 或人工。 8. runbook 每个异常状态映射 owner、诊断查询、安全动作与禁止动作。waiting_approval 检查 expiry/digest，禁止自批；timer_late 检查 capacity，禁止批量重建 timer；effect_unknown 先 reconcile，禁止新 key；non_deterministic 恢复兼容 worker，禁止删 history。redrive 记录 operator、reason 与原 identity。 reduce(state, event): next = deterministictransition(state, event) persist(next.commands, expectedversion=state.version) oncompletioncandidate(run): evidence = verify(run.postconditions, externalsources) if evidence.allrequired and run.unknowneffects == 0: append(workflowcompleted(evidence.digest)) else: append(repairormanualreview(evidence.failures)) 1. event-sourced record every command passes admission before append: validate tenant, principal, workflow schema, policy version, and unique command id. a reducer takes state plus one event and computes next state and commands. a snapshot may cache state at event n, but losing it may only slow recovery; it cannot change the result. model output affecting control flow is also recorded with model/version, prompt digest, and response digest. 2. durable timers after recording timerscheduled(timerid, fireat) , release the worker. at due time the timer service appends timerfired , deduplicated by timer id. its usual meaning is “not processed before fireat,” not exact execution then; congestion adds lateness. separate business deadlines, reminder timers, and authority expiry. record cancellation instead of trusting an in-memory timeout handle. 3. signals and correlation normalize callbacks into signals carrying workflow id, signal id, type, schema version, issuer, payload digest, and receive time. authenticate the issuer, deduplicate by signal id, then test whether the wait set accepts the type. buffer an early signal. a late signal or one targeting a cancelled workflow becomes an auditable rejection; it cannot resurrect execution. routing from natural-language body text turns correlation error into an authorization vulnerability. 4. human approval an approval request freezes an intent digest : tool, target, material arguments, risk, policy version, expiry, and permitted variation. the approval event binds approver identity, decision, digest, and timestamp. material change to amount, recipient, code diff, or permission scope invalidates the old decision. expiry follows escalation, rejection, or pause—never implicit approval. 5. replay and versioning history contains decisions made by old code. a new worker taking another branch over the same history creates nondeterminism. safe strategies include pinning old executions to an old build; recording a version marker that replay reads consistently; or continuing as new, carrying explicit compacted state into a new run and schema. an event upcaster performs only deterministic, tested schema transformation and never rewrites historical facts. 6. leases and supervision a polling worker receives a finite lease; heartbeats report progress and recoverable checkpoints. lease timeout says the owner disappeared, not that an effect did not happen. takeover still follows part 3's idempotency, fencing, and reconciliation. a supervisor watches state age, last progress, timer lateness, budgets, open approvals, and unresolved effects. typed failure determines restart child, pause, escalate, compensate, or fail. 7. terminal verification a model's completion_candidate does not directly become success. the control plane runs predeclared verifiers: query target systems, execute tests, inspect artifact digests, policy, and unresolved calls. an evidence bundle records verifier/version, observation time, source identity, query or test, result, and hash. only all required postconditions being true with no unknown effect permits workflowcompleted ; otherwise bounded repair or human review follows. 8. runbooks every abnormal state maps to an owner, diagnostic query, safe action, and forbidden action. for waiting approval, inspect expiry and digest; never self-approve. for timer late, inspect capacity; never recreate timers in bulk. for effect unknown, reconcile first; never mint a new key. for nondeterminism, restore a compatible worker; never delete history. redrive records operator, reason, and original identity. reduce(state, event): next = deterministictransition(state, event) persist(next.commands, expectedversion=state.version) oncompletioncandidate(run): evidence = verify(run.postconditions, externalsources) if evidence.allrequired and run.unknowneffects == 0: append(workflowcompleted(evidence.digest)) else: append(repairormanualreview(evidence.failures)) 必要数学：安全余量、积压与收敛 essential mathematics: safety margins, backlog, and convergence timer lateness 与 lease timer 计划时间为 t f ，实际处理时间为 t p ，则 ℓ=max(0,t p −t f ) 。应监控 ℓ 的 p95/p99；若 approval expiry 是硬边界，必须比较 event time 与 expiry，不能因晚处理让过期授权生效。 lease 时长 l 至少容纳 heartbeat 间隔 h 、最大延迟 d 与时钟误差 ε ： l h+d+2ε 可减少误接管。但它不是安全证明；暂停的旧 worker 仍可能复活，所以 effect 还需 fencing token 或稳定 idempotency key。 积压收敛 runnable 到达率 λ ，可持续完成率 μ ，backlog 为 b 。只有 μ λ 才收敛，理想排空时间 t≈b/(μ−λ) 。b=18,000、μ=120/s、λ=100/s 时约需 900 秒，不是 150 秒。timer 同时到期会抬高 λ；jitter、分区与 admission control 是容量安全机制。 完成谓词 required postconditions 为 v₁…vₙ 、未知副作用数为 u ，则 c=(v₁∧…∧vₙ)∧(u=0) 。这不是概率乘法，而是逻辑门：任一 false/unknown 都不能成功。运维 slo 可测 p(t terminal ≤d) ，即 deadline d 内进入 succeeded、failed 或明确 manual-review 终态的比例，比 worker uptime 更接近收敛性。 timer lateness and leases for scheduled time t f and actual processing time t p , lateness is ℓ=max(0,t p −t f ) . monitor p95 and p99 of ℓ. if approval expiry is hard, compare event time with expiry; delayed processing cannot revive authority. lease length l should accommodate heartbeat interval h , maximum delay d , and clock uncertainty ε : l h+d+2ε reduces false takeover. it is not a safety proof. a paused worker may revive, so effects still need fencing or stable idempotency. backlog convergence let runnable arrivals be λ , sustainable service rate μ , and backlog b . it converges only if μ λ , with ideal drain time t≈b/(μ−λ) . for b=18,000, μ=120/s, λ=100/s, that is 900 seconds, not 150. cohorts of timers raise λ together; jitter, partitioning, and admission control are capacity-safety mechanisms. completion predicate for required postconditions v₁…vₙ and unknown-effect count u , define c=(v₁∧…∧vₙ)∧(u=0) . this is a logical gate, not probability multiplication: one false or unknown blocks success. an operational slo can measure p(t terminal ≤d) , the fraction reaching succeeded, failed, or explicit manual review by deadline d. it captures convergence better than worker uptime. 对 agent 系统的影响 implications for agent systems 等待成为一等动作 agent 可声明等待 callback、审批或明早 09:00，释放计算，在 signal/timer 后从 durable state 恢复。模型只接收压缩 current state 与新 event，不必回灌三天 transcript；完整 history 留给 replay、审计和证据。 认知判断与控制判断分离 llm 负责规划、解释模糊输入和提出 repair；runtime 拥有 identity、authorization、deadline、replay、retry 与 terminal gate。模型可建议重跑，却不能绕过 unresolved effect 或 retry budget；可总结审批理由，却不能生成 approval event。模型升级因此不会改写故障语义。 可观测性必须复原状态，而不只是统计请求 trace span 应携带 workflowid、runid、operationid、callid 与 attemptid，metric 则按 state、wait reason、tool class 和 failure class 聚合；高基数 identity 留在 logs/traces，不直接做 metric label。核心面板同时展示 open executions 的年龄分布、timer lateness、approval age、unknown effects、repair 次数与 terminal convergence slo。这样 on-call 才能从聚合异常下钻到事件历史，并判断是容量不足、外部依赖停滞、审批无人负责，还是 verifier 发现真实后置条件未满足。 成本与产品语义 event、snapshot、timer index、visibility query 与 verifier 增加存储/i/o，兼容 worker 和 schema migration 增加工程成本，却避免长占 worker、重复推理与人工追查。状态页应显示 waiting reason、last progress、owner、certainty 和安全下一步；把一切写成“agent 正在思考”会掩盖系统停滞。 waiting becomes a first-class action an agent can wait for a callback, approval, or 09:00 tomorrow, release compute, and resume from durable state after a signal or timer. the model receives compact current state plus the new event rather than three days of transcript. full history remains for replay, audit, and evidence. separate cognitive from control judgment the llm plans, interprets ambiguity, and proposes repair. the runtime owns identity, authorization, deadlines, replay, retry, and the terminal gate. a model may suggest rerunning but cannot bypass an unresolved effect or retry budget; it may summarize approval rationale but cannot create the approval event. model upgrades therefore do not rewrite failure semantics. observability must reconstruct state, not merely count requests a trace span carries workflow, run, operation, call, and attempt identities. metrics aggregate by state, wait reason, tool class, and failure class, while high-cardinality identities stay in logs and traces rather than metric labels. a useful control-plane dashboard combines the age distribution of open executions, timer lateness, approval age, unknown effects, repair count, and the terminal-convergence slo. an on-call engineer can then descend from an aggregate anomaly into event history and distinguish insufficient capacity, a stalled dependency, ownerless approval, or a verifier correctly finding that a real postcondition remains false. request success rate alone cannot make those distinctions. cost and product semantics events, snapshots, timer indexes, visibility queries, and verifiers add storage and i/o; compatible workers and migrations add engineering cost. they avoid holding workers, repeating inference, and manually reconstructing outcomes. status should expose wait reason, last progress, owner, certainty, and the next safe action. saying “agent is thinking” for every state hides systemic stalls. 设计取舍与失败模式 trade-offs and failure modes history 增长： 每次 heartbeat 都入 event 会拖慢 replay；用粗粒度 checkpoint、payload 外置、retention 和 continue-as-new，但不能删未决 effect。 版本分叉： 维护旧/新 worker 有成本，强制迁移又可能无法解释旧 history；compatible builds + marker 通常更安全。 signal race： callback 可能早到、重复、乱序或晚到；先持久化去重再消费，“无 waiter 就丢弃”会永久卡住。 approval toctou： dispatch 前重新比较 intent digest；expiry、revocation 或 policy changed 都要重评。 poison execution： 确定性 bug 会在同 event/version 反复 crash；停止 restart，路由兼容 build 或人工修复。 verifier 自证： 执行 agent 自称通过仍是同源 assertion；高风险条件应查目标 api、独立 test runner 或只读观察面。 恢复风暴： region 恢复后 expired leases、timers、retries 同时 runnable；分区、rate limit、priority、jitter 保护 effect owner。 平台差异： temporal、durable functions、step functions 的 history、timeout、delivery、versioning contract 不同，不能移植保证。 history growth: eventing every heartbeat slows replay. use coarse checkpoints, external payloads, retention, and continue-as-new without deleting unresolved effects. version forks: old and new workers cost money, while forced migration may make old history uninterpretable. compatible builds plus markers are usually safer. signal races: callbacks arrive early, duplicated, reordered, or late. persist and deduplicate before consumption; dropping when no waiter exists can stall forever. approval toctou: compare the intent digest again before dispatch. expiry, revocation, or policy change requires reevaluation. poison execution: a deterministic bug crashes repeatedly at the same event/version. stop restart and route to a compatible build or repair. self-verification: the executing agent claiming success is a same-source assertion. high-risk conditions query target apis, independent tests, or read-only observation. recovery storms: expired leases, timers, and retries become runnable together after recovery. partitioning, limits, priority, and jitter protect effect owners. platform differences: temporal, durable functions, and step functions differ in history, timeout, delivery, and versioning contracts; guarantees do not transplant. 可复用的技术判断 reusable technical judgments 长运行 agent 的 durable unit 是可重放 execution record，不是常驻进程或完整 transcript。 timer、signal、approval 都是带 identity、schema、policy、provenance 的事件；approval 绑定 material intent digest。 pin build、version marker、continue-as-new 分别处理旧 history 的执行兼容、分支兼容与代际切换。 supervisor 管理 progress、lateness、budget、unresolved effect；lease expiry 不等于 effect 未发生。 成功是独立 verifier 对 postconditions 的合取证明，并要求 unknown effects 为零；runbook 定义未收敛时谁做什么、禁止什么。 the durable unit is a replayable execution record, not a resident process or full transcript. timers, signals, and approvals are events with identity, schema, policy, and provenance; approval binds a material-intent digest. build pinning, version markers, and continue-as-new address execution compatibility, branch compatibility, and generational transition. supervisors manage progress, lateness, budgets, and unresolved effects. lease expiry never proves an effect did not happen. success is an independent verifier's conjunctive proof of postconditions with zero unknown effects. runbooks define who acts and what is forbidden. 一手资料 primary sources temporal: workflow execution — 官方说明 event history、replay、durable execution 与 identity；保证只属于 temporal。 temporal: events and event history — 官方定义 history events 与 replay recovery。 temporal: workflow message passing — 官方说明 signals、queries、updates。 microsoft durable functions timers — 官方说明 timer 跨 unload/restart 恢复及触发语义。 durable functions code constraints — 官方说明 deterministic replay、时间/随机数和 side-effect 约束。 aws step functions workflow types — 官方对比 duration、execution semantics 与 history 边界。 erlang/otp supervisor principles — 官方 supervision tree 与 restart strategy。 google sre: automation at google — 官方讨论自动化失败模式与可操作性。 approval intent digest、terminal evidence bundle、完成谓词与 agent runbook 是本文的编辑性综合，不是单一平台的现成功能声明。 temporal: workflow execution — official event-history, replay, durable-execution, and identity documentation; guarantees are temporal-specific. temporal: events and event history — official event and replay-recovery definitions. temporal: workflow message passing — official signals, queries, and updates semantics. microsoft durable functions timers — official recovery and firing semantics across unload and restart. durable functions code constraints — official deterministic replay, time, randomness, and side-effect constraints. aws step functions workflow types — official duration, execution-semantics, and history comparison. erlang/otp supervisor principles — official supervision-tree and restart-strategy principles. google sre: automation at google — official discussion of automation failure modes and operability. the approval intent digest, terminal evidence bundle, completion predicate, and agent runbook are editorial synthesis rather than claims of turnkey capability in one platform. 本系列收束与下一条主线 series synthesis and the next track 今天已完成： event history 与 deterministic reducer 支撑长运行 execution；durable timers 释放 worker，signals 以强 correlation 进入 wait set，approval 绑定 intent digest；versioning 保持旧 history 语义，supervision 管理停滞与预算，terminal verifier 以外部证据决定完成。 四篇合起来： runtime 先把模型意图变成 typed command 和 call lifecycle，再以 structured concurrency 限制并发，以 idempotency/reconciliation 穿越副作用 crash window，最后由持久 control plane 跨天调度、升级、监督并证明终态。可靠性来自系统边界组合，不来自更长 prompt。 本系列状态： agent runtime 内核 4/4 已完成。下一期进入 context memory：从 context window 硬边界开始，区分 transcript、working state、retrieval index 与 durable memory，解释 agent 为什么会“记得很多却用错”。 completed today: event history and a deterministic reducer support long runs. durable timers release workers, strongly correlated signals enter wait sets, and approval binds intent. versioning preserves old-history semantics, supervision manages stalls and budgets, and external evidence gates completion. across four parts: the runtime turns model intent into typed commands and a call lifecycle, bounds concurrency through structured concurrency, crosses effect crash windows through idempotency and reconciliation, then schedules, upgrades, supervises, and proves terminal state through a durable control plane. reliability comes from composing system boundaries, not a longer prompt. series status: agent runtime internals 4/4 is complete. the next track is context memory: starting from context-window limits, separating transcript, working state, retrieval index, and durable memory, and explaining why an agent can remember much yet use the wrong fact.

title.zh: 工具超时后，Agent 到底该不该重试？
title.en: Should an Agent Retry After a Tool Timeout?

text: 工具超时后，agent 到底该不该重试？ should an agent retry after a tool timeout? agent runtime 内核 agent runtime internals idempotency durable recovery retries checkpoint replay compensation 今日命题 today's proposition 请求已 dispatch 后的 timeout 只证明 runtime 没有按时收到结果，不证明远端没有执行；若 admission/queue 阶段在 dispatch 前超时，则可以证明没有远端 effect。支付可能已经扣款、邮件可能已经发送、工单可能已经创建，只是 response 在网络或进程崩溃中丢失。若 agent 把 timeout 直接分类为 failure 并重新调用，就可能把一次不确定结果变成确定的重复副作用。 可靠恢复必须把 逻辑操作 与 传输尝试 分开：一个稳定 operation/call identity 可以经历多个 attempts；idempotency key 让远端识别“这是同一个逻辑意图”；dedup ledger 记录 key、request fingerprint、状态与已提交结果；retry policy 只处理可重试类别；无法证明结果时进入 reconciliation，而不是靠模型猜“应该没成功”。 核心判断： at-least-once delivery + idempotent effect 可以实现“重复投递、单一业务结果”的体验，但 exactly-once 不是一句 runtime 配置。它要求副作用系统参与 key/transaction，或提供可查询的业务 identity；否则跨故障边界只能管理不确定性，不能消除它。 a timeout after dispatch proves only that the runtime did not receive a result on time; it does not prove the remote operation did not execute. an admission or queue timeout before dispatch can establish that no remote effect ran. a payment may be captured, an email sent, or a ticket created while the response is lost to the network or a process crash. if an agent classifies timeout as failure and calls again, it can turn one uncertain outcome into a definite duplicate side effect. reliable recovery separates the logical operation from its transport attempts . one stable operation or call identity may have several attempts. an idempotency key tells the remote system that attempts represent the same intent. a deduplication ledger records the key, request fingerprint, state, and committed result. a retry policy handles only retryable classes. when the outcome cannot be proven, the runtime reconciles rather than asking the model to guess that it probably failed. core judgment: at-least-once delivery plus an idempotent effect can produce “duplicate delivery, one business result.” exactly once is not a runtime toggle. the side-effect system must participate through a key or transaction, or expose a queryable business identity. otherwise the runtime manages uncertainty across failure boundaries; it cannot eliminate it. 承接 lifecycle 与 structured concurrency continue from lifecycle and structured concurrency 1/4 建立了 callid、attemptid 与 outcome_unknown ；2/4 建立了 task group、deadline、cancellation 与 bounded queue。今天把 failure recovery 放进同一状态机。callid/idempotency key 在重试间保持稳定，attemptid 每次变化；parent deadline 和 retry budget 限制尝试次数；任何 late result 都按 call identity 与 ledger version 去重。 关键 crash window 位于“远端 effect commit”和“本地 outcome commit”之间。即使 runtime 先记录 intent 再派发，仍无法用本地事务包住外部系统。解决方式不是再加一次 prompt，而是让远端以 key 原子地查重并保存结果，或在 timeout 后按 business identifier 查询真实状态。 副作用执行的 crash windows 与恢复路径 runtime 先记录 intent，再发送带 idempotency key 的请求。远端查重、执行并保存结果。本地在保存 outcome 前崩溃时，重试同一 key 返回旧结果；若远端不支持 key，则进入 reconciliation。 record intent send key k remote dedup commit effect save outcome 危险窗口：effect 已发生，本地未知 重试 k → 返回已保存 outcome 无 key → query/reconcile/manual record accepted outcome once 原创示意：idempotency 必须覆盖 effect commit 与 result storage 的原子边界；仅在 client 端保存 key 不能防止远端重复执行。 part 1 established call ids, attempt ids, and outcome_unknown . part 2 established task groups, deadlines, cancellation, and bounded queues. today failure recovery enters the same state machine. the call id and idempotency key stay stable across retries; the attempt id changes. parent deadlines and retry budgets bound attempts. late results deduplicate against call identity and ledger version. the critical crash window lies between remote effect commit and local outcome commit. recording intent before dispatch does not let a local transaction encompass another system. the solution is not another prompt. the remote endpoint must atomically deduplicate by key and store the result, or the runtime must query actual state by a business identifier after timeout. crash windows and recovery paths for a side effect the runtime records intent and sends a request with an idempotency key. the remote system deduplicates, performs the effect, and stores the result. if the local process crashes before saving the outcome, retrying the key returns the previous result; without remote key support the runtime reconciles. record intent send key k remote dedup commit effect save outcome danger: effect committed, local state unknown retry k → return stored outcome no key → query/reconcile/manual record accepted outcome once original diagram: idempotency must cover the atomic boundary between effect commit and result storage. saving a key only on the client does not prevent duplicate remote execution. 机制：从 key 到恢复协议 mechanism: from a key to a recovery protocol 1. 生成稳定 identity operationid 标识业务级意图，例如“为订单 o 收款一次”；一个 operation 可含多个逻辑 tool calls。callid 标识其中一次逻辑工具调用，attemptid 标识该 call 的一次传输执行。idempotency key 可由 operationid 派生，但必须在所有 retries、worker handoff 与 replay 中保持不变；重新生成 key 就是新操作。 2. fingerprint 请求 ledger 同时保存 key 与 canonical request hash：tool/version、tenant、授权主体、规范化参数、目标 resource。相同 key+相同 hash 可返回已有状态；相同 key+不同 hash 必须拒绝，不能悄悄把旧 key 用于新金额或新收件人。敏感原文可外置加密，hash 只用于一致性而非授权。 3. 远端原子 dedup 理想 endpoint 在一个事务中执行：插入 key 的 in_progress （若不存在）、完成业务 effect、将 result/status 保存为 succeeded/failed 。重复请求读回相同 outcome。若 dedup record 与 effect 分属两个不能原子提交的存储，内部仍存在 crash window，需要 outbox/inbox 或业务 reconciliation。 4. retry classifier 只读操作可按 contract 对 transient failure 自动 retry；写操作必须能证明未提交，或由 effect owner 以同一 key 提供幂等保护，generic transient 标签本身不够。validation、authorization、semantic rejection 不重试；rate limit 遵守 retry-after；timeout/connection reset 对无保护且无法证明未提交的 effect 进入 unknown。classifier 由 tool contract 和错误类型决定，不由模型读 error string 后自由选择。 5. backoff、jitter 与 retry budget attempt 使用 exponential backoff 加随机 jitter，避免大量 agent 同时重试。max attempts、absolute deadline、per-tool token bucket 与全局 retry budget 同时约束。一个层级负责 retry；若 sdk、runtime、workflow 各自最多发出 3 个总 attempts（initial + 2 retries），最坏放大为 27 次；若每层是 initial + 3 retries，则是 4³=64 次。 6. checkpoint 与 replay checkpoint 保存 state version、event cursor、open calls、keys、attempts、deadlines 与 accepted outcomes。恢复时 reducer replay events 重建 decisions，但不直接重做 side effects；effect command 若已 recorded 未完成，则查询 ledger/tool 状态或以同一 key 重投。wall clock、随机数和模型响应必须作为历史 events 读取，而不是 replay 时重新生成。 7. reconciliation 当 tool 不支持 key，但提供查询 api，runtime 用 business key（orderid、messageid、externalreference）查询真实状态。结果唯一则补写 outcome；不存在且 deadline/budget 允许才考虑新 attempt；多条匹配或无法查询则进入 manual review。reconciliation 是一等 workflow，不是后台日志。 8. concurrent duplicates 与 in-progress lease 两个 attempts 可能同时携带同一 key 到达。ledger 的 unique insert 只能选出一个 owner；其余不能同时执行 effect，而应等待、返回 conflict/in-progress，或读取完成结果。owner 持有带 expiry 的 lease、heartbeat 与单调递增 fencing token；接管者通过 cas 提升 token。effect owner 若能校验 fencing token，应拒绝旧 token；若远端只支持 idempotency key，则 key 仍防重复 effect。两者都不支持时，lease expiry 和 reconciliation 不能排除旧 owner 复活并发，必须暂停自动接管或转人工。简单删除“卡住的 in_progress”会重新打开重复执行窗口。 9. poison work 与 dead-letter state 持续失败不应无限轮回。超过 attempt/deadline budget 后写入 retry_exhausted ，保存最后错误、attempt history 与下一操作建议；需要人工的进入 review queue。dead letter 不是垃圾桶：必须有 owner、slo、redrive policy，并在 redrive 时复用原 key 或显式创建经批准的新 operation。 10. compensation 不可撤销 effect 无法 rollback；saga 用后续业务动作补偿，例如退款、关闭工单、发送更正。compensation 自身也会失败、需要 idempotency，并可能不是严格逆操作。runtime 记录 compensation_required/in_progress/failed/completed ，不能把“已请求退款”展示成“原扣款从未发生”。 ondispatch(call): persistintent(call.id, key, requesthash) outcome = remote.execute(args, idempotencykey=key) persistoutcomeonce(call.id, outcome) onrecovery(call): if localoutcome(call): return it if remote.lookup(key): persistandreturn(remote.result(key)) if call.effectiskeyprotected && retrybudget.allows(): retrysamekey() else transitiontoreconciliationormanualreview() 1. generate a stable identity an operation id identifies business intent, such as “capture payment once for order
