o”; one operation may contain several logical tool calls. a call id identifies one logical tool invocation, and an attempt id identifies one transport execution of that call. an idempotency key may derive from the operation id, but it stays unchanged across retries, worker handoffs, and replay. a new key represents a new operation. 2. fingerprint the request the ledger stores the key with a canonical request hash: tool and version, tenant, authorization principal, normalized arguments, and target resource. same key plus same hash may return existing status. same key plus a different hash must be rejected; a key cannot silently move to a new amount or recipient. sensitive payloads may live in encrypted storage. a hash checks consistency, not authorization. 3. deduplicate atomically at the remote boundary an ideal endpoint runs one transaction: insert an in_progress key if absent, perform the business effect, and save result and status as succeeded or failed . a duplicate reads the same outcome. if the dedup record and effect live in stores that cannot commit atomically, an internal crash window remains and requires outbox, inbox, or business reconciliation. 4. classify retries a read-only operation may retry contract-declared transient failures. a write must either be proven uncommitted or be protected by effect-owner idempotency under the same key; a generic transient label alone is insufficient. validation, authorization, and semantic rejections do not retry. rate limiting respects retry-after. timeout and connection reset on an unprotected effect that cannot be proven uncommitted become unknown. the classifier comes from the tool contract and structured error type, not from a model improvising over an error string. 5. use backoff, jitter, and a retry budget attempts use exponential backoff plus random jitter so many agents do not retry simultaneously. maximum attempts, absolute deadline, per-tool token buckets, and a global retry budget all bound work. one layer owns retries. if an sdk, runtime, and workflow each issue three total attempts—initial plus two retries—worst-case amplification is twenty-seven. if each means initial plus three retries, it is 4³=64 requests. 6. checkpoint and replay a checkpoint stores state version, event cursor, open calls, keys, attempts, deadlines, and accepted outcomes. recovery replays events through reducers to rebuild decisions but does not directly repeat side effects. a recorded but incomplete effect command triggers a ledger or tool lookup, or redispatch with the same key. wall-clock readings, randomness, and model responses are consumed as historical events rather than regenerated during replay. 7. reconcile when a tool lacks key support but exposes a query api, the runtime searches by a business key such as order id, message id, or external reference. one unique result completes the local outcome. no result may permit a new attempt if deadline and budget allow. multiple matches or an unqueryable system enters manual review. reconciliation is a first-class workflow, not a background log. 8. concurrent duplicates and an in-progress lease two attempts may arrive with the same key concurrently. a unique ledger insert elects one owner. others must wait, return conflict or in-progress, or read the completed result rather than execute the effect too. the owner holds an expiring lease, heartbeats, and a monotonically increasing fencing token; takeover advances the token with compare-and-swap. an effect owner that supports fencing rejects stale tokens; otherwise a shared idempotency key still prevents duplicate effect. if neither is supported, lease expiry plus reconciliation cannot exclude a revived old owner, so automatic takeover must pause or escalate. simply deleting a stuck in-progress record reopens the duplicate-effect window. 9. poison work and a dead-letter state persistent failure must not loop forever. after attempt or deadline budget is exhausted, record retry_exhausted with the last error, attempt history, and next-action guidance. human-required work enters a review queue. a dead letter is not a trash can: it needs an owner, slo, and redrive policy. redrive reuses the original key or creates an explicitly approved new operation. 10. compensate an irreversible effect cannot be rolled back. a saga uses a later business action—refund, close ticket, send correction—to compensate. compensation can fail, needs idempotency, and may not be a strict inverse. the runtime records compensation_required , in_progress , failed , and completed . “refund requested” must not be displayed as “the charge never happened.” ondispatch(call): persistintent(call.id, key, requesthash) outcome = remote.execute(args, idempotencykey=key) persistoutcomeonce(call.id, outcome) onrecovery(call): if localoutcome(call): return it if remote.lookup(key): persistandreturn(remote.result(key)) if call.effectiskeyprotected && retrybudget.allows(): retrysamekey() else transitiontoreconciliationormanualreview() 必要数学：退避、放大与一致性不变量 essential math: backoff, amplification, and consistency invariants exponential backoff with full jitter b k = min(b max , b 0 ·2 k ), wait k ∼ u(0,b k ) k 是 attempt index， b₀ 是基础 delay， bmax 是上限。full jitter 的期望等待为 bₖ/2 ，把同步重试打散。backoff 只减轻压力，不让不可重试操作变安全；deadline 到期应停止。 truncated attempts e[n] = σ k=0 n−1 (1−q) k = (1−(1−q) n )/q 若每次独立成功概率为 q ，最多 n 次，期望发出次数如上。例如 q=0.8、n=3，e[n]=1.24。真实失败常相关且 retry 会改变负载，此式仅展示 amplification 直觉，不是容量预测。 layered retry amplification a max = ∏ l=1 m n l m 个层级各最多发出 nₗ 个总 attempts（包含 initial）时，一个用户 operation 最坏放大为乘积；若配置写的是 retry count rₗ ，则 nₗ=rₗ+1 。应在最了解 effect/idempotency 的层级集中 retry，其他层传递结构化状态。 idempotency invariant same(k) ∧ same(h(request)) ⇒ same(committed outcome) k 是 key， h 是 canonical fingerprint。若 key 相同但 hash 不同，必须 conflict；若相同，则多次 attempts 返回同一逻辑 outcome。ledger 的 unique constraint 与 effect transaction 共同维护 invariant，而不是模型承诺。 retention bound ttl dedup ≥ max retry horizon + max message delay + clock/error margin dedup record 删除过早，迟到 retry 会被当新操作；保存过久增加成本与隐私风险。ttl 必须覆盖所有 transport/workflow 的最大重试与延迟窗口，并与业务审计、数据删除 policy 协调。 exponential backoff with full jitter b k = min(b max , b 0 ·2 k ), wait k ∼ u(0,b k ) k is the attempt index, b₀ the base delay, and bmax the cap. full jitter has expected wait bₖ/2 and spreads synchronized retries. backoff reduces pressure; it does not make an unsafe operation retryable. stop at the deadline. truncated attempts e[n] = σ k=0 n−1 (1−q) k = (1−(1−q) n )/q if attempts independently succeed with probability q and at most n are issued, expected attempts follow the expression. at q=0.8 and n=3, e[n]=1.24. real failures are correlated and retries alter load, so this illustrates amplification rather than predicting capacity. layered retry amplification a max = ∏ l=1 m n l if m layers each issue at most nₗ total attempts including the initial one, one user operation amplifies to their product in the worst case. if configuration specifies retry count rₗ , then nₗ=rₗ+1 . centralize retries in the layer that understands effect and idempotency; other layers propagate structured state. the idempotency invariant same(k) ∧ same(h(request)) ⇒ same(committed outcome) k is the key and h a canonical fingerprint. same key with a different hash is a conflict. same key and hash makes many attempts return one logical outcome. a unique ledger constraint and the effect transaction maintain the invariant—not a model promise. a retention bound ttl dedup ≥ max retry horizon + max message delay + clock/error margin deleting a dedup record too soon turns a late retry into a new operation. retaining it too long increases cost and privacy exposure. ttl covers the maximum retry and delivery windows across transports and workflows while respecting audit and deletion policy. 对 agent 系统的影响 implications for agent systems 1. tool contract 必须声明 retry semantics metadata 包含 effect class、是否支持 idempotency key、key scope/ttl、lookup api、retryable errors 与 compensation。缺失这些信息时，runtime 对写操作默认不自动 retry。模型说“再试一次”不能覆盖 contract。 2. key 绑定已授权的精确 intent 用户批准金额 10 和收件人 a 后生成 request fingerprint；模型后续改变任一参数必须新 approval/new operation，而不是沿用旧 key。key 不是 capability token，也不能跨 tenant 重用。 3. checkpoint 不应复制 secrets 持久化 key reference、credential handle 与 encrypted payload pointer，不把 access token 写入 event log。恢复时重新解析短期 credential，并再次验证 authorization 是否仍有效；旧 checkpoint 不赋予永久权限。 4. late result 仍有价值 timeout 后进入 reconciliation 的 call 若收到 late success，应通过 ledger 完成，而不是丢弃；若 compensation 已启动，则状态机需决定接受原结果、继续补偿或人工介入。arrival order 不能绕过 version guard。 5. ui 必须展示 certainty level 区分“重试中”“结果未知”“正在核对”“补偿中”“已补偿”与“成功/失败”。把 outcome_unknown 显示成失败会诱导用户重复操作；把 compensation requested 显示成已恢复会掩盖风险。 6. evals 必须故障注入 在 intent commit 前后、remote effect 前后、result commit 前后杀进程；注入重复 delivery、迟到 response、ledger ttl expiry、429 与 lookup 不一致。只测 happy path 无法证明 recovery protocol。 7. 模型不负责 retry classifier llm 可解释错误或提出人工建议，但 retry/reconcile/compensate transition 由确定性 policy 决定。否则模型的随机文本会成为重复副作用的控制面。 8. recovery telemetry 要区分原因 分别统计 initial attempt success、key dedup hit、transient retry success、unknown outcome、reconciliation resolution、compensation success 与 manual queue age。一个总“tool success rate”会掩盖系统靠大量重试或人工补救维持成功。trace 用 operation/call/attempt/key-reference 关联，但日志不记录原始 key 或敏感 payload。 1. a tool contract declares retry semantics metadata includes effect class, idempotency-key support, key scope and ttl, lookup api, retryable errors, and compensation. when this information is missing, the runtime defaults to no automatic retry for writes. a model saying “try again” cannot override the contract. 2. bind the key to the exact authorized intent after the user approves amount 10 and recipient a, create the request fingerprint. if the model changes either argument, it needs new approval and a new operation rather than reusing the key. a key is not a capability token and cannot cross tenants. 3. a checkpoint should not copy secrets persist key references, credential handles, and encrypted payload pointers—not access tokens in the event log. on recovery, resolve short-lived credentials again and verify authorization remains valid. an old checkpoint grants no permanent authority. 4. late results remain valuable if a call under reconciliation receives a late success, complete it through the ledger rather than discarding it. if compensation has started, the state machine decides whether to accept the original result, continue compensation, or escalate. arrival order cannot bypass a version guard. 5. the ui displays certainty levels distinguish retrying, outcome unknown, reconciling, compensating, compensated, succeeded, and failed. showing unknown as failed encourages duplicate action; showing compensation requested as restored conceals risk. 6. evaluations inject faults kill the process before and after intent commit, remote effect, and result commit. inject duplicate delivery, late responses, ledger ttl expiry, 429s, and lookup disagreement. a happy-path test cannot establish a recovery protocol. 7. the model does not own the retry classifier an llm may explain an error or suggest human action, but deterministic policy owns retry, reconcile, and compensate transitions. otherwise stochastic prose becomes the control plane for duplicate side effects. 8. recovery telemetry separates causes measure initial-attempt success, key deduplication hits, transient-retry success, unknown outcomes, reconciliation resolution, compensation success, and manual-queue age separately. one tool-success rate can hide a system sustained by heavy retries or manual repair. traces correlate operation, call, attempt, and key references without logging raw keys or sensitive payloads. 取舍与失败模式 trade-offs and failure modes long key retention vs privacy/cost： 长 ttl 覆盖迟到 retry，却扩大存储与敏感 metadata 暴露。使用最小 fingerprint、加密 payload、按业务风险设置 retention，并让 expiry 后的 retry 进入人工确认而非新执行。 key entropy 与 scope： key 必须难以猜测且仅在明确 tenant/tool scope 内唯一，防止他人通过枚举 key 读取旧结果。server 仍需正常 authentication/authorization；知道 key 不等于有权访问 outcome。 cached failure vs retry： 有些 provider 对同 key 缓存首个 terminal failure；有些只缓存成功。contract 必须明确。若 validation failure 被永久缓存，修正参数需要新 operation/key；不能用相同 key 偷换 payload。 replay determinism vs code evolution： 旧 history 用新 reducer replay 可能产生不同 commands。version workflow code、upcast events，并在 deployment 前 replay corpus。无法兼容时让旧任务留在旧 worker 或显式 migration。 automatic compensation vs human control： 自动退款/撤销降低恢复时间，却可能在原 outcome 迟到时产生第二个错误。高价值或不可逆操作需要 reconciliation barrier 和人工审批。 reconciliation read consistency： 查询 api 可能 eventual consistent，立即查不到不等于 effect 不存在。contract 应给 visibility delay、pagination 与唯一性字段；runtime 在安全窗口内重复 query，而不是看到一次空结果就重新执行。 remote idempotency vs local dedup： 本地 ledger 防止同 runtime 重复 dispatch，但不能阻止另一个 client 或远端在 ack 丢失时重复 effect。真正边界必须靠 effect owner；本地记录只是其中一层。 exactly-once within one log vs across systems： 同一事务域可原子提交 input offset、state 与 output；跨数据库、支付、邮件系统时则需要各方 transaction/idempotency，或接受 at-least-once + dedup + reconciliation。不要把消息系统的 exactly-once label 外推到业务效果。 最危险的失败模式： 每次 retry 生成新 key；key 不绑定 payload；dedup ttl 短于 retry horizon；sdk/runtime/workflow 多层重试；replay 重新调用模型与工具；compensation 被当作 rollback；unknown 被 ui 显示为 failed。 long key retention versus privacy and cost: long ttl covers late retries while expanding storage and sensitive-metadata exposure. use minimal fingerprints, encrypted payloads, and risk-based retention. a retry after expiry should require confirmation rather than execute as new. key entropy and scope: keys must be unguessable and unique inside an explicit tenant and tool scope so another party cannot enumerate keys to retrieve old results. the server still performs normal authentication and authorization; knowing a key does not grant access to its outcome. cached failure versus retry: some providers cache the first terminal failure for a key; others cache only success. the contract must say. if a validation failure is cached, corrected arguments need a new operation and key; the same key cannot hide a changed payload. replay determinism versus code evolution: replaying old history under a new reducer can emit different commands. version workflow code, upcast events, and replay a corpus before deployment. incompatible old tasks stay on old workers or pass an explicit migration. automatic compensation versus human control: automatic refund or reversal shortens recovery while a late original outcome can create a second error. high-value or irreversible operations need a reconciliation barrier and human approval. reconciliation read consistency: a query api may be eventually consistent, so one empty read does not prove the effect is absent. the contract defines visibility delay, pagination, and unique fields. the runtime repeats queries through a safe window rather than re-executing after one miss. remote idempotency versus local deduplication: a local ledger stops one runtime from dispatching twice but cannot stop another client or a remote service from duplicating an effect after acknowledgement loss. the effect owner defines the true boundary; the local ledger is one layer. exactly once inside one log versus across systems: one transaction domain can atomically commit input offset, state, and output. across databases, payments, and email, participants need transactions or idempotency—or the design accepts at-least-once plus deduplication and reconciliation. do not extrapolate a messaging system’s exactly-once label to a business effect. the most dangerous failure modes: creating a new key for every retry; failing to bind key to payload; dedup ttl shorter than retry horizon; sdk, runtime, and workflow all retrying; replay calling models and tools again; treating compensation as rollback; showing unknown as failed. 可复用判断 reusable judgments timeout 表示 acknowledgement 未到，不表示副作用未发生；非幂等写入应进入 outcome_unknown。 逻辑 operation/call 使用稳定 key，attempt 使用独立 identity；key 必须绑定 canonical request fingerprint。 retry 对只读 transient failure 生效；写操作还必须证明未提交或受 effect-owner idempotency 保护，并受 backoff、jitter、deadline 与 retry budget 约束。 checkpoint replay 重建 decisions，不重复 side effects；未决命令先 lookup/reconcile，再决定是否同 key 重投。 compensation 是新的、可能失败的业务动作，不是时间倒流；exactly-once effect 需要 effect owner 参与。 a timeout means acknowledgement did not arrive, not that the effect did not happen. a non-idempotent write becomes outcome unknown. a logical operation or call uses a stable key; attempts have separate identities. the key binds a canonical request fingerprint. retry read-only transient failures, or writes proven uncommitted or protected by effect-owner idempotency, all bounded by backoff, jitter, deadlines, and retry budgets. checkpoint replay rebuilds decisions without repeating side effects. pending commands lookup or reconcile before redispatch with the same key. compensation is a new business action that can fail, not time reversal. exactly-once effect requires participation from the effect owner. 一手资料 primary sources ietf httpapi idempotency-key draft — http idempotency key、fingerprint、expiry 与错误场景的工作组草案；目前标记为 expired/archived internet-draft，不是最终 rfc；仅用于设计语义参考。 stripe idempotent requests — 官方 api 文档展示 key/result retention 与参数不一致检查；行为只代表 stripe contract。 aws builders' library: timeouts, retries, and backoff with jitter — 官方工程文章讨论 retry amplification、backoff、jitter 与 token bucket。 apache kafka delivery semantics — 官方文档区分 at-most-once、at-least-once 与 kafka transaction 范围内的 exactly-once semantics。 temporal activity documentation — 官方说明 activity retries、idempotency 与 durable workflow interaction；具体保证属于 temporal。 durable functions orchestrator code constraints — 官方说明 replay、deterministic orchestrator 与 side effects 放入 activity。 garcia-molina & salem, sagas — 长事务拆分与 compensation 的经典论文。 dedup ledger schema、agent retry classifier、certainty ui 与 recovery state names 是本文基于这些协议/系统原则的编辑性综合。 ietf httpapi idempotency-key draft — the working-group draft covers http idempotency keys, fingerprints, expiry, and error scenarios. it is currently marked expired and archived, not a final rfc, and is used only as design-semantics reference. stripe idempotent requests — official api documentation illustrating key and result retention plus parameter mismatch checks. behavior is specific to stripe’s contract. aws builders' library: timeouts, retries, and backoff with jitter — an official engineering article about retry amplification, backoff, jitter, and token buckets. apache kafka delivery semantics — official documentation distinguishing at-most-once, at-least-once, and exactly-once semantics inside kafka’s transaction scope. temporal activity documentation — official documentation for activity retries, idempotency, and durable workflow interaction. concrete guarantees are temporal-specific. durable functions orchestrator code constraints — officially documents replay, deterministic orchestrators, and moving side effects into activities. garcia-molina & salem, sagas — the classic paper on decomposing long transactions and compensation. the deduplication-ledger schema, agent retry classifier, certainty ui, and recovery-state names are editorial synthesis from these protocol and systems principles. 已建立与下一篇起点 what is established and where we continue 今天已建立： 稳定 idempotency key + request fingerprint + effect-owner dedup ledger 将多次 attempts 收敛为一个业务 outcome；retry 由确定性 classifier、backoff/jitter、deadline 与 budget 控制；checkpoint replay 不重复 effects，ambiguous calls 通过 lookup/reconciliation/compensation 恢复。 尚未讲完： 当任务持续数小时或数天、跨审批、部署和外部回调时，control plane 如何管理 leases、timers、signals、versioning、human-in-the-loop 与 observability，并证明任务最终收敛？ 下一篇起点： agent runtime 内核 4/4 将完成本系列：长运行 execution control plane、durable timers、human approval、workflow versioning、supervision、terminal verification 与运行手册。 established today: a stable idempotency key, request fingerprint, and effect-owner deduplication ledger converge several attempts into one business outcome. a deterministic classifier, backoff and jitter, deadline, and budget control retries. checkpoint replay does not repeat effects; ambiguous calls recover through lookup, reconciliation, and compensation. still unresolved: when a task spans hours or days, approvals, deployments, and external callbacks, how does the control plane manage leases, timers, signals, versioning, human involvement, and observability—and prove eventual convergence? next starting point: agent runtime internals 4/4 will complete the series with the long-running execution control plane: durable timers, human approval, workflow versioning, supervision, terminal verification, and operational runbooks.

title.zh: 并行工具调用，为什么不能只是 Promise.all？
title.en: Why Parallel Tool Calls Are More Than Promise.all

text: 并行工具调用，为什么不能只是 promise.all？ why parallel tool calls are more than promise.all agent runtime 内核 agent runtime internals structured concurrency cancellation backpressure agent scheduler tool parallelism 今日命题 today's proposition 模型一次返回多个 tool calls，不代表它们应该立刻并行。调用之间可能有数据依赖、共享资源冲突、不同风险等级和不同 deadline。无界 promise.all 会同时占满连接池、打爆下游 rate limit；其中一个失败后，其他调用仍可能继续产生副作用；父任务取消时，孤儿请求可能继续运行并在更晚回写过期结果。 structured concurrency 的核心不是某个语言 api，而是生命周期原则：子任务必须属于一个可命名 scope；父 scope 在退出前知道所有子任务的终态；deadline、cancellation 和 failure policy 沿结构传播；并发度由 runtime budget 约束，而不是由模型生成多少 calls 决定。 核心判断： 并行是一种资源与一致性策略，不是性能按钮。模型可以提出“这些工作看似独立”，但 runtime 必须验证 dependency、effect class、resource key、budget 和 join policy 后，才决定哪些 calls 真正并发。 a model returning several tool calls in one response does not mean they should all start immediately. calls can have data dependencies, conflicts on shared resources, different risk classes, and different deadlines. an unbounded promise.all can exhaust connection pools and downstream rate limits. when one call fails, siblings may continue producing side effects. when a parent task is cancelled, orphaned requests may keep running and write stale results later. the core of structured concurrency is not a particular language api but a lifetime principle: every child belongs to a named scope; the parent knows every child’s terminal state before leaving; deadlines, cancellation, and failure policy propagate through the structure; and concurrency is bounded by runtime budgets rather than by however many calls the model generated. core judgment: parallelism is a resource and consistency policy, not a performance switch. a model may propose that work appears independent, but the runtime must validate dependencies, effect classes, resource keys, budgets, and join policy before deciding which calls truly run concurrently. 承接显式状态机 continue from the explicit state machine 上一篇把单个 tool call 展开成 proposed→validated→authorized→recorded→dispatched→outcome。多个 calls 出现时，runtime 不只是复制这条 lifecycle，而要建立一个 execution graph：节点是逻辑 calls，边表示“b 必须读取 a 的 accepted outcome”；没有依赖边也不保证可以并发，因为两个节点可能写同一文件、同一订单或同一用户记录。 因此 state 中需要 task group、dependency edges、resource claims、child deadlines 与 join policy。事件不再只有 toolresultobserved ，还包括 childstarted 、 cancellationrequested 、 childcancelled 、 joinsatisfied 和 capacityreleased 。父 turn 只有在 join 条件满足后，才能构造一致的 observation 给模型。 受限 agent tool dag 与 task group 父 scope 的第一层包含三个工具任务，其中两个在并发上限内运行、一个排队；下游汇总任务依赖搜索结果，写入任务还依赖其他结果并需要资源锁。所有子任务在 join 或 cancellation 后汇总为一个有序 observation。 parent task group · deadline · concurrency=2 a · search docs b · fetch profile c · queue waiting d · summarize(a) e · write(resource k) join → deterministic observation order 原创示意：dag 表达数据依赖，resource key 表达隐藏冲突，并发上限表达容量。三者是不同约束，不能只看模型是否把 calls 放在同一数组。 the previous installment expanded one tool call into proposed, validated, authorized, recorded, dispatched, and outcome states. with several calls, the runtime does more than replicate that lifecycle. it builds an execution graph: nodes are logical calls, and an edge says that b must consume a’s accepted outcome. missing dependency edges still do not prove calls can run together; two nodes may write the same file, order, or user record. state therefore needs a task group, dependency edges, resource claims, child deadlines, and a join policy. events now include not only toolresultobserved but childstarted , cancellationrequested , childcancelled , joinsatisfied , and capacityreleased . a parent turn constructs one coherent model observation only after the join condition is satisfied. a bounded agent tool dag and task group a parent scope contains three initial tool tasks. two may run under the concurrency limit while one waits. another task depends on search output and a write task needs a resource lock. children join or cancel before producing one ordered observation. parent task group · deadline · concurrency=2 a · search docs b · fetch profile c · queue waiting d · summarize(a) e · write(resource k) join → deterministic observation order original diagram: the dag expresses data dependency, a resource key expresses hidden conflict, and a concurrency limit expresses capacity. these are different constraints; the model placing calls in one array proves none of them. 机制：一个 bounded scheduler mechanism: a bounded scheduler 1. 先验证 graph runtime 将模型 proposal 编译成内部 dag，检查 call id 唯一、依赖存在、无 cycle、tool schema 合法、权限已满足。模型引用未知 node 或产生环时，返回结构化 planning error，而不是执行一半再发现。 2. 计算 ready set 只有所有 predecessors 达到 join policy 所需状态的 node 才 ready。默认要求 dependencies succeeded；也可显式定义“任一成功”“允许 partial failure”或“finally/compensation”。join semantics 属于 runtime contract，不能从自然语言猜。 3. 取得多层 capacity scheduler 同时检查 global concurrency、tenant quota、tool-specific semaphore 与 resource key。读工具可能共享，写同一对象需要互斥或 optimistic version。取得 capacity 后先记录 childstarted ，再 dispatch；正常完成或异常返回时用 finally 释放 permit；进程崩溃无法执行 finally，因此分布式 permit 需要带 owner 与 expiry 的 lease，并由 reaper/reconciliation 回收。 4. deadline 与 timeout deadline 是父 scope 的绝对最晚时间；child timeout 是单次 operation 的局部预算。child deadline 应为 min(parent deadline, now+tool timeout) 。排队时间也消耗 deadline，不能等真正发出请求才开始计时。若剩余时间不足完成有意义的工作，scheduler 应拒绝启动。 5. cancellation propagation 父 cancel 先改变 durable state，使新 children 不再启动，再向 running children 发送 cancellation token。协作式 tool 在安全点停止并返回 acknowledgement；不可取消或已经提交副作用的工具进入 cancelling / outcome_unknown ，等待 reconcile。不能把取消 promise 当作副作用已撤销。 6. failure policy 与 sibling fate fail-fast 在关键 child 失败时取消 siblings； collect-all 等所有结果并聚合； quorum 在获得足够成功后取消剩余读取。policy 应按 group 声明。写操作通常不能因为 sibling 失败就盲目 cancel；可能需要补偿或人工介入。 7. backpressure ready nodes 不直接变成 running，而进入有界 queue。queue 满时，producer 等待或减速才是 backpressure；入队前拒绝、降级或减少计划属于 admission control/load shedding。两者共同防止无限堆内存。dispatcher 根据 capacity 拉取（pull/demand），tool 返回 429/503 或 latency 上升时减少 permits。模型只收到“capacity deferred” observation，不获得提高 limit 的权限。 8. deterministic join 并发完成顺序不应随机改变 prompt。runtime 按 node id、dependency topology 或计划顺序稳定排列 accepted outcomes，并显式标记 cancelled/failed/missing。若 partial results 已经流给模型，必须记录每次 projection version，避免后来的结果使旧决策看似基于完整信息。 while group.open: ready = graph.nodeswithsatisfieddependencies(state) for node in stableorder(ready): if budget.expired(node): recordskipped(node) else if capacity.tryacquire(node.tool, node.resourcekey): recordstarted(node) spawninscope(node, childdeadline(node)) event = await nextchildeventorcancellation() state = reduce(state, event) applyfailureandjoinpolicy(state) 1. validate the graph first the runtime compiles the model proposal into an internal dag and verifies unique call ids, existing dependencies, acyclicity, valid tool schemas, and satisfied authorization. an unknown node reference or cycle returns a structured planning error rather than being discovered after half the graph executes. 2. compute the ready set a node becomes ready only when every predecessor satisfies the declared join policy. the default may require all dependencies to succeed; alternatives explicitly permit any-success, partial failure, or finally and compensation behavior. join semantics belong to the runtime contract and must not be inferred from prose. 3. acquire layered capacity the scheduler checks global concurrency, tenant quota, a tool-specific semaphore, and resource keys. reads may share; writes to the same object need exclusion or optimistic versions. after capacity is acquired, record childstarted before dispatch. release permits in a finally path on normal completion or exceptions. a process crash cannot execute finally, so distributed permits need owner-and-expiry leases plus reaping or reconciliation. 4. deadlines and timeouts a deadline is the parent scope’s absolute latest time. a child timeout is a local budget for one operation. the child deadline is min(parent deadline, now + tool timeout) . queueing consumes deadline too; timing must not begin only when a request is sent. if remaining time cannot support meaningful work, the scheduler should refuse to start. 5. cancellation propagation parent cancellation first changes durable state so no new child starts, then signals running children. a cooperative tool stops at a safe point and acknowledges. a non-cancellable tool—or one whose side effect may already be committed—enters cancelling or outcome_unknown and awaits reconciliation. cancelling a promise does not prove a business effect was undone. 6. failure policy and sibling fate fail-fast cancels siblings after a critical child fails. collect-all waits and aggregates every result. quorum cancels remaining reads after enough successes. the group declares its policy. writes generally cannot be blindly cancelled because a sibling failed; compensation or human intervention may be required. 7. backpressure ready nodes enter a bounded queue rather than becoming running immediately. when full, making the producer wait or slow down is backpressure. rejecting, degrading, or shrinking a plan before enqueueing is admission control or load shedding. together they prevent unbounded memory growth. a dispatcher pulls according to capacity. it lowers permits when tools return 429 or 503 or latency rises. the model receives a “capacity deferred” observation but no permission to raise limits. 8. deterministic join concurrent completion order should not randomly reorder the prompt. the runtime orders accepted outcomes by node id, dependency topology, or plan order and explicitly marks cancelled, failed, and missing nodes. if partial results are streamed to the model, record every projection version so a later result cannot make an earlier decision appear to have used complete information. while group.open: ready = graph.nodeswithsatisfieddependencies(state) for node in stableorder(ready): if budget.expired(node): recordskipped(node) else if capacity.tryacquire(node.tool, node.resourcekey): recordstarted(node) spawninscope(node, childdeadline(node)) event = await nextchildeventorcancellation() state = reduce(state, event) applyfailureandjoinpolicy(state) 必要数学：关键路径、队列与失败放大 essential math: critical paths, queues, and failure amplification dag critical path t min ≥ max path p σ i∈p t i tᵢ 是节点服务时间。即使无限并发，总延迟也不能短于最长依赖路径；只并行非关键节点可能几乎不降 latency。真实时间还加 queue、serialization 与 join overhead。 little's law l = λw l 是系统平均在途请求数， λ 是稳定到达率， w 是平均停留时间。若工具每秒接收 10 个 calls、平均停留 2 秒，平均约 20 个在途。little's law 本身只关联稳定状态下的平均量。agent fan-out 可提高 λ，下游变慢可提高 w，从而提高 l；无界 queue 可能持续积压，而有界 queue 会饱和并阻塞或拒绝。并发上限必须结合测得 latency，而非固定拍脑袋。 utilization ρ = λ / (cμ) 1 c 是并行 worker/permit 数， μ 是单 worker 服务率。对无界 queue，长期 ρ≥1 意味着 arrival 超过 capacity 并持续积压；有界 queue 则会饱和，转为阻塞、降级或拒绝。接近 1 时 tail latency 通常急剧恶化。backpressure 的目标不是让所有 worker 永远 100% busy，而是维持可恢复余量。 fan-out failure p(any failure) = 1 − (1−p) n 若 n 个独立 calls 各以概率 p 失败，至少一个失败的概率随 fan-out 增长：p=1%、n=50 时约 39.5%。现实失败常相关（同一 outage/rate limit），此时独立公式不再适用；正相关通常放大同时多节点失败的 blast radius，但不保证至少一次失败概率相对独立估计只向一个方向变化。parallelism 提高速度的同时扩大 failure surface。 deadline allocation d child = min(d parent , now + b tool ) d 是绝对 deadline， b tool 是局部 timeout budget。传递绝对 deadline 比层层重置 timeout 更能防止嵌套调用超出用户总预算。还应预留 join、verification 与 persistence 时间，不能把全部剩余时间给最后一个 tool。 the dag critical path t min ≥ max path p σ i∈p t i tᵢ is node service time. even with unlimited parallelism, total latency cannot be shorter than the longest dependency path. parallelizing only non-critical nodes may barely improve latency. real time also includes queueing, serialization, and join overhead. little's law l = λw l is average work in the system, λ the stable arrival rate, and w average time in system. if a tool receives ten calls per second and each spends two seconds, average in-flight work is about twenty. little's law itself only relates stable averages. agent fan-out can raise λ and a slower dependency can raise w, thereby raising l. an unbounded queue may accumulate, while a bounded queue saturates and blocks or rejects. concurrency limits must use observed latency rather than intuition alone. utilization ρ = λ / (cμ) 1 c is worker or permit count and μ one worker’s service rate. with an unbounded queue, sustained ρ≥1 means arrivals exceed capacity and backlog accumulates. a bounded queue instead saturates and turns excess load into blocking, degradation, or rejection. near one, tail latency generally deteriorates sharply. backpressure aims for recoverable headroom, not permanent 100 percent utilization. fan-out failure p(any failure) = 1 − (1−p) n if n independent calls each fail with probability p , at least one failure becomes more likely with fan-out. at p=1 percent and n=50 it is about 39.5 percent. real failures are often correlated by the same outage or rate limit, so the independence formula no longer applies. positive correlation commonly increases the blast radius of simultaneous failures, but it does not guarantee that the probability of at least one failure moves in only one direction relative to the independent estimate. parallelism reduces time while expanding the failure surface. deadline allocation d child = min(d parent , now + b tool ) d is an absolute deadline and b tool a local timeout budget. propagating absolute deadlines prevents nested calls from resetting timeouts beyond the user’s total budget. reserve time for joining, verification, and persistence rather than giving the final tool every remaining millisecond. 对 agent 系统的影响 implications for agent systems 1. tool metadata 必须包含 scheduling contract 除了 input schema，还应声明 read/write effect、resource-key extractor、default timeout、cancellation capability、retry class、rate-limit bucket 与 max concurrency。模型看简化描述，runtime 使用可信 metadata；不能让模型自报“我是只读”。 2. 计划与调度分离 planner 输出 dependency/rationale，但 scheduler 独立验证 dag 和 capacity。被拒绝的并行建议返回原因，例如 cyclic dependency、conflicting write 或 budget exhausted，让模型重新规划，而不是扩大权限。 3. partial result 需要版本语义 早到结果可以加速下一步，但模型基于 projection v3 做出的动作不能在 v5 到来后被重新解释。后续结果若推翻前提，应产生 invalidation event，取消尚未执行的 descendants，并让 runtime 显式 replan。 4. cancellation 必须可观察 记录 requested、signal-delivered、acknowledged、effect-reconciled 四个时间点。用户看到“正在取消”比虚假的瞬时完成更正确。tool manifest 应说明 cancel 是停止等待、停止计算，还是能撤回业务动作。 5. fairness 防止一个 agent 垄断资源 global semaphore 不够；一个高 fan-out task 可能占满所有 permits。按 tenant/task 做 weighted fair queue 或 per-task cap，并为交互请求保留容量。queue position 与 estimated start 可成为 observation，避免模型通过重复 calls 争抢。 6. result ordering 是 prompt determinism 的一部分 同一批并发结果若按到达顺序 append，网络抖动会改变 prompt、后续 logits 和 tool trajectory。稳定 join order、explicit timestamps 与 call ids 能减少无意义 nondeterminism，同时保留真实完成时间供诊断。 7. rate limit 是共享状态 429 不是单 call 私有错误。runtime 更新 tool/tenant bucket，暂停相关 queue 并遵守 retry-after；若每个 child 独立 backoff，会形成 retry storm。模型不应反复换同义 call 绕过 quota。 8. admission control 发生在入队前 backpressure 若只在 worker 端生效，queue 仍会吞掉内存和 deadline。runtime 在接受 graph 时估算节点数、cost、tool bucket 与用户剩余预算；超限时拒绝整图、裁剪低价值 speculative nodes，或拆成需要审批的 batch。被拒绝必须成为 durable event，防止重启后又重新接受同一计划。 9. bulkhead 隔离故障域 搜索、浏览器、数据库写入和外部通知不应共享一个 semaphore/queue。为每类 dependency 建 bulkhead，使慢浏览器不会耗尽数据库 permit，高 fan-out 搜索也不会阻塞审批回调。global budget 仍在上层约束总量，避免每个隔舱都各自满载后共同压垮进程。 10. 相同读取可以 coalesce 多个 children 若请求相同的纯读取且 freshness/authorization scope 一致，scheduler 可共享一个 in-flight future，并把结果 fan-out 给多个 call ids。coalescing 不是缓存：任一调用取消不应自动取消仍有订阅者的底层请求；写操作、不同租户或不同授权上下文不能合并。记录共享关系才能正确审计成本和 provenance。 1. tool metadata needs a scheduling contract beyond input schemas, declare read or write effect, resource-key extraction, default timeout, cancellation capability, retry class, rate-limit bucket, and maximum concurrency. the model sees a simplified description while the runtime uses trusted metadata. the model cannot self-declare that a call is read-only. 2. separate planning from scheduling the planner proposes dependencies and rationale; the scheduler independently validates the dag and capacity. rejected parallelism returns a reason—cyclic dependency, conflicting write, or exhausted budget—so the model can replan without gaining authority. 3. partial results need version semantics an early result can accelerate the next step, but an action based on projection v3 cannot later appear to have used v5. when a later result invalidates an assumption, emit an invalidation event, cancel undispatched descendants, and make replanning explicit. 4. cancellation must be observable record requested, signal-delivered, acknowledged, and effect-reconciled timestamps. “cancelling” is more honest than false instant completion. a tool manifest states whether cancellation stops waiting, stops computation, or can reverse a business action. 5. fairness prevents one agent from monopolizing capacity a global semaphore is insufficient; one high-fan-out task can consume every permit. use weighted fair queues or per-task caps and reserve capacity for interactive work. queue position and estimated start may become observations so repeated calls cannot win a race for quota. 6. result order is part of prompt determinism if concurrent results are appended in arrival order, network jitter changes the prompt, later logits, and the tool trajectory. stable join order, explicit timestamps, and call ids reduce meaningless nondeterminism while retaining real completion times for diagnosis. 7. a rate limit is shared state a 429 is not a private error for one call. the runtime updates the tool or tenant bucket, pauses related queues, and respects retry-after. independent child backoff can create a retry storm. the model must not bypass quota by generating synonymous calls. 8. admission control happens before enqueueing backpressure applied only at workers still lets the queue consume memory and deadlines. when accepting a graph, the runtime estimates node count, cost, tool buckets, and remaining user budget. it can reject the graph, remove low-value speculative nodes, or split work into an approval-gated batch. rejection is a durable event so restart cannot silently accept the same plan. 9. bulkheads isolate failure domains search, browser work, database writes, and external notifications should not share one semaphore and queue. separate bulkheads prevent a slow browser from consuming database permits and high-fan-out search from blocking approval callbacks. a global budget still caps the aggregate so every compartment cannot saturate the process simultaneously. 10. identical reads may be coalesced if several children request the same pure read under identical freshness and authorization scopes, the scheduler may share one in-flight future and fan the result out to several call ids. coalescing is not caching: cancelling one subscriber must not cancel the underlying request while others remain. writes, different tenants, or different authorization contexts cannot be merged. recording the sharing relationship preserves cost attribution and provenance. 取舍与失败模式 trade-offs and failure modes 并发度 vs tail latency： 增加 permits 可降低 queue time，直到下游饱和；之后 contention、429 和重试让 p95/p99 更差。寻找 knee point，而不是最大吞吐数字。 fail-fast vs useful partial work： 搜索类 fan-out 可在一个失败后保留其他结果；事务链的关键 prerequisite 失败应阻止 descendants。统一策略会浪费信息或放大错误。 cancellation responsiveness vs consistency： 频繁检查 token 能快速取消，但增加代码和状态；不可分割事务保证一致性却延迟响应。清楚标注 safe points 和不可取消区间。 static dag vs adaptive replanning： 静态图易验证、审计；agent 根据 partial result 动态加节点更灵活。每次扩图必须形成新 graph version，重新检查 cycle、budget 和 authorization，不能原地偷偷修改。 queue durability vs overhead： 内存 queue 快但进程崩溃丢失；durable queue 可恢复却增加序列化、租约和重复 delivery。副作用 calls 通常需要 durable command；可重新推导的只读 speculative work 可以短暂。 resource locks vs optimistic concurrency： 锁避免冲突但可能死锁、降低并发；version check 允许并发读取/计算，提交时可能重做。对外部 api 若无 version/idempotency 支持，runtime 的本地锁无法协调其他系统写入者。 最危险的失败模式： unbounded fan-out；父结束后 orphan children；cancel 被当作 rollback；排队不计 deadline；到达顺序改变 prompt；重复 429 各自重试；写冲突被模型“合理化”。这些是 scheduler/control-plane 缺陷，不是更强模型能消除的问题。 concurrency versus tail latency: more permits reduce queue time until the dependency saturates; then contention, 429s, and retries worsen p95 and p99. find the knee rather than maximizing one throughput number. fail-fast versus useful partial work: search fan-out can retain other results after one failure; a failed critical prerequisite in a transaction chain must block descendants. one policy either wastes information or amplifies errors. cancellation responsiveness versus consistency: frequent token checks cancel quickly but add code and state. an indivisible transaction protects consistency while delaying cancellation. declare safe points and non-cancellable regions. static dag versus adaptive replanning: a static graph is easy to validate and audit. dynamically adding nodes from partial results is flexible, but every expansion creates a new graph version and repeats cycle, budget, and authorization checks. it cannot mutate invisibly. durable queues versus overhead: an in-memory queue is fast but disappears with the process. a durable queue recovers while adding serialization, leases, and duplicate delivery. side-effect commands generally need durability; recomputable read-only speculation may remain ephemeral. resource locks versus optimistic concurrency: locks prevent conflict but reduce concurrency and can deadlock. version checks permit parallel reading and computation but may redo work at commit. if an external api lacks version or idempotency support, a local lock cannot coordinate other writers. the most dangerous failure modes: unbounded fan-out; orphan children after parent exit; treating cancel as rollback; ignoring queue time in deadlines; arrival order changing prompts; independent retries after 429; asking the model to rationalize write conflicts. these are scheduler and control-plane defects that a stronger model cannot remove. 可复用判断 reusable judgments 并行 eligibility 由 dependency、effect/resource conflict 与 capacity 三类独立约束决定。 structured concurrency 要求子任务归属 scope，父退出前收敛 child 状态，并传播 deadline/cancellation。 bounded queue 与 pull-based permits 才能形成 backpressure；模型不能通过 fan-out 决定并发度。 cancel 是异步协议，不是 rollback；不可确认的副作用进入 cancelling/outcome-unknown 并 reconcile。 并发结果必须按稳定规则 join，并记录 projection version，避免完成顺序随机改变 agent 决策。 parallel eligibility is determined independently by dependencies, effect or resource conflicts, and capacity. structured concurrency gives children a scope, converges their states before parent exit, and propagates deadlines and cancellation. bounded queues and demand-based permits create backpressure; model fan-out cannot determine concurrency. cancellation is an asynchronous protocol, not rollback. unconfirmed effects enter cancelling or outcome-unknown and reconcile. concurrent results join in stable order with projection versions so completion order does not randomly change agent decisions. 一手资料 primary sources openjdk jep 505: structured concurrency — 官方 jep 以 task scope 管理子任务生命周期、取消与观测；java api 不是本文架构的唯一实现。 python asyncio task groups — 官方说明异步 context 中等待所有 tasks、异常取消 siblings 与 exceptiongroup 语义；具体行为受 python 版本约束。 go context package — 官方 contract：跨 api 传播 deadline、cancellation signal 与 request-scoped values，并要求调用 cancel 释放资源。 reactive streams — 异步流中 non-blocking backpressure 的倡议与 jvm specification 入口；本文把 demand/boundedness 原理映射到 agent scheduler。 azure architecture center: bulkhead pattern — 官方说明将资源隔离成 pools 以限制故障扩散；本文将其映射到不同 tool queues。 go singleflight package — 官方 package 文档说明重复函数调用抑制与结果共享；本文的 request coalescing 额外要求 authorization/freshness scope 一致。 rfc 8290: the flow queue codel packet scheduler — 网络 packet scheduler 中的 per-flow queueing/fairness 标准；本文仅借用公平隔离原则，不声称 agent queue 等同网络队列。 aws builders' library: timeouts, retries, and backoff with jitter — 官方工程文章讨论 timeout、retry amplification、token bucket 与 jitter；属于 aws 实践总结而非普适定理。 little, a proof for the queuing formula l = λw — little's law 的 1961 原始论文；jstor 页面提供论文元数据，doi 为 10.1287/opre.9.3.383。 dag compiler、resource-key contract、projection version、admission policy 与 agent-specific join policy 是本文基于 concurrency/queueing 原理的编辑性综合，不是任何一个来源规定的框架。 openjdk jep 505: structured concurrency — the official jep manages child lifetimes, cancellation, and observability through task scopes. its java api is not the only implementation of this article’s architecture. python asyncio task groups — officially documents awaiting all tasks in an async context, cancelling siblings on failures, and exceptiongroup semantics. concrete behavior is python-version-specific. go context package — the official contract for propagating deadlines, cancellation signals, and request-scoped values across api boundaries, including the requirement to call cancellation functions to release resources. reactive streams — the initiative and jvm specification entry for non-blocking backpressure in asynchronous streams. this article maps demand and boundedness principles to agent scheduling. azure architecture center: bulkhead pattern — officially describes isolating resources into pools to limit failure propagation; this article maps it to separate tool queues. go singleflight package — official package documentation for duplicate-call suppression and shared results; this article additionally requires matching authorization and freshness scopes. rfc 8290: the flow queue codel packet scheduler — standardizes per-flow queueing and fairness for network packets. this article borrows the fairness principle without equating agent queues to network queues. aws builders' library: timeouts, retries, and backoff with jitter — an official engineering article about timeouts, retry amplification, token buckets, and jitter; it reports aws practice rather than a universal theorem. little, a proof for the queuing formula l = λw — the original 1961 paper for little's law; the jstor record provides paper metadata and the doi is 10.1287/opre.9.3.383. the dag compiler, resource-key contract, projection versions, admission policy, and agent-specific join policy are editorial synthesis from concurrency and queueing principles, not a framework mandated by any one source. 已建立与下一篇起点 what is established and where we continue 今天已建立： 多个 tool calls 应编译成受 dependency、resource conflict 与 capacity 共同约束的 dag；children 必须属于 task group，继承 deadline/cancellation，并通过 bounded queue 接受 backpressure。join policy 与稳定结果顺序决定何时、怎样把 observation 投影给模型。 尚未讲完： at-least-once delivery、worker crash、重复 tool result 和 checkpoint replay 下，怎样避免副作用重复？哪些 operation 可安全 retry，哪些必须 reconcile 或 compensation？ 下一篇起点： agent runtime 内核 3/4 将进入 idempotency 与 durable recovery：idempotency key、dedup ledger、retry/backoff、checkpoint、replay、compensation 与 exactly-once illusion。 established today: several tool calls compile into a dag constrained independently by dependencies, resource conflict, and capacity. children belong to a task group, inherit deadlines and cancellation, and receive backpressure through bounded queues. join policy and stable result ordering determine when and how observations are projected to the model. still unresolved: under at-least-once delivery, worker crashes, duplicate results, and checkpoint replay, how does the runtime prevent repeated side effects? which operations are safe to retry, and which require reconciliation or compensation? next starting point: agent runtime internals 3/4 will cover idempotency and durable recovery: idempotency keys, deduplication ledgers, retry and backoff, checkpoints, replay, compensation, and the exactly-once illusion.

title.zh: Agent 不是 while loop，而是一台状态机
title.en: An Agent Is a State Machine, Not a While Loop

text: agent 不是 while loop，而是一台状态机 an agent is a state machine, not a while loop agent runtime 内核 agent runtime internals agent runtime state machine tool lifecycle control plane durable execution 今日命题 today's proposition 最小 agent demo 常写成 while (!done) { model(); tool(); } 。这个 loop 能解释控制流，却隐藏了生产系统最关键的问题：进程在 tool 完成后、结果写入前崩溃怎么办？两个并行调用哪个结果属于谁？取消与 timeout 到底终止模型、网络请求还是业务副作用？模型说“完成”是否足以结束任务？ 可靠 runtime 必须把隐式 call stack 展开成 可持久化状态、带身份的事件、受 policy 约束的命令 。模型输出只是提出一个 transition candidate；runtime 校验当前状态、权限与不变量，记录将要发生的动作，再驱动工具。tool response 也不是一段随便 append 的文本，而是对应某个 call identity 的事件，只有合法 transition 才能进入下一轮 context。 核心判断： agent loop 是状态机的一种执行器，不是状态本身。若任务阶段、call id、attempt、审批、deadline、结果和完成条件只存在内存或 prompt 中，系统就无法可靠恢复、去重、审计或证明完成。 a minimal agent demo is often written as while (!done) { model(); tool(); } . that loop explains control flow while hiding the production questions that matter most: what happens if the process crashes after a tool finishes but before its result is stored? which parallel result belongs to which call? does cancellation terminate model generation, an http request, or the underlying business side effect? is the model saying “done” sufficient to complete the task? a reliable runtime expands the implicit call stack into durable state, identity-bearing events, and policy-constrained commands . model output merely proposes a transition candidate. the runtime validates current state, authorization, and invariants; records the intended action; then drives the tool. a tool response is not arbitrary text to append. it is an event correlated to one call identity, and only a legal transition may feed the next model context. core judgment: an agent loop is one executor for a state machine; it is not the state itself. if task phase, call id, attempt, approval, deadline, result, and completion criteria live only in memory or in the prompt, the system cannot reliably recover, deduplicate, audit, or prove completion. 连接你熟悉的 agent loop connect it to the agent loop you know 你熟悉的 reason/action loop 描述的是顺序：构造 context、调用模型、发现 tool call、执行、追加 observation、继续。状态机视角再问三件事： 现在处于哪个可命名阶段？什么事件允许它离开？离开时必须保持哪些不变量？ 例如模型产生 charge_card 并不等于调用已发生。runtime 可先进入 proposed ，解析 schema 后进入 validated ，通过用户与 policy approval 后进入 authorized ，把 intent 与 idempotency key 持久化后进入 dispatched 。只有收到与 call id 匹配的 outcome，才能转为 succeeded 、 failed 或 outcome_unknown 。每个状态拥有不同的合法操作。 一次 agent tool call 的显式生命周期 模型提出调用后，runtime 依次验证、授权、记录并派发。工具结果按 call id 关联，进入成功、失败或结果未知；只有已记录的 outcome 可进入下一轮模型上下文。 proposed validated authorized recorded dispatched succeeded failed outcome unknown record outcome → build next context 原创示意：状态名称可不同，但“先记录 intent、后执行、再按 identity 记录 outcome”的边界必须显式。outcome unknown 不能自动当作 failed 重试。 the reason/action loop you already know describes order: build context, call the model, detect a tool call, execute it, append an observation, and continue. a state-machine view asks three additional questions: which named phase are we in, which event permits us to leave it, and which invariants must remain true during the transition? for example, a model emitting charge_card does not mean a charge occurred. the runtime can enter proposed , move to validated after schema parsing, reach authorized after user and policy approval, persist intent plus an idempotency key in recorded , and only then enter dispatched . an outcome correlated to the call id moves the machine to succeeded , failed , or outcome_unknown . each state permits a different set of actions. the explicit lifecycle of one agent tool call after the model proposes a call, the runtime validates, authorizes, records, and dispatches it. tool results correlate by call id and become succeeded, failed, or outcome unknown. only a recorded outcome enters the next model context. proposed validated authorized recorded dispatched succeeded failed outcome unknown record outcome → build next context original diagram: names may differ, but the boundary “record intent, execute, then record the identity-correlated outcome” must be explicit. an unknown outcome must not be treated as a failed call and retried automatically. 机制：把执行分成三条平面 mechanism: separate three execution planes 1. state plane：事实快照 保存 taskid、phase、version、activecalls、budgets、approval records、artifacts 和 terminal status。它只包含 runtime 能解释的结构化事实，不把模型自然语言 plan 当作权威状态。每次写入带 expected version，防止两个 worker 同时覆盖。 2. event plane：发生过什么 事件是不可变记录，例如 modelturncompleted 、 toolcallauthorized 、 toolresultobserved 、 cancellationrequested 。事件携带 eventid、taskid、turnid、callid、attempt、timestamp 与 provenance。状态可由事件 fold 得到；即使使用 snapshot 加速，也保留足够日志审计与 replay。 3. command plane：希望发生什么 命令是待执行意图，例如 invokemodel 、 dispatchtool 、 requestapproval 。它可以失败、超时或被拒绝，因此不能在产生时就写成事实。outbox 模式把 state transition 与待发送 command 放在同一数据库事务中，再由 dispatcher 投递，减少“状态已更新但消息没发”或相反的裂缝。 4. reducer 与 effect handler decision = reduce(currentstate, incomingevent) assert invariants(decision.nextstate) transaction { writestate(decision.nextstate, expectedversion) appendevents(decision.events) enqueueoutbox(decision.commands) } dispatcher.deliver(outbox) # side effects outside reducer reducer 应尽量 deterministic：同一 state+event 得到同一 next state 与 commands。模型调用、当前时间、随机数和网络 i/o 属于 effect handler；其结果作为新事件返回。这样 replay 不会在重放时再次发邮件或扣款。 5. tool-call correlation 一个逻辑 call 使用稳定 callid ；每次传输尝试使用 attemptid 。tool result 必须同时校验 task/turn/call identity，迟到结果若已被 supersede，应记录但不能覆盖新状态。模型看到的 observation 从 recorded outcome 构造，并带状态（success/error/unknown）、结构化 payload 与可追溯引用。 6. completion terminal transition 由 runtime predicate 决定，例如 required artifacts 存在、外部订单状态已确认、无 active calls、审批已满足。模型的 final 只是 completion proposal。系统可以接受、要求 verifier、或返回 observation 让模型继续；完成后到达 completed 、 failed 、 cancelled 等互斥 terminal states。 7. schema evolution durable task 可能跨越数天与多个部署版本，state、event 和 tool schema 都会变化。每条记录应带 schemaversion；reader 使用显式 upcaster 把旧 event 转成当前内部形式，或让 reducer 支持多个版本。不要原地改写历史语义。若新版本改变授权或 completion 条件，旧任务需要 migration gate、人工确认或继续由旧 worker 处理，不能假设重放自然得到相同结果。 8. context projection 模型不需要看到完整 event log。projector 根据当前 phase 生成最小上下文：目标、有效约束、尚未完成的 calls、已接受 outcomes 与 artifact references。被 supersede 的 attempt、内部审计字段和 credentials 不进入 prompt。projection 带 source event ids，便于把模型后续引用追溯到事实。摘要器可以压缩文本，但不能改变 canonical state。 1. state plane: the factual snapshot persist task id, phase, version, active calls, budgets, approvals, artifacts, and terminal status. store structured facts that the runtime can interpret; do not treat a natural-language model plan as authoritative workflow state. every write carries an expected version so two workers cannot silently overwrite each other. 2. event plane: what happened events are immutable records such as modelturncompleted , toolcallauthorized , toolresultobserved , and cancellationrequested . they carry event id, task id, turn id, call id, attempt, timestamp, and provenance. state can be folded from events. snapshots may accelerate loading, while sufficient history remains for audit and replay. 3. command plane: what should happen commands express intended work such as invokemodel , dispatchtool , and requestapproval . a command can fail, time out, or be rejected, so producing it does not make it a fact. the outbox pattern stores the state transition and outbound command in one database transaction; a dispatcher later delivers it, reducing the gap between “state committed but message lost” and its inverse. 4. reducer and effect handler decision = reduce(currentstate, incomingevent) assert invariants(decision.nextstate) transaction { writestate(decision.nextstate, expectedversion) appendevents(decision.events) enqueueoutbox(decision.commands) } dispatcher.deliver(outbox) # side effects outside reducer the reducer should be deterministic: the same state and event produce the same next state and commands. model calls, wall-clock time, random numbers, and network i/o belong in effect handlers; their results return as new events. replay then does not send an email or charge a card again. 5. tool-call correlation one logical call uses a stable callid ; each transport attempt gets an attemptid . a result must match task, turn, and call identity. a late result after supersession is recorded but cannot overwrite newer state. the observation shown to the model is built from a recorded outcome and carries status—success, error, or unknown—plus structured payload and a traceable reference. 6. completion a runtime predicate owns terminal transitions: required artifacts exist, an external order is confirmed, no calls remain active, and approvals are satisfied. a model’s final output is merely a completion proposal. the runtime can accept it, invoke a verifier, or return an observation and continue. completion ends in mutually exclusive terminal states such as completed , failed , or cancelled . 7. schema evolution a durable task may span days and several deployments while state, event, and tool schemas evolve. every record carries a schema version. readers use explicit upcasters to translate old events into current internal forms, or reducers support several versions. do not rewrite historical meaning in place. if a release changes authorization or completion conditions, old tasks need a migration gate, human confirmation, or execution by the old worker; replay cannot be assumed to produce the same result automatically. 8. context projection the model does not need the complete event log. a projector builds minimal context for the current phase: objective, effective constraints, unfinished calls, accepted outcomes, and artifact references. superseded attempts, internal audit fields, and credentials stay out of the prompt. the projection carries source event ids so later model references remain traceable to facts. a summarizer may compress prose but cannot mutate canonical state. 必要数学：转移、不变量与交付语义 essential math: transitions, invariants, and delivery semantics transition function δ : s × e → s × c s 是持久状态集合， e 是输入事件， c 是发出的命令集合。 δ 不执行副作用，只决定下一状态与 intents。若 event 在当前 phase 不合法，应得到明确 rejection/no-op event，而非由模型猜测修复。工程价值是所有合法边都可枚举、测试和审计。 invariant ∀ transition s→s′, i(s) ∧ guard(s,e) ⇒ i(s′) i 是必须始终为真的条件，例如 terminal task 没有新的 side-effect command；未授权 call 不能 dispatched；一个 call 最多有一个 accepted terminal outcome。guard 校验 event version、identity 与 phase。模型输出永远不能绕过 invariant。 optimistic concurrency update task set state=s′, version=v+1 where id=k and version=v 若更新行数为 0，说明其他 worker 已推进状态；当前 worker 必须重新读取并 reduce，而不是覆盖。这个 compare-and-swap 把并发冲突显式化，却不自动解决业务合并。 delivery semantics at-most-once 避免重复但可能丢失； at-least-once 避免静默丢失但可能重复；端到端 exactly-once effect 通常需要 tool 参与幂等/事务协议，不能由 runtime 单方面承诺。若发送 timeout，runtime 只知道 reply 未到，不知道 effect 未发生，因此必须进入 outcome_unknown 并 reconcile。 progress measure b′ = b − cost(command), b ≥ 0 b 可表示 token、tool calls、wall time 或 monetary budget。每个 command 消耗显式 budget；达到 0 时转到等待审批、降级或 terminal，而不是无限 loop。budget 是 safety bound，不是任务是否完成的定义。 the transition function δ : s × e → s × c s is the set of durable states, e the input events, and c the emitted commands. δ performs no side effect; it decides the next state and intents. an event illegal in the current phase should produce an explicit rejection or no-op event rather than asking the model to guess a repair. every legal edge can therefore be enumerated, tested, and audited. an invariant ∀ transition s→s′, i(s) ∧ guard(s,e) ⇒ i(s′) i is a condition that must always remain true: a terminal task emits no new side-effect command; an unauthorized call cannot be dispatched; one call has at most one accepted terminal outcome. the guard validates event version, identity, and phase. model output can never bypass an invariant. optimistic concurrency update task set state=s′, version=v+1 where id=k and version=v if zero rows update, another worker already advanced the state. the current worker must reload and reduce again rather than overwrite. this compare-and-swap makes concurrency conflicts explicit; it does not automatically decide how business state should merge. delivery semantics at-most-once avoids duplicates while permitting loss. at-least-once avoids silent loss while permitting duplicates. end-to-end exactly-once effect generally requires the tool to participate through idempotency or a transaction protocol; a runtime cannot promise it unilaterally. after a send timeout, the runtime knows only that no reply arrived—not that no effect happened—so it enters outcome_unknown and reconciles. a progress measure b′ = b − cost(command), b ≥ 0 b can represent tokens, tool calls, wall-clock time, or money. every command consumes explicit budget. at zero, transition to approval, degradation, or a terminal state rather than looping indefinitely. a budget is a safety bound, not the definition of task completion. 对 agent 系统的影响 implications for agent systems 1. prompt 只投影状态，不拥有状态 context builder 从 durable state/events 选择模型需要的视图。压缩或截断 prompt 不会删除真实审批、call outcome 或 artifact。反之，模型在文本中声称“已批准”也不会创建 approval record。 2. 每个 tool call 都是业务 transaction boundary schema validation、authorization、intent persistence、dispatch、outcome reconciliation 和 observation construction 分开记录。这样“工具失败”才能区分 validation error、policy denial、transport timeout、remote rejection 与 ambiguous outcome。 3. 审计必须能回答因果链 谁/哪个模型在何种 state 提出什么 call？哪条 policy 批准？哪个 attempt 被发送？哪个结果被接受？它如何改变下一轮 context？只有带 identity 的 event chain 能回答，而聊天 transcript 只展示部分投影。 4. human approval 是等待状态 等待用户不是阻塞线程；状态机进入 awaiting_approval ，持久化 proposal、risk、expiry 与 resume token。批准/拒绝作为事件回来，进程可在期间重启。approval 必须绑定精确参数和版本，参数变化后旧批准失效。 5. cancellation 是请求，不是事实 收到 cancel 后记录 cancellationrequested ，停止尚未派发的命令，并尝试取消 in-flight work。远端副作用可能已经发生，因此最终状态需等待 acknowledgement/reconciliation。ui 的“已取消”不应早于业务事实。 6. model routing 不能破坏状态协议 不同模型可负责 planning、tool selection 或 summarization，但都通过同一 command/event contract。更换模型只改变 proposal quality，不改变 authorization、call identity、invariants 和 completion predicate。 7. observability 围绕 transition，而非日志字符串 指标应按 phase 和 transition 统计：proposed→authorized 的拒绝率、dispatched→outcome 的延迟、unknown outcome 的数量、迟到结果、version conflict、budget exhaustion 与 terminal reason。trace span 使用 task/turn/call/attempt ids 关联模型、队列和工具。这样 p95 上升能定位在审批、排队、远端执行还是 reconciliation，而不是只看到“agent 很慢”。 8. 测试状态空间，而不只测 happy path 表驱动测试枚举每个 state 对每类 event 的结果；property test 检查 invariants；故障注入在 intent commit、dispatch、remote effect、outcome commit 各边界杀进程。还要发送重复、乱序、迟到与未知 id 的 events。若系统只能在理想顺序下通过，它仍不是 durable runtime。 1. a prompt projects state; it does not own state the context builder selects a model-facing view from durable state and events. compressing or truncating a prompt does not delete a real approval, call outcome, or artifact. conversely, a model claiming “approved” in text does not create an approval record. 2. every tool call is a business transaction boundary record schema validation, authorization, intent persistence, dispatch, outcome reconciliation, and observation construction separately. “tool failure” can then distinguish validation error, policy denial, transport timeout, remote rejection, and ambiguous outcome. 3. audit must answer the causal chain who or which model proposed which call in what state? which policy approved it? which attempt was sent? which result was accepted? how did it alter the next context? only an identity-bearing event chain answers those questions. a chat transcript is only a partial projection. 4. human approval is a waiting state waiting for a person does not block a thread. the machine enters awaiting_approval and persists proposal, risk, expiry, and resume token. approval or rejection returns as an event, and the process may restart meanwhile. approval binds exact arguments and version; changed arguments invalidate it. 5. cancellation is a request, not a fact on cancel, record cancellationrequested , stop undispatched commands, and attempt to cancel in-flight work. a remote side effect may already have happened, so final state waits for acknowledgement or reconciliation. the ui must not claim “cancelled” before the business fact is known. 6. model routing must preserve the state protocol different models may handle planning, tool selection, or summarization, but all speak the same command and event contract. replacing a model changes proposal quality, not authorization, call identity, invariants, or the completion predicate. 7. observability centers on transitions, not log strings measure by phase and transition: proposal-to-authorization rejection rate, dispatch-to-outcome latency, unknown outcomes, late results, version conflicts, budget exhaustion, and terminal reasons. trace spans correlate models, queues, and tools through task, turn, call, and attempt ids. a p95 regression can then be located in approval, queueing, remote execution, or reconciliation instead of summarized as “the agent is slow.” 8. test the state space, not only the happy path table-driven tests enumerate each event in each state; property tests assert invariants; fault injection kills the process at intent commit, dispatch, remote effect, and outcome commit boundaries. send duplicate, out-of-order, late, and unknown-id events. a system that passes only ideal ordering is not yet a durable runtime. 取舍与失败模式 trade-offs and failure modes 显式状态 vs 开发速度： 状态/事件 schema 增加代码与 migration 成本，却把 crash、并发和审计从隐含 bug 变成可测试协议。高风险或长运行任务通常值得；一次性无副作用问答可保持简单。 event sourcing vs snapshot crud： 完整事件流利于审计/replay，但存储、版本演进和隐私删除更复杂。常见折中是 current snapshot + append-only audit events，而不是为所有数据做纯 event sourcing。 deterministic reducer vs 灵活逻辑： 把 i/o 排除在 reducer 外使 replay 可预测，却要求显式 command/event plumbing。若 reducer 直接读时间或调用模型，历史 replay 会产生新决策和副作用。 严格 lifecycle vs latency： 每次持久化、授权和 outbox 增加延迟。可按风险分级：只读、可重试工具走轻路径；不可逆 side effect 走完整 intent/approval/reconcile 路径。但分类本身必须由确定性 policy 决定。 状态粒度： 过粗无法区分 sent 与 succeeded；过细造成状态爆炸。优先建模影响恢复和合法动作的差异。仅用于 ui 文案的细节可放事件 metadata，不必成为 phase。 隐私删除 vs append-only audit： 事件不可变不等于数据永不删除。敏感 payload 可放受生命周期管理的 encrypted blob，event 只保存引用与最小 metadata；删除时销毁 blob/key，同时保留必要审计骨架。若把用户原文、credential 或 tool secret 复制进每条 event，后续 retention 与访问控制会非常困难。 最危险的失败模式： timeout 被当作 failure 后自动重试不可逆工具；迟到 response 覆盖新 attempt；模型文本被当作授权；进程内变量被当作 durable truth；terminal 后仍接受 tool result。它们都是状态协议缺失，而非 prompt 不够好。 explicit state versus development speed: state and event schemas add code and migration cost, but turn crashes, concurrency, and audit from implicit bugs into a testable protocol. high-risk or long-running work usually justifies it; a one-shot, side-effect-free answer may remain simple. event sourcing versus snapshot crud: a full event stream improves audit and replay while complicating storage, version evolution, and privacy deletion. a common compromise is a current snapshot plus append-only audit events rather than pure event sourcing for every datum. deterministic reducer versus flexible logic: excluding i/o from the reducer makes replay predictable but requires explicit command/event plumbing. a reducer that reads wall-clock time or calls a model can generate new decisions and side effects while replaying history. strict lifecycle versus latency: persistence, authorization, and outbox steps add latency. risk-tiered paths can let read-only, retryable tools use a lighter protocol while irreversible side effects use full intent, approval, and reconciliation. deterministic policy—not the model—must own classification. state granularity: states that are too coarse cannot distinguish sent from succeeded; states that are too fine create an explosion. model differences that change recovery or legal actions. details used only for ui copy can remain event metadata rather than phases. privacy deletion versus append-only audit: immutable events do not imply retaining every payload forever. sensitive content can live in lifecycle-managed encrypted blobs while events store references and minimal metadata. deletion destroys the blob or key while retaining a necessary audit skeleton. copying user text, credentials, or tool secrets into every event makes retention and access control extremely difficult. the most dangerous failure modes: treating timeout as failure and retrying an irreversible tool; allowing a late response to overwrite a new attempt; treating model text as authorization; treating process memory as durable truth; accepting tool results after terminal state. these are missing state protocols, not weak prompts. 可复用判断 reusable judgments agent loop 是状态机执行器；durable state、events 与 commands 必须分离。 模型输出只提出 transition；runtime guard、authorization 与 invariant 决定是否合法。 tool call 需要稳定 callid、独立 attemptid 和明确的 success/failure/outcome-unknown 结果状态语义；unknown 仍等待 reconciliation。 先持久化 intent 再派发 effect，按 identity 持久化 outcome 后才构造下一轮 observation。 完成、取消与审批都是 runtime state transition，不能由模型文本或 ui 单方面宣告。 an agent loop executes a state machine; durable state, events, and commands must remain separate. model output only proposes a transition. runtime guards, authorization, and invariants decide whether it is legal. a tool call needs a stable call id, separate attempt ids, and explicit success, failure, or outcome-unknown result-state semantics; unknown still awaits reconciliation. persist intent before dispatching an effect; persist the identity-correlated outcome before constructing the next observation. completion, cancellation, and approval are runtime state transitions, not declarations made unilaterally by model text or ui. 一手资料 primary sources amazon states language specification — json 状态机、states、transitions、terminal/error semantics 的规范；本文未主张 agent 必须使用 aws step functions。 temporal workflow execution documentation — 官方解释 workflow execution、event history、durability 与恢复；具体 replay constraints 属于 temporal 产品模型。 azure durable functions overview — 官方概述 orchestrator、activity、entity、状态管理、checkpoint、重试与恢复；本文不把该页面作为 event-sourcing 实现细节的证据。 transactional outbox pattern — 将业务状态与待发布消息同事务保存、再由独立 relay 发送的模式说明。 rfc 9457: problem details for http apis — 结构化错误类型、状态与细节的标准，可用于 tool error observation；它不定义 agent lifecycle。 yao et al., react — 交错 reasoning/action/observation 的论文基础；本文进一步讨论生产 runtime 的 durable state 与 effect boundary。 状态名、三平面划分和 agent tool lifecycle 是基于 workflow/messaging 原理的编辑性架构综合，不是任何单一来源规定的唯一实现。 amazon states language specification — specifies json state machines, states, transitions, and terminal and error semantics. this article does not claim agents must use aws step functions. temporal workflow execution documentation — the official explanation of workflow execution, event history, durability, and recovery; concrete replay constraints belong to temporal’s product model. azure durable functions overview — officially overviews orchestrators, activities, entities, state management, checkpoints, retries, and recovery. this article does not use that page as evidence for event-sourcing implementation details. transactional outbox pattern — describes storing business state and an outbound message in one transaction, then delivering with a separate relay. rfc 9457: problem details for http apis — standardizes structured error types, status, and details useful for tool-error observations; it does not define an agent lifecycle. yao et al., react — establishes interleaved reasoning, action, and observation. this article extends the discussion to durable state and effect boundaries in production runtimes. the state names, three-plane separation, and agent tool lifecycle are an editorial architecture synthesis from workflow and messaging principles, not the sole implementation prescribed by any one source. 已建立与下一篇起点 what is established and where we continue 今天已建立： agent runtime 应把 durable state、immutable events 与 side-effect commands 分离；每个 tool call 经 proposed→validated→authorized→recorded→dispatched，并以 call identity 关联 success、failure 或 outcome unknown。模型只提出 transition，runtime 拥有 guard、invariant 与 completion predicate。 尚未讲完： 如果模型一次提出多个 tool calls，哪些能并行？如何限制 fan-out、处理共享资源冲突、传播 cancellation，并在下游变慢时实施 backpressure？ 下一篇起点： agent runtime 内核 2/4 将进入 structured concurrency：task groups、dependency dag、deadline/cancellation propagation、semaphore、queue 与 backpressure，解释“并行工具调用”为什么不是简单的 promise.all 。 established today: an agent runtime separates durable state, immutable events, and side-effect commands. every tool call moves through proposed, validated, authorized, recorded, and dispatched, then correlates success, failure, or unknown outcome by call identity. the model proposes transitions; the runtime owns guards, invariants, and the completion predicate. still unresolved: when a model proposes several tool calls, which may run concurrently? how should the runtime bound fan-out, handle conflicts on shared resources, propagate cancellation, and apply backpressure when downstream systems slow down? next starting point: agent runtime internals 2/4 will cover structured concurrency: task groups, dependency dags, deadline and cancellation propagation, semaphores, queues, and backpressure—showing why “parallel tool calls” is not simply promise.all .

title.en: Why Does a Model Learn to Follow Instructions?

text: 模型为什么会“听话”？ why does a model learn to follow instructions? 训练目标与推理控制 training objectives & inference control sft rlhf dpo reward model agent control plane 今日命题 today's proposition base model 的 pretraining 目标是继续文本，不天然区分“用户请求”“系统政策”和“网页里的一句指令”。instruction-following behavior 来自后续训练与数据格式：高质量示范告诉模型什么回答像一个 assistant；成对偏好告诉它同一 prompt 下哪个 completion 更好；rlhf 或 dpo 再把这些相对信号转成 policy 更新。 但 alignment 不是把一套确定性规则安装进模型。它改变的是条件 token distribution：某些回答、拒绝或工具模式变得更可能，其他模式变得更不可能。偏好数据有限、标注者意见不一致，reward model 只是 proxy；policy 还会寻找 proxy 的漏洞。因此“训练得更听话”与“拥有授权”“知道实时事实”“保证完成任务”属于不同系统层。 核心判断： sft 教模型模仿可见示范，preference optimization 教模型在候选间排序并偏向某类行为。它们能改善默认行为，却不能承担 credential、policy enforcement、side-effect verification 或 durable state。 a base model’s pretraining objective is to continue text. it does not inherently recognize “user request,” “system policy,” and “an instruction quoted from a webpage” as different authority classes. instruction-following behavior is created by later training and data formats: high-quality demonstrations show what an assistant-like answer looks like; paired preferences indicate which completion is better for the same prompt; rlhf or dpo then converts those relative signals into policy updates. alignment does not install a deterministic rulebook inside the model. it changes a conditional token distribution: some answers, refusals, and tool patterns become more likely, while others become less likely. preference coverage is finite, annotators disagree, and a reward model is only a proxy. a policy can also search for weaknesses in that proxy. “more likely to follow instructions” is therefore separate from “possesses authorization,” “knows live facts,” or “guarantees task completion.” core judgment: sft teaches a model to imitate visible demonstrations; preference optimization teaches it to rank and favor classes of behavior. these stages improve default behavior, but cannot carry credentials, enforce policy, verify side effects, or hold durable workflow state. 把四篇串成一条链 connect all four installments 1/4 说明 cross-entropy 在 teacher-forced prefix 上提高真实 next token 的概率；2/4 说明 optimizer、data mixture 与 compute 决定这些 gradients 最终塑造什么能力；3/4 说明 inference policy 从 logits 选择一条 rollout 路径。alignment 仍使用这些基础部件，只是改变数据来源和 objective。 sft 仍是 next-token cross-entropy，但 loss 常只计算 assistant completion。reward modeling 不直接生成 token，而是学习一个比较分数。ppo-style rlhf 把生成模型当 policy，在线采样 completions，用 reward model 加 kl penalty 得到奖励，再做 constrained policy update。dpo 则从成对偏好直接优化 policy 与 reference policy 的 log-probability ratio，不需要显式训练 reward model 后再跑在线 rl。 从预训练到 agent runtime 的完整控制栈 预训练建立基础预测能力，sft 注入示范格式，偏好优化改变行为倾向，sampling 选择 token 路径，agent runtime 执行权限、工具、验证与持久状态控制。 pretraining · 预测互联网/代码分布 · 基础能力 sft · 模仿 demonstrations · 角色、格式、任务范式 preference optimization · rlhf / dpo · 行为倾向 decoding policy · temperature / constraints · rollout 路径 agent runtime · credentials / policy / verifier / durable state 训练时 推理时 系统时 原创示意：越往下越接近真实副作用。上层改变概率，下层建立确定性权限与环境边界；任何一层都不能被另一层完全替代。 part 1 showed cross-entropy raising the probability of observed next tokens under teacher-forced prefixes. part 2 showed how optimizers, mixtures, and compute determine which capabilities those gradients create. part 3 showed an inference policy selecting one rollout path from logits. alignment reuses these foundations while changing the source of data and the objective. sft is still next-token cross-entropy, commonly masked to assistant completions. reward modeling does not generate tokens directly; it learns a comparative score. ppo-style rlhf treats the generator as a policy, samples completions online, combines reward-model scores with a kl penalty, and performs constrained policy updates. dpo instead optimizes policy-to-reference log-probability ratios directly from preference pairs, avoiding the sequence of fitting an explicit reward model and then running online reinforcement learning. the full control stack from pretraining to agent runtime pretraining establishes predictive capability, sft introduces demonstration formats, preference optimization shifts behavioral tendencies, sampling selects token paths, and the agent runtime enforces authorization, tools, verification, and durable state. pretraining · predictive distribution · base capability sft · imitate demonstrations · roles, formats, task patterns preference optimization · rlhf / dpo · behavior tendencies decoding policy · temperature / constraints · rollout path agent runtime · credentials / policy / verifier / durable state training inference system original diagram: lower layers are closer to real side effects. upper layers shift probabilities; lower layers establish deterministic authorization and environmental boundaries. no layer completely replaces another. 机制：sft、rlhf 与 dpo mechanism: sft, rlhf, and dpo 1. supervised fine-tuning（sft） 收集 prompt 与理想 assistant completion，把它们格式化为聊天序列，并对 assistant tokens 计算 cross-entropy。sft 可快速建立角色、回答结构、tool-call syntax 和任务范式。它的 objective 直接监督示范中的 assistant tokens；pretrained model 可以泛化到未逐字出现的 prompt 与行为，但这种覆盖不是 sft loss 的保证。若每个 prompt 只有一个 completion，优化会把概率质量推向该路径，可能收窄其他合理答案；低质量示范也会提供错误的直接信号。chat template、role token 与 loss mask 属于训练契约；上线时模板不一致会造成 distribution shift，即使自然语言内容看起来相同。 2. preference collection 对同一 prompt 生成或撰写多个 responses，让标注者选择 preferred 与 rejected，或提供排序/评分。偏好反映 helpfulness、harmlessness、truthfulness、风格等混合目标。标注 instruction、worker population、response sampling policy 和呈现顺序都会改变数据。pairwise preference 表示相对选择，不等于绝对正确事实。若候选都很差，chosen 只代表“两害相权取其轻”；若候选几乎相同，标签噪声会很高。保留 tie、disagreement 与 annotator confidence 比强迫二选一更诚实。 3. reward model（rm） 常在语言模型 backbone 上增加 scalar head，输入 prompt+response，输出 reward。用 bradley–terry 风格 loss 让 preferred response 的分数高于 rejected。rm 把有限比较泛化到未标注输出，但也压缩了多个目标；policy 优化会主动寻找 rm 高分区域，可能暴露训练分布外的 proxy loophole。rm validation 应按领域、长度和风险切片；总体 pairwise accuracy 会隐藏罕见但关键的错误排序。 4. ppo-style rlhf 从当前 policy 采样 responses，经 rm 打分，并用 reference model 的 kl penalty 限制 policy 漂移。ppo 使用 clipped surrogate 等机制做多轮 minibatch updates。它能针对 policy 自己产生的 rollout 学习，但系统复杂：需要 policy/reference/rm（通常还有 value model）、在线生成、advantage estimation 与稳定性调参。reward normalization、response truncation、stop token 和 kl estimator 都会改变有效 objective；复现实验必须记录它们，而不能只写“用了 ppo”。 5. direct preference optimization（dpo） dpo 从 kl-regularized reward maximization 的最优 policy 关系出发，把隐式 reward 写成 policy 与 reference 的 log-ratio，直接对 preference pairs 做分类式 loss。它省掉显式 rm 和在线 ppo loop，训练更简单。代价是仍依赖 preference coverage、reference policy 与超参数 β；“直接”不表示无 reward assumption，也不保证避免 overoptimization。离线数据来自旧 policy 时，新 policy 可能进入未覆盖区域；需要迭代收集或在线 eval 发现这种 support gap。 # sft: imitate a demonstrated completion loss_sft = ce(policy(prompt), chosen_tokens) # rlhf: sample, score, then update with kl control y = sample(policy, prompt) reward = rm(prompt, y) - beta * kl(policy || reference) policy = ppo_update(policy, reward) # dpo: update directly from chosen/rejected log-ratios loss_dpo = preference_loss(policy, reference, chosen, rejected, beta) 6. evaluation and release 每个 stage 都需要 held-out preference accuracy、capability/safety eval、red-team 与真实 agent sandbox。rm accuracy 上升不保证最终 policy 更好；dpo loss 下降也不保证工具成功。release gate 应比较 base/sft/aligned checkpoints 的能力回归、拒绝边界、校准与 long-horizon
