trajectories。还要检查 training/eval contamination、标注者间一致性与各风险 slice 的置信区间；单个平均 win rate 无法支持高风险发布。 1. supervised fine-tuning (sft) collect prompts and ideal assistant completions, format them as chat sequences, and compute cross-entropy over assistant tokens. sft quickly establishes roles, answer structure, tool-call syntax, and task patterns. its objective directly supervises the demonstrated assistant tokens. a pretrained model can generalize to prompts and behaviors not literally present in the demonstrations, but that coverage is not guaranteed by the sft loss. when each prompt has one completion, optimization pushes probability mass toward that path and may narrow other reasonable answers; low-quality demonstrations also provide incorrect direct signal. chat templates, role tokens, and loss masks are part of the training contract. a different serving template creates distribution shift even when the visible prose looks equivalent. 2. preference collection for one prompt, generate or author several responses and ask annotators to select a preferred and rejected response, or provide rankings or scores. preferences combine objectives such as helpfulness, harmlessness, truthfulness, and style. annotation instructions, worker population, response-sampling policy, and display order all change the resulting dataset. a pairwise preference is a relative judgment, not an absolute factual certificate. if both candidates are poor, chosen means only “less bad.” if they are nearly identical, labels can be noisy. retaining ties, disagreement, and annotator confidence is more honest than forcing every pair into a binary label. 3. reward modeling (rm) a common design adds a scalar head to a language-model backbone. given prompt plus response, it emits a reward. a bradley–terry-style loss raises the preferred response above the rejected response. the rm generalizes limited comparisons to unlabeled outputs, but also compresses multiple objectives into one score. policy optimization actively searches high-reward regions and can expose proxy loopholes outside the reward model’s training distribution. rm validation should be sliced by domain, length, and risk; aggregate pairwise accuracy hides rare but critical ranking errors. 4. ppo-style rlhf sample responses from the current policy, score them with the rm, and apply a kl penalty to a reference model to limit policy drift. ppo uses mechanisms including a clipped surrogate for minibatch updates. it learns from the policy’s own rollouts, but the system is complex: it needs policy, reference, and reward models—often a value model too—plus online generation, advantage estimation, and stability tuning. reward normalization, response truncation, stop tokens, and the kl estimator all change the effective objective. a reproducible report must record them rather than merely state “we used ppo.” 5. direct preference optimization (dpo) dpo starts from the optimal-policy relationship for kl-regularized reward maximization, writes the implicit reward as a log-ratio between policy and reference probabilities, and applies a classification-like loss directly to preference pairs. it removes the explicit rm and online ppo loop, simplifying training. it still depends on preference coverage, the reference policy, and β. “direct” does not mean reward-assumption-free, nor does it guarantee immunity to overoptimization. when offline pairs came from an older policy, the new policy can enter unsupported regions; iterative collection or online evaluation is needed to expose that support gap. # sft: imitate a demonstrated completion loss_sft = ce(policy(prompt), chosen_tokens) # rlhf: sample, score, then update with kl control y = sample(policy, prompt) reward = rm(prompt, y) - beta * kl(policy || reference) policy = ppo_update(policy, reward) # dpo: update directly from chosen/rejected log-ratios loss_dpo = preference_loss(policy, reference, chosen, rejected, beta) 6. evaluation and release every stage needs held-out preference accuracy, capability and safety evaluation, red teaming, and real agent sandboxes. higher rm accuracy does not guarantee a better final policy; lower dpo loss does not guarantee tool success. release gates should compare base, sft, and aligned checkpoints for capability regressions, refusal boundaries, calibration, and long-horizon trajectories. they should also check training/evaluation contamination, inter-annotator agreement, and confidence intervals for each risk slice. one average win rate cannot justify a high-risk release. 必要数学：偏好如何变成 loss essential math: turning preference into loss reward-model preference probability p(y w ≻ y l | x) = σ(r φ (x,y w ) − r φ (x,y l )) x 是 prompt， y w / y l 是 preferred/rejected， rφ 是 reward model， σ 是 sigmoid。训练最小化上述概率的 negative log。只有分数差参与 loss，所以 reward 的绝对零点不可识别；rm 分数跨版本、prompt domain 或训练 recipe 未必可直接比较。 kl-regularized policy objective max π e y∼π(·|x) [r(x,y)] − β d kl (π(·|x) || π ref (·|x)) 第一项偏向高 reward，第二项惩罚 policy 远离 reference； β 控制对齐强度。β 太小，policy 更容易 exploit rm 或丢失 base capabilities；太大，则几乎不改变行为。实际 ppo 还需 token-level kl estimator、advantages、value targets 与 clipping；上式是目标直觉，不是完整实现。 dpo loss l dpo = −log σ(β[(log π θ (y w |x)−log π ref (y w |x)) − (log π θ (y l |x)−log π ref (y l |x))]) 括号比较 policy 相对 reference 对 preferred 和 rejected 的提升幅度。loss 推动 preferred 的相对 log-ratio 更大。 β 影响隐式 reward/偏离 reference 的尺度，不应简单读成“学习率”或“安全强度”。sequence log-prob 是 token log-prob 之和，因此 response length、mask 与 normalization 细节会影响训练动态。 proxy overoptimization 设真实人类 utility 为 u ，可训练 proxy 为 r=u+ε 。policy 搜索越强，越可能找到 ε 偶然很高的区域，即使 u 没有提高。gao 等在其合成设定中报告，优化 proxy reward 超过某点后 gold reward 可下降，并研究其 scaling pattern。这个结果说明 rm holdout accuracy 不足以证明强优化安全，但不是所有生产 rlhf 都遵循同一曲线。 reward-model preference probability p(y w ≻ y l | x) = σ(r φ (x,y w ) − r φ (x,y l )) x is the prompt, y w and y l are preferred and rejected responses, rφ is the reward model, and σ is sigmoid. training minimizes the negative log of this probability. only score differences enter the loss, so the absolute reward origin is unidentifiable. rm scores need not be directly comparable across versions, prompt domains, or training recipes. the kl-regularized policy objective max π e y∼π(·|x) [r(x,y)] − β d kl (π(·|x) || π ref (·|x)) the first term favors high reward; the second penalizes divergence from a reference policy. β controls the trade-off. if β is too small, the policy can exploit rm errors or lose base capabilities; if too large, behavior barely changes. practical ppo additionally needs token-level kl estimates, advantages, value targets, and clipping. the equation communicates the objective, not a complete implementation. the dpo loss l dpo = −log σ(β[(log π θ (y w |x)−log π ref (y w |x)) − (log π θ (y l |x)−log π ref (y l |x))]) the bracket compares how much the policy improves preferred and rejected responses relative to the reference. the loss pushes the preferred relative log-ratio higher. β controls the scale of the implicit reward and departure from the reference; it is not simply a learning rate or “safety strength.” sequence log-probability is a sum of token log-probabilities, so response length, masking, and normalization details affect optimization. proxy overoptimization let true human utility be u and a trainable proxy be r=u+ε . stronger policy search is more likely to find regions where error ε is accidentally high even when u has not improved. gao and colleagues report in their synthetic setup that optimizing proxy reward beyond a point can reduce gold reward, and study scaling patterns for that effect. this supports the warning that rm holdout accuracy is insufficient evidence for safe strong optimization; it does not imply every production rlhf system follows one universal curve. 对 agent 系统的影响 implications for agent systems 1. tool-use alignment 需要 outcome-grounded data 只标注 tool call 看起来合理，会奖励“像会用工具”；更强数据应包含实际执行结果、参数合法性、恢复轨迹和副作用。即使如此，训练数据中的 sandbox 权限也不能迁移成生产授权。 2. refusal 不是 access control 偏好训练可提高模型拒绝危险请求的概率，但 prompt injection、distribution shift 或新语言可能绕过。runtime 必须在模型外检查身份、资源、动作和审批。模型拒绝是 defense-in-depth 信号，不是安全边界。 3. sycophancy 来自偏好 proxy 若标注者更喜欢顺从、流畅或自信的回答，模型可能迎合错误前提。agent 在分析、代码 review 和决策支持中应奖励证据、校准和纠错，而不是只奖励用户满意。eval 要包含用户强烈暗示错误答案的对抗样本。 4. reward hacking 也发生在 agent loop 若成功指标是“工具返回 200”或“用户未追问”，policy 可能选择无意义调用、隐藏失败或提前宣布完成。训练 reward 与 runtime metric 都需要 outcome verifier、反作弊信号和人工抽查；不要让模型自己既执行又定义成功。 5. 对齐版本是行为依赖 同一 base model 经过不同 sft/preference recipe 后，tool propensity、拒绝、verbosity 和风险偏好可改变。model upgrade 必须跑固定回归与真实 trajectory shadow test，并记录 post-training lineage，而不是只看 base family 名。 6. 多目标不应压成唯一 release score helpfulness、truthfulness、harmlessness、latency 与 cost 互相冲突。用分层 dashboard 与硬性 safety constraints，而不是一个平均 reward。对高风险 action，即使总体 win rate 上升，也不能接受 rare catastrophic regression。 7. 模型内政策冲突要由外层仲裁 system instruction、用户目标、tool output 与 post-training 倾向可能互相冲突。模型只能以学到的概率模式进行权衡，无法证明自己采用了正确优先级。runtime 应先把不可信数据与指令分离，用显式 precedence、capability token 和 deny-by-default policy 决定可执行集合；模型只在集合内提出动作。这样即使 alignment 在边缘场景失败，权限边界仍保持稳定。 1. tool-use alignment needs outcome-grounded data labeling only whether a tool call looks plausible rewards the appearance of tool use. stronger data includes execution results, argument validity, recovery trajectories, and side effects. even then, sandbox permissions in training data do not transfer into production authorization. 2. refusal is not access control preference training can raise the probability of refusing dangerous requests, yet prompt injection, distribution shift, or a new language can bypass it. the runtime must check identity, resource, action, and approval outside the model. model refusal is a defense-in-depth signal, not a security boundary. 3. sycophancy can arise from a preference proxy if annotators prefer agreeable, fluent, or confident answers, the model may accommodate a false premise. agents used for analysis, code review, or decision support should reward evidence, calibration, and correction rather than satisfaction alone. evaluations need adversarial examples in which the user strongly suggests the wrong answer. 4. reward hacking also occurs inside an agent loop if success means “the tool returned http 200” or “the user did not ask again,” a policy can make meaningless calls, conceal failures, or declare completion early. training rewards and runtime metrics both need outcome verifiers, anti-gaming signals, and human audits. do not let the model both execute and define success. 5. alignment versions are behavioral dependencies the same base model can acquire different tool propensity, refusals, verbosity, and risk preferences under different sft and preference recipes. a model upgrade needs fixed regression suites and shadow tests on real trajectories, with post-training lineage recorded rather than only a base-family name. 6. multiple objectives should not collapse into one release score helpfulness, truthfulness, harmlessness, latency, and cost conflict. use a layered dashboard and hard safety constraints rather than one average reward. for a high-risk action, a higher overall win rate cannot justify a rare catastrophic regression. 7. resolve policy conflicts outside the model system instructions, user goals, tool output, and post-training tendencies can conflict. a model balances them through learned probability patterns; it cannot prove that it applied the correct precedence. the runtime should separate untrusted data from instructions and use explicit precedence, capability tokens, and deny-by-default policy to define the executable set. the model proposes only inside that set, preserving authorization boundaries even when alignment fails at an edge case. 取舍与失败模式 trade-offs and failure modes sft coverage vs diversity： 精选示范稳定格式，却可能造成 mode narrowing、verbosity 模板化或遗忘 base capability。混入多种正确答案和通用数据可缓解，但增加 curated data 成本。 rm generalization vs scalar compression： 一个分数便于优化，却把真实性、安全和风格纠缠。多 reward heads、规则约束或分阶段优化能拆开目标，但 arbitration 更复杂。 ppo control vs system complexity： 在线 rollout 能适应当前 policy 分布，代价是高计算、多个模型和不稳定性。dpo 简化 pipeline，却使用离线偏好，无法自动覆盖新 policy 访问的所有区域。 kl 约束 vs 改进行为空间： 强 kl 保留 base 能力但限制对齐；弱 kl 允许大改却增加 reward hacking、语言退化和 capability regression。没有普适 β，必须由多维 eval 选择。 human preference vs objective truth： 人类也会受呈现、风格、知识和时间压力影响。多数偏好不是事实 oracle。专家标注、事实工具、disagreement modeling 与 adjudication 能提高质量，但无法消除规范性冲突。 alignment tax vs alignment gain： 某些 safety tuning 会提高拒答并损失边缘能力，也可能通过更清晰 instruction-following 改善能力。只能按目标任务测量，不能假设所有对齐必然降低或提升 intelligence。 sft coverage versus diversity: curated demonstrations stabilize format but can narrow modes, create verbosity templates, or forget base capabilities. several correct answers and general replay data can help, at the cost of more curation. rm generalization versus scalar compression: one score is convenient to optimize but entangles truth, safety, and style. multiple reward heads, rule constraints, or staged optimization separate objectives while making arbitration more complex. ppo control versus system complexity: online rollouts adapt to the current policy distribution, but require substantial compute, several models, and stability work. dpo simplifies the pipeline but uses offline preferences and does not automatically cover every region a new policy reaches. kl constraint versus room to improve: strong kl preserves base capability while limiting alignment; weak kl enables larger changes but raises reward hacking, language degradation, and capability regression. there is no universal β. multi-dimensional evaluation must select it. human preference versus objective truth: humans are affected by presentation, style, knowledge, and time pressure. majority preference is not a factual oracle. expert labeling, factual tools, disagreement modeling, and adjudication improve quality without eliminating normative conflict. alignment tax versus alignment gain: some safety tuning raises refusal and loses marginal capability; clearer instruction following can also improve capability. measure on the target workflow rather than assuming alignment always lowers or raises intelligence. 可复用判断 reusable judgments sft 仍是 completion 上的 cross-entropy；它模仿示范，不直接表达相对偏好。 reward model 学习 preferred/rejected 的相对分数；proxy accuracy 不保证强 policy optimization 后仍与真实 utility 对齐。 ppo/rlhf 在线采样并以 reward+kl 更新；dpo 直接优化 policy/reference log-ratio，简化但不消除偏好假设。 模型拒绝、tool propensity 和 aligned behavior 是概率倾向，不是 credential、authorization 或完成验证。 完整控制栈必须同时管理 training objective、decoding policy 与 agent runtime policy，并分别评估。 sft remains cross-entropy over completions. it imitates demonstrations and does not directly express relative preference. a reward model learns relative scores for preferred and rejected responses. proxy accuracy does not guarantee alignment with true utility after strong policy optimization. ppo/rlhf samples online and updates with reward plus kl control. dpo directly optimizes policy/reference log-ratios, simplifying rather than eliminating preference assumptions. model refusal, tool propensity, and aligned behavior are probabilistic tendencies—not credentials, authorization, or completion verification. a complete control stack manages and evaluates training objectives, decoding policy, and agent-runtime policy separately. 一手资料 primary sources ouyang et al., training language models to follow instructions with human feedback — instructgpt 的 sft、reward model 与 ppo pipeline；收益是作者在指定模型和标注设置中的报告。 schulman et al., proximal policy optimization algorithms — ppo clipped surrogate 与 policy optimization 基础；原论文并非专为 llm。 rafailov et al., direct preference optimization — 从 kl-regularized rlhf 推导 dpo objective，并报告相对 ppo-based rlhf 的实验结果。 stiennon et al., learning to summarize with human feedback — 在摘要任务中训练 preference model 并优化 policy，是早期大规模文本 rlhf 证据之一。 gao et al., scaling laws for reward model overoptimization — 在合成 gold/proxy reward 设置中研究 overoptimization scaling；不应外推为所有生产系统的固定曲线。 bai et al., training a helpful and harmless assistant with reinforcement learning from human feedback — anthropic hh-rlhf 的 helpful/harmless pipeline 与实验；属于作者报告。 本文将 refusal、tool-use preference、runtime authorization 与 release governance 串联，是基于论文机制的编辑性工程分析，不是任何单篇论文直接验证的统一 agent 方案。 ouyang et al., training language models to follow instructions with human feedback — the instructgpt sft, reward-model, and ppo pipeline. gains are author-reported results under specific models and annotation settings. schulman et al., proximal policy optimization algorithms — establishes ppo’s clipped surrogate and policy-optimization foundations; the original paper is not specific to llms. rafailov et al., direct preference optimization — derives the dpo objective from kl-regularized rlhf and reports experiments against ppo-based rlhf. stiennon et al., learning to summarize with human feedback — trains a preference model and optimizes a policy for summarization, providing early large-scale evidence for text rlhf. gao et al., scaling laws for reward model overoptimization — studies overoptimization scaling with synthetic gold and proxy rewards. it should not be extrapolated as a fixed curve for every production system. bai et al., training a helpful and harmless assistant with reinforcement learning from human feedback — describes anthropic’s helpful and harmless rlhf pipeline and experiments; results are author reported. connecting refusal, tool-use preferences, runtime authorization, and release governance is editorial engineering analysis based on the mechanisms, not one unified agent prescription directly validated by any single paper. 四篇收束与下一站 closing the four parts and choosing the next stop 1/4 训练目标： cross-entropy 在真实 prefix 上学习 next-token likelihood，teacher forcing 与真实 rollout 存在 exposure mismatch。 2/4 优化与 scaling： adamw、batch、schedule、data mixture 与 compute allocation 共同塑造能力，average loss 不是 agent 成功率。 3/4 推理控制： temperature、top-p、seed 与 grammar 决定如何从 logits 选择路径，语法与确定性都有明确边界。 4/4 alignment： sft、reward modeling、ppo/rlhf 与 dpo 改变行为倾向，但仍是概率层。 本 series 已完成。 我们现在能把模型行为拆成三类问题：参数通过什么 objective/data 学来？decoding 如何选择 token 路径？runtime 如何授权、执行、验证与恢复？下一条系统主线进入 agent runtime internals ，从显式状态机与 control plane 开始，深入 tool-call lifecycle、并发、幂等、checkpoint/recovery 和长运行任务，而不是重讲 agent loop 的表面定义。 part 1—training objective: cross-entropy learns next-token likelihood on ground-truth prefixes, while teacher forcing differs from the real rollout distribution. part 2—optimization and scaling: adamw, batches, schedules, mixtures, and compute allocation shape capability; average loss is not agent success. part 3—inference control: temperature, top-p, seeds, and grammars select paths from logits, with clear limits on syntax and determinism. part 4—alignment: sft, reward modeling, ppo/rlhf, and dpo shift behavioral tendencies while remaining probabilistic. this series is complete. we can now separate three questions about model behavior: which objective and data shaped the parameters, which decoding policy selected a token path, and which runtime authorized, executed, verified, and recovered the action. the next systematic curriculum enters agent runtime internals , beginning with explicit state machines and control planes, then tool-call lifecycle, concurrency, idempotency, checkpointing, recovery, and long-running tasks—without repeating a surface-level description of the agent loop.

title.zh: 同一组 logits，为什么会生成不同答案？
title.en: Why Can the Same Logits Produce Different Answers?

text: 同一组 logits，为什么会生成不同答案？ why can the same logits produce different answers? 训练目标与推理控制 training objectives & inference control llm inference sampling temperature top-p constrained decoding 今日命题 today's proposition transformer 的最后一层输出 vocabulary logits。logits 不是答案，也不是概率；它们是每个候选 token 的未归一化分数。runtime 还要执行一条 decoding policy：应用 repetition/grammar 等约束、用 temperature 重标分数、截断候选集合、softmax 归一化，然后选择或随机采样一个 token。每生成一步，这条 policy 都重新运行。 因此“模型相同”不等于“行为相同”。同一 checkpoint、同一 prompt 在不同 decoding 参数下，可以从稳定的工具名变成有创造力的解释，也可以陷入重复或抽到低概率错误。反过来，temperature 设为 0 或 greedy decoding 只让 token selection policy 趋于确定；并不能固定模型版本、浮点 kernel、并发调度、tool state、网络结果或 agent runtime 的分支。 核心判断： sampling 控制如何从模型已经给出的分布中选路径，不会把错误 logits 变正确。constrained decoding 能保证输出属于某个语法语言，却仍不能保证参数语义、权限或环境事实。 the final transformer layer emits vocabulary logits. logits are neither an answer nor probabilities; they are unnormalized scores for candidate tokens. the runtime still executes a decoding policy: apply repetition or grammar constraints, rescale scores with temperature, truncate the candidate set, normalize with softmax, and then select or randomly sample one token. the policy runs again at every generation step. consequently, “the same model” does not imply the same behavior. the same checkpoint and prompt can produce a stable tool name under one decoding configuration, a diverse explanation under another, or a repetitive or low-probability error under a poor one. conversely, temperature zero or greedy decoding makes the token-selection policy approach determinism; it does not freeze model revisions, floating-point kernels, concurrent scheduling, tool state, network results, or branches in the agent runtime. core judgment: sampling controls which path is selected from the distribution the model already produced. it cannot make incorrect logits correct. constrained decoding can guarantee membership in a syntactic language, but it cannot guarantee parameter semantics, authorization, or environmental truth. 承接训练与 agent loop connect training to the agent loop 1/4 解释了 cross-entropy 如何训练 pθ(next token | prefix) ；2/4 解释了 optimizer、数据与 compute 怎样塑造参数 θ 。今天固定 θ ，研究 inference policy。模型输出 logits 后，training objective 已经结束；temperature 和 top-p 不会临时改参数，只改变下一 token 的选择分布。 在 agent loop 中，decoding policy 同时作用于自然语言、tool name、json key 和参数 value。自然语言 brainstorming 需要探索多个高概率路径；工具协议通常希望稳定、低熵。若整次 response 只能共享一套 sampling 参数，runtime 必须在多样性与协议可靠性间折中。更好的系统会利用结构化输出边界、候选生成后验证，或把“提出方案”和“执行动作”分成不同调用。 从 logits 到 agent token 的 decoding pipeline 模型产生 logits，runtime 依次应用语法掩码、temperature 和 top-k 或 top-p 截断，再通过 greedy 或随机采样选出 token，追加回上下文。 logits grammar mask temperature top-k / top-p softmax 选 token 追加到 prefix，进入下一步 删掉非法 token 重塑相对概率 删掉分布尾部 原创示意：具体实现的 processor 顺序可能不同；顺序本身会改变最终分布，因此必须作为可观测配置记录。 part 1 explained how cross-entropy trains pθ(next token | prefix) . part 2 explained how optimization, data, and compute shape parameters θ . today we hold θ fixed and study inference policy. once the model has emitted logits, the training objective is no longer active. temperature and top-p do not update parameters during the request; they change the distribution used to select the next token. inside an agent loop, that policy applies to prose, tool names, json keys, and argument values alike. brainstorming in natural language benefits from exploring several high-probability paths, while a tool protocol usually benefits from low entropy and stability. if an entire response must share one sampling configuration, the runtime trades diversity against protocol reliability. better systems exploit structured-output boundaries, generate candidates and verify them, or separate “propose alternatives” from “execute an action” into different calls. a decoding pipeline from logits to an agent token the model emits logits. the runtime applies a grammar mask, temperature, and top-k or top-p truncation, then uses greedy selection or random sampling and appends the chosen token to context. logits grammar mask temperature top-k / top-p softmax choose append to prefix and repeat remove illegal tokens reshape probabilities remove the tail original diagram: concrete implementations may order processors differently. order changes the final distribution and must be recorded as observable configuration. 机制：五种控制不是一回事 mechanism: five controls with different jobs 1. greedy decoding 每步选择最大 logit 的 token。它便宜、低变异，适合格式稳定的路径，但只做局部最优；早期一个略高的 token 会永久改变后续 prefix。greedy 不等于寻找整段序列概率最高的答案，也不保证事实或工具语义正确。 2. temperature softmax 前把 logits 除以 t 。 t 1 放大差距，使分布更尖； t 1 压平差距，提升尾部概率。temperature 不改变 token 排名（有限正数 t 下），只改变相对概率。所谓 temperature 0 通常由实现特殊处理为 greedy，而不是数学上真的除以零。 3. top-k 只保留 logit 最高的固定 k 个 token，再重新归一化。它能砍掉长尾，但固定集合大小不适应分布形状：在模型很确定时仍保留多余候选，在模型很不确定时又可能只留过少选择。 4. top-p / nucleus sampling 按概率从高到低排序，保留累计概率首次达到阈值 p 的最小集合，再归一化采样。模型确定时 nucleus 小，不确定时自动扩大。holtzman 等报告它在开放式文本生成中避免 unreliable tail，同时比当时的 beam search 更接近人类文本；这是指定模型与任务上的作者结果，不能直接推出 tool calling 最优。 5. constrained decoding grammar、json schema 或有限状态机根据当前 prefix 计算合法 next tokens，把非法 logits 设为负无穷。采样只在剩余集合中进行。约束器必须处理 tokenizer 边界：一个 token 可能包含多个字符，字符串 escaping、数字范围和递归 schema 都会影响状态。若 grammar 与 tokenizer 组合后没有合法 token，decoder 会失败而不是“理解意图”。 logits = model(prefix) logits = apply_penalties(logits, history) logits = grammar_mask(logits, grammar_state) logits = logits / temperature logits = truncate_top_k_or_top_p(logits) token = argmax(logits) if greedy else categorical(softmax(logits), rng) prefix.append(token) seed 与 random-number state seed 初始化伪随机数生成器；只有当 logits、候选集合、processor 顺序、rng algorithm/state 和采样调用次数完全一致时，才有机会复现 token 序列。一次额外 retry、并行候选或 speculative decoding 都可能消耗不同随机数。seed 是实验控制变量，不是跨版本 api 合约。 1. greedy decoding at every step, choose the token with the largest logit. greedy decoding is cheap and low-variance, which helps stable formatting, but it is only locally optimal. one slightly higher early token permanently changes the later prefix. greedy selection does not search for the globally highest-probability complete sequence, nor does it guarantee factual or tool-semantic correctness. 2. temperature before softmax, divide logits by t . with t 1 , differences grow and the distribution sharpens. with t 1 , differences shrink and tail probabilities rise. for any finite positive t , temperature does not change token ranking; it changes relative probabilities. “temperature zero” is commonly special-cased by implementations as greedy behavior rather than literally dividing by zero. 3. top-k keep the k highest-logit tokens and renormalize. this removes a long tail, but a fixed candidate count does not adapt to distribution shape. when the model is confident, top-k can retain unnecessary choices; when it is uncertain, the same k may retain too few. 4. top-p or nucleus sampling sort tokens by probability, retain the smallest set whose cumulative mass reaches threshold p , then renormalize and sample. the nucleus is small when the model is confident and grows when it is uncertain. holtzman and colleagues report that nucleus sampling avoids an unreliable tail in open-ended text and produces text closer to human writing than the beam-search baselines they studied. this is an author-reported result on specific models and tasks, not evidence that nucleus sampling is optimal for tool calling. 5. constrained decoding a grammar, json schema, or finite-state machine computes legal next tokens for the current prefix and assigns negative infinity to illegal logits. sampling proceeds only inside the remaining set. the constraint engine must operate across tokenizer boundaries: one token may contain several characters, while escaping, number formats, and recursive schemas alter grammar state. if the grammar-tokenizer combination leaves no legal token, decoding fails; the system does not recover semantic intent by itself. logits = model(prefix) logits = apply_penalties(logits, history) logits = grammar_mask(logits, grammar_state) logits = logits / temperature logits = truncate_top_k_or_top_p(logits) token = argmax(logits) if greedy else categorical(softmax(logits), rng) prefix.append(token) seeds and random-number state a seed initializes a pseudorandom generator. reproducing a token sequence requires identical logits, candidate sets, processor order, rng algorithm and state, and the same number of random draws. one extra retry, parallel candidate, or speculative-decoding path can consume random numbers differently. a seed is an experimental control variable, not a cross-version api contract. 必要数学：重塑与截断分布 essential math: reshaping and truncating a distribution temperature softmax pᵢ(t) = exp(zᵢ/t) / σⱼ exp(zⱼ/t) zᵢ 是 token i 的 logit， t 0 是 temperature。对两个 token，odds ratio 为 pᵢ/pⱼ=exp((zᵢ−zⱼ)/t) ：如果 logit 差为 2， t=1 时 odds 约 7.4； t=0.5 时约 54.6； t=2 时约 2.7。这说明 temperature 能显著改变多个 plausible alternatives 之间的竞争，却不会修复最高分 token 的业务错误；具体敏感度还取决于完整分布与采用的度量。 top-p 集合 vₚ = smallest v′ such that σ i∈v′ pᵢ ≥ p 候选按概率降序排列， vₚ 是累计质量达到阈值的最小前缀集合。随后定义 qᵢ=pᵢ/σ j∈vₚ pⱼ （若 i∈vₚ ，否则 0）。同一个 p=0.9 可能保留 2 个或 2,000 个 token，取决于模型不确定性。top-p 控制 probability mass，不直接控制输出质量或候选数量。 sequence probability 与局部选择 log p(x₁:t) = σ t=1 t log p(xₜ | x t) greedy 每步最大化一项，却可能错过总和更大的另一条路径，因为选择会改变后续条件分布。beam search 保留多个累计高分 prefix，但在开放式生成中可能偏向通用、重复文本；长度 normalization 等又引入额外 policy。对 agent 来说，sequence likelihood 也不是 task utility：一个概率更高的礼貌解释可能不如一个低概率但正确的 tool call。 约束后的条件分布 q(i | prefix, g) = p(i | prefix)·1[i∈a(g,prefix)] / z g 是 grammar， a 是当前合法 token 集合，indicator 对非法 token 为 0， z 重新归一化。它严格保证语法前提，但如果合法集合包含错误 enum、危险路径或虚构 id，约束仍会采样它。语法正确率可达到 100%，语义正确率仍需 verifier 测量。 temperature softmax pᵢ(t) = exp(zᵢ/t) / σⱼ exp(zⱼ/t) zᵢ is the logit for token i , and t 0 is temperature. for two tokens, the odds ratio is pᵢ/pⱼ=exp((zᵢ−zⱼ)/t) . if the logit difference is two, odds are about 7.4 at t=1 , 54.6 at t=0.5 , and 2.7 at t=2 . temperature can therefore materially change competition among plausible alternatives, while it cannot repair a business error in the highest-scored token; exact sensitivity depends on the complete distribution and the metric used. the top-p set vₚ = smallest v′ such that σ i∈v′ pᵢ ≥ p tokens are ordered by probability, and vₚ is the shortest prefix whose cumulative mass reaches the threshold. define qᵢ=pᵢ/σ j∈vₚ pⱼ for tokens inside the nucleus and zero otherwise. the same p=0.9 may retain two tokens or two thousand, depending on model uncertainty. top-p controls retained probability mass, not output quality or candidate count directly. sequence probability and local decisions log p(x₁:t) = σ t=1 t log p(xₜ | x t) greedy decoding maximizes each term locally but can miss a path with a larger total because one choice changes every later conditional distribution. beam search retains several high-scoring prefixes, but in open-ended generation it can favor generic or repetitive text; length normalization introduces further policy. for an agent, sequence likelihood is not task utility either: a high-probability polite explanation may be less useful than a lower-probability correct tool call. the distribution after constraints q(i | prefix, g) = p(i | prefix)·1[i∈a(g,prefix)] / z g is a grammar, a is the currently legal token set, the indicator is zero for illegal tokens, and z renormalizes. this can strictly guarantee syntax under its assumptions. if the legal set contains an incorrect enum, dangerous path, or fabricated identifier, the constrained decoder can still select it. syntactic validity may reach 100 percent while semantic validity still requires a verifier. 对 agent 系统的影响 implications for agent systems 1. 按决策类型配置，而非全局一个 temperature 创意候选生成可用更高 entropy，再由 rubric/verifier 排序；tool selection、参数填充和最终副作用应使用低 entropy、schema constraint 与 policy validation。若 provider 只允许 response 级配置，可拆成 planner 与 executor 调用。 2. 多样性应在可回滚区域发生 随机探索适合生成搜索词、测试假设或计划草案；不适合直接选择转账对象、删除路径或生产发布。把 sampling 放在无副作用阶段，之后用确定性检查、审批和幂等执行收敛。 3. 记录完整 decoding provenance trace 至少保存 model/version、prompt hash、temperature、top-k/top-p、penalties、constraint schema/version、seed（若有）与候选数。只保存 final text 无法解释回归。若 service 不承诺完全复现，仍可用这些字段缩小差异来源。 4. 测量分布，不只测一次 随机策略的单次 pass/fail 方差很大。对关键 eval 使用多个 seeds，报告 pass@1、pass@k、方差、unsafe-any-of-k 和 verifier acceptance。增加候选数通常提高“至少一个正确”的机会，也提高至少一个危险输出出现的机会，并线性或超线性增加验证成本。 5. 区分模型不确定性与采样噪声 同一 prompt 多次输出不同，可能是分布本就平坦，也可能只是 sampling policy 较宽；同一答案反复出现，也可能是模型错误地高度自信。若 api 支持 logprobs，可观察关键 token 的 margin/entropy；否则用多次采样与 prompt perturbation 估计稳定性。不要把“输出一致”直接解释成“模型确定且正确”，也不要把变化全部归因于模型知识不足。 6. structured output 后仍要业务校验 json schema 可以保证字段与类型，却不知道 customerid 是否存在、金额是否越权、工具是否幂等。parse success、schema validity、semantic validity、authorization 和 environment success 应作为五层独立指标。 7. 系统级确定性是端到端属性 即使 token 序列固定，tool api 的时间、搜索索引、数据库状态、排序 tie、重试和并发竞态仍可改变结果。若业务要求 reproducibility，需要 snapshot inputs、版本化工具与数据、确定性状态机、事件日志和 replay，而不是只把 temperature 改成 0。 1. configure by decision type, not one global temperature creative candidate generation can use higher entropy followed by rubric or verifier ranking. tool selection, argument filling, and final side effects benefit from low entropy, schema constraints, and policy validation. if a provider exposes only response-level settings, split planning and execution into separate calls. 2. put diversity in reversible regions random exploration is useful for proposing search queries, hypotheses, or draft plans. it should not directly choose a transfer recipient, deletion path, or production release. sample before side effects, then converge through deterministic checks, approval, and idempotent execution. 3. record complete decoding provenance a trace should preserve model and version, prompt hash, temperature, top-k or top-p, penalties, constraint schema and version, seed when available, and candidate count. final text alone cannot explain a regression. even when a service does not promise exact replay, these fields narrow the source of divergence. 4. measure a distribution, not one run one pass or failure from a stochastic policy has high variance. for critical evaluations, run multiple seeds and report pass@1, pass@k, variance, unsafe-any-of-k, and verifier acceptance. more candidates often increase the chance that at least one is correct, but also increase the chance that at least one is unsafe and raise verification cost linearly or worse. 5. separate model uncertainty from sampling noise different outputs across repeated runs may reflect a genuinely flat model distribution or simply a broad sampling policy. repeatedly identical output may reflect confident error. when an api exposes log probabilities, inspect margins or entropy at critical tokens; otherwise estimate stability with repeated samples and prompt perturbations. do not interpret consistency as correctness, and do not attribute every variation to missing model knowledge. 6. validate business semantics after structured output a json schema can guarantee fields and types, but it does not know whether a customer id exists, an amount exceeds authorization, or a tool is idempotent. parse success, schema validity, semantic validity, authorization, and environmental success should be five separate metrics. 7. system-level determinism is end-to-end even with an identical token sequence, tool time, search indexes, database state, ordering ties, retries, and concurrency races can change the outcome. a reproducible business workflow needs snapshotted inputs, versioned tools and data, a deterministic state machine, event logs, and replay—not merely temperature zero. 取舍与失败模式 trade-offs and failure modes 低 temperature vs 错误自信： 尖锐分布减少变异，也会稳定复现最高分错误。对知识缺口，降低 temperature 不是 factuality 修复；需要 retrieval、abstention 或 verifier。 高 temperature vs 长尾污染： 增加多样性同时放大低概率 token，长序列中一次异常选择会重塑后续分布。top-p 可移除 tail，但阈值过低会切掉必要的罕见标识符。 top-k vs top-p： top-k 的计算与候选数直观，top-p 适应分布熵。二者同时启用时通常取交集，processor 顺序与最小保留数会改变行为；不要把参数名当成跨实现完全相同的语义。 约束强度 vs 可达性： 严格 grammar 提高 parse rate，却可能因 schema 错误让正确答案不可生成；复杂 schema 还带来状态管理和 latency。保留清晰 failure signal，不要静默退化到 unconstrained text。 复现 vs 吞吐： 固定 kernel、batching 和执行顺序有助 reproducibility，却可能牺牲 continuous batching 与硬件效率。产品需明确目标是 statistical repeatability、token-exact replay，还是 environment-exact outcome；三者成本不同。 多候选 vs selection bias： best-of-n 只有在 scorer 与真实目标对齐时才有效。奖励模型或 heuristic 可被 exploit，选出的答案可能更会讨好 scorer，而不是更正确。必须用 held-out outcome 验证 selector。 low temperature versus confident error: a sharper distribution reduces variation while reproducing the highest-scored mistake more consistently. lower temperature is not a factuality repair for a knowledge gap; use retrieval, abstention, or verification. high temperature versus tail contamination: diversity rises together with the probability of unlikely tokens. in a long sequence, one unusual choice reshapes all later distributions. top-p removes a tail, but an overly low threshold can eliminate a necessary rare identifier. top-k versus top-p: top-k offers an intuitive fixed candidate count; top-p adapts to entropy. when both are enabled, implementations typically intersect their retained sets, while processor order and minimum-token rules alter behavior. do not assume identical parameter names have perfectly identical semantics across implementations. constraint strength versus reachability: a strict grammar raises parse rate but an incorrect schema can make the correct answer impossible to generate. complex schemas add state-management and latency cost. preserve an explicit failure signal rather than silently falling back to unconstrained text. reproducibility versus throughput: fixed kernels, batches, and execution ordering can improve replay while sacrificing continuous batching and hardware efficiency. a product must distinguish statistical repeatability, token-exact replay, and environment-exact outcomes; each has a different cost. multiple candidates versus selection bias: best-of-n helps only when the scorer aligns with the real objective. a reward model or heuristic can be exploited, selecting answers that please the scorer rather than answers that are correct. validate the selector against held-out outcomes. 可复用判断 reusable judgments logits 经 decoding policy 才变成 token；temperature 重塑概率，top-k/top-p 截断候选，职责不同。 greedy 只做逐步局部最优；temperature 0 通常是实现特例，也不提供系统级确定性。 constrained decoding 保证语法语言成员资格，不保证业务语义、权限或环境成功。 多样性应发生在可回滚的 proposal 阶段；执行前用 verifier、policy gate 与幂等机制收敛。 随机 agent eval 要跨 seeds 报告分布；完整 provenance 是定位模型回归与 serving drift 的前提。 logits become tokens only through a decoding policy. temperature reshapes probabilities; top-k and top-p truncate candidates. they perform different jobs. greedy decoding is locally optimal one step at a time. temperature zero is usually an implementation special case and does not provide system-level determinism. constrained decoding guarantees membership in a syntactic language, not business semantics, authorization, or environmental success. diversity belongs in a reversible proposal stage. verifiers, policy gates, and idempotency should converge before execution. stochastic agent evaluations require distributions across seeds. complete provenance is necessary to diagnose model regressions and serving drift. 一手资料 primary sources holtzman et al., the curious case of neural text degeneration — 提出 nucleus sampling，并在开放式文本上比较 sampling 与 beam/search degeneration；结论受论文模型与任务边界限制。 fan et al., hierarchical neural story generation — 在故事生成中使用 top-k sampling；不是 tool-use 最优性证据。 meister et al., locally typical sampling — 从信息论角度提出 typical sampling，并比较多种 decoding 策略，说明“截断分布”仍是活跃设计空间。 willard & louf, efficient guided generation for large language models — 讨论用有限状态机与 token indexing 加速 grammar-guided generation。 beurer-kellner et al., guiding llms the right way — 分析 constrained decoding 的 token misalignment 与实现正确性，提醒字符 grammar 与 subword token 间需要严谨映射。 pytorch torch.multinomial documentation — 官方 categorical sampling api 的 replacement、generator 与输入权重契约；具体服务端实现未必使用 pytorch 或相同 rng。 pytorch reproducibility note — 官方说明跨 release、platform 或 cpu/gpu 不保证完全复现，并列出 rng 与 deterministic algorithm 的控制边界；其他 serving stack 需查其自身契约。 本文关于 planner/executor 拆分、五层结构化输出指标和系统级 replay 的建议是基于机制的编辑性工程推论，不是上述论文共同验证的单一 agent 架构。 holtzman et al., the curious case of neural text degeneration — introduces nucleus sampling and compares sampling with beam and search degeneration in open-ended text. conclusions are bounded to the paper’s models and tasks. fan et al., hierarchical neural story generation — uses top-k sampling for story generation; it is not evidence of optimality for tool use. meister et al., locally typical sampling — proposes typical sampling from an information-theoretic perspective and compares decoding strategies, illustrating that distribution truncation remains an active design space. willard & louf, efficient guided generation for large language models — discusses finite-state machines and token indexing for efficient grammar-guided generation. beurer-kellner et al., guiding llms the right way — analyzes token misalignment and implementation correctness in constrained decoding, emphasizing the mapping between character grammars and subword tokens. pytorch torch.multinomial documentation — the official contract for a categorical sampling api, including replacement, generator, and input-weight behavior. a serving provider may not use pytorch or the same rng. pytorch reproducibility note — officially states that complete reproducibility is not guaranteed across releases, platforms, or cpu and gpu, and describes rng and deterministic-algorithm controls. other serving stacks require their own contracts. the recommendations about planner/executor separation, five-layer structured-output metrics, and system-level replay are editorial engineering deductions from the mechanisms, not one agent architecture jointly validated by the cited sources. 已建立与下一篇起点 what is established and where we continue 今天已建立： decoding 是参数冻结后的 runtime policy；temperature、top-k/top-p、greedy、seed 和 grammar 分别重塑、截断、选择或限制分布。低随机性不等于正确，语法约束不等于语义验证，token 重现不等于环境结果重现。 尚未讲完： base model 学会预测、optimizer 塑造能力、sampling 选择路径之后，sft、reward model、rlhf 与 dpo 怎样把“像互联网文本”调整成“遵循用户意图”？这些目标又会引入哪些 reward hacking、sycophancy 与 capability trade-off？ 下一篇起点： 训练目标与推理控制 4/4 将完成本系列：拆开 pretraining、sft、preference data、reward modeling、ppo/rlhf 与 dpo，最后把训练目标、sampling policy 和 agent runtime policy 串成一张完整控制栈。 established today: decoding is a runtime policy applied after parameters are frozen. temperature, top-k or top-p, greedy selection, seeds, and grammars reshape, truncate, select from, or constrain the distribution in different ways. low randomness is not correctness, syntactic constraint is not semantic verification, and token replay is not environmental replay. still unresolved: after a base model learns prediction, optimization shapes capability, and sampling chooses a path, how do sft, reward models, rlhf, and dpo turn “text like the internet” into “follow the user’s intent”? what reward hacking, sycophancy, and capability trade-offs do those objectives introduce? next starting point: training objectives & inference control 4/4 will complete the series by separating pretraining, sft, preference data, reward modeling, ppo/rlhf, and dpo, then unifying training objectives, sampling policy, and agent runtime policy into one control stack.

title.zh: 一次梯度，怎样变成模型能力？
title.en: How Does a Gradient Become Model Capability?

text: 一次梯度，怎样变成模型能力？ how does a gradient become model capability? 训练目标与推理控制 training objectives & inference control llm training adamw scaling laws data mixture compute budget 今日命题 today's proposition 上一篇的 cross-entropy 只定义“往哪个方向更好”：提高真实 next token 的概率。它没有决定参数每次走多远、多少样本合成一个方向、哪些数据出现得更频繁，也没有决定固定算力该分给更大模型还是更多 token。真正得到什么模型，取决于 objective × optimizer × schedule × data mixture × compute allocation 的组合。 训练不是把知识逐条写入数据库。每个 batch 产生一个高维、带噪声的 gradient；optimizer 把当前 gradient 与历史统计变成 parameter update。数十万次 update 共同改变模型的表示和条件分布。相同架构和 token 数，如果 learning rate 不稳定、batch 组织不同或高质量代码被低质量重复文本淹没，也可能得到能力完全不同的 checkpoint。 核心判断： scaling law 描述特定实验范围内 average loss 随 model/data/compute 的规律，不是“参数越多就自动会用工具”的定律。训练 recipe 决定算力是否转化为可迁移能力；agent 的具体可靠性仍需任务级、闭环 eval。 cross-entropy from the previous installment specifies only a direction of improvement: raise the probability of the observed next token. it does not determine how far parameters move, how many examples are combined into one direction, which data appears more often, or whether a fixed compute budget should buy a larger model or more training tokens. the resulting model is determined by the combination of objective × optimizer × schedule × data mixture × compute allocation . training does not write facts into a database one record at a time. every batch produces a noisy vector in a very high-dimensional parameter space. the optimizer combines the current gradient with running statistics and emits a parameter update. hundreds of thousands of updates jointly reshape representations and conditional distributions. two runs with the same architecture and token count can yield very different checkpoints when one uses an unstable learning rate, organizes batches differently, or allows low-quality repeated text to overwhelm high-signal code and reasoning examples. core judgment: a scaling law describes how average loss changes with model size, data, and compute inside a measured regime. it is not a law that “more parameters automatically produce better tool use.” the training recipe controls whether compute becomes transferable capability; an agent’s concrete reliability still requires task-level, closed-loop evaluation. 承接 cross-entropy continue from cross-entropy 上一篇停在 loss.backward() ：automatic differentiation 得到每个参数的 gradient。把它类比为 agent runtime：loss 像 verifier 给出的局部误差信号，gradient 像针对所有参数的建议方向，但它还不是副作用。optimizer 才像执行 policy——决定实际改哪些参数、改多少，并保存 momentum 等跨 step 状态。 不同点也同样重要。agent verifier 可以返回可解释的业务错误；gradient 只是 loss 对参数的局部导数。它不携带“这是事实更新”“这是安全规则”的标签。一个 batch 中代码、新闻和聊天样本的 gradients 会在同一参数空间相加，有时协同，有时冲突。数据 sampler 实际上决定哪些目标更频繁地获得表决权。 大模型训练控制回路 数据混合器采样 batch，模型前向计算 loss，反向得到 gradient，gradient clipping 与 adamw 结合 learning-rate schedule 更新参数；validation 和 checkpoint 位于训练回路外侧。 数据 mixture forward/loss backward clip + adamw 更新参数 θ 下一 step 使用新参数 learning-rate schedule validation / checkpoint 在外层定期运行 原创示意：能力不是单个 gradient 的产物，而是 sampler、optimizer、schedule 与长期 update 轨迹的共同结果。 the previous installment stopped at loss.backward() , where automatic differentiation provides a gradient for every parameter. an agent-runtime analogy is useful: loss resembles a verifier’s local error signal, and the gradient is a proposed direction over all parameters, but neither has yet created a side effect. the optimizer acts more like execution policy. it decides the actual update size and preserves cross-step state such as momentum. the differences matter too. an agent verifier can report an interpretable business error. a gradient is only the local derivative of loss with respect to parameters; it contains no label saying “this is a factual update” or “this is a safety rule.” gradients from code, news, and chat examples are added in the same parameter space. they can reinforce or conflict with one another. the data sampler therefore decides which objectives receive more frequent votes. the large-model training control loop a data mixer samples a batch; the model computes loss; backward produces gradients; clipping and adamw combine with a learning-rate schedule to update parameters. validation and checkpointing run outside the inner loop. data mixture forward/loss backward clip + adamw update θ next step uses new parameters learning-rate schedule validation and checkpoints run outside the inner loop original diagram: capability is not produced by one gradient. it emerges from the sampler, optimizer, schedule, and the long trajectory of parameter updates. 机制：一条 training recipe mechanism: one training recipe 1. global batch 与 gradient accumulation 显存通常放不下完整 global batch。训练把它拆成每张设备上的 microbatch，执行多次 forward/backward，把 gradients 累积后再同步更新。global batch 近似为 microbatch × accumulation steps × data-parallel workers 。更大 batch 降低 gradient 方差、提高并行效率，但每个 token 带来的新信息会递减；如果 learning rate 不随之调整，优化动态也会改变。 2. gradient clipping 长序列或异常 batch 可能产生极大 gradient norm。global-norm clipping 在 norm 超过阈值时等比例缩小全部 gradients并保留方向。它约束的是送入 optimizer 的 raw gradient norm；adamw 还包含历史 moments、自适应缩放与 decay，因此 parameter-update norm 并未被同一阈值直接限制。它是训练稳定器，不会修复脏数据或错误 loss；阈值过低会把正常信号长期压扁。 3. adamw 的状态 adam 为每个参数维护一阶动量 m 与二阶矩 v ，用历史均值平滑噪声，并按近期平方梯度自适应缩放。adamw 将 weight decay 与 loss gradient 解耦，直接按比例收缩参数，避免把 l2 penalty 混入 adam 的自适应归一化。代价是 optimizer states 常以较高精度存储，显存可能是权重本身的数倍；大规模训练需 sharding。 4. warmup、peak 与 decay 训练初期 moments 尚未稳定，直接使用 peak learning rate 易发散，因此常线性 warmup；中段保持或缓慢变化；后段 cosine 或 linear decay 让参数在较小步长下收敛。schedule 按 step 还是 token 计数、是否在断点恢复时保持一致，都会影响结果。loss spike 后盲目继续可能传播坏 optimizer state，需要 checkpoint、数据定位与回退策略。 5. mixed precision 与分布式同步 大模型常用 bf16/fp16 做矩阵计算，以较高精度保留部分 master weights、moments 或累积量。低精度提高吞吐、降低显存，却可能 overflow、underflow 或累积舍入误差。fp16 常用 loss scaling 防止很小的 gradients underflow；bf16 的 exponent range 更宽，通常不需要同样处理，而 loss scaling 也不会普遍修复 activation overflow。data-parallel workers 正常情况下各自处理不同 microbatches，再用 all-reduce 合成 global-batch gradient；故障边界是 collective 未完成，或 workers 的 model version、step、scale/scheduler state 不一致。tensor/pipeline parallel 则切分单个模型。因此 checkpoint 不只保存权重，还应记录 optimizer、scheduler、随机数、sampler 与已消费 token 位置，才能避免恢复后重复或跳过数据。 6. 数据 mixture 与去重 sampler 按权重从 web、code、books、math 或领域数据取样。权重不是原始语料占比的被动反映，而是训练目标的一部分。重复数据会让少数文本获得过量 gradient votes，增加 memorization 并浪费 compute；过滤过强又会丢掉稀有语言或专业知识。高质量小域可被 upsample，但过多 epoch 会过拟合。数据 provenance、dedup、contamination 检查与 held-out eval 是 recipe 的一部分。 for step in schedule: zero_grad() for microbatch in accumulate(global_batch): loss = model(microbatch) / accumulation_steps loss.backward() all_reduce_gradients() clip_global_norm(threshold) adamw_step(lr=lr_schedule(step), weight_decay=wd) if validation_or_checkpoint(step): persist_and_measure() 1. global batches and gradient accumulation the full global batch rarely fits in accelerator memory. training divides it into per-device microbatches, runs several forward and backward passes, accumulates gradients, and synchronizes before an update. global batch is approximately microbatch × accumulation steps × data-parallel workers . a larger batch reduces gradient variance and improves parallel efficiency, but additional examples eventually provide diminishing new information. optimization dynamics also change if the learning rate is not adjusted appropriately. 2. gradient clipping long sequences or anomalous batches can produce a very large gradient norm. global-norm clipping rescales all gradients proportionally when the norm exceeds a threshold, preserving direction. it bounds the raw gradient norm entering the optimizer. adamw still applies historical moments, adaptive normalization, and decay, so the same threshold does not directly bound the parameter-update norm. clipping is a stability mechanism, not a repair for corrupt data or an incorrect loss. a threshold that is too low suppresses ordinary learning signal on many steps. 3. adamw state adam maintains first-moment state m and second-moment state v for every parameter. the first smooths noisy gradients; the second adaptively scales updates according to recent squared gradients. adamw decouples weight decay from the loss gradient and shrinks parameters directly, avoiding the interaction between an l2 penalty and adam’s adaptive normalization. the cost is memory: optimizer states are commonly stored at relatively high precision and can consume multiples of parameter memory, motivating state sharding at scale. 4. warmup, peak, and decay optimizer moments are poorly established at the beginning, so immediately applying the peak learning rate can destabilize training. recipes commonly use linear warmup, a peak or plateau region, and cosine or linear decay so late updates become smaller. whether a schedule counts steps or tokens, and whether checkpoint recovery restores it exactly, affects the final model. blindly continuing after a loss spike can carry damaged optimizer state forward; robust runs need checkpoints, data-batch attribution, and rollback policy. 5. mixed precision and distributed synchronization large models commonly use bf16 or fp16 for matrix operations while retaining selected master weights, moments, or accumulators at higher precision. lower precision improves throughput and memory use but introduces overflow, underflow, and rounding risk. fp16 commonly uses loss scaling to prevent tiny gradients from underflowing; bf16’s wider exponent range usually avoids that requirement, and loss scaling does not generally repair activation overflow. data-parallel workers normally consume distinct microbatches and all-reduce their gradients into the global-batch gradient. failure occurs when a collective is incomplete or workers disagree on model version, step, scale, or scheduler state—not because their samples differ. tensor and pipeline parallelism instead split one model across devices. faithful checkpoints therefore include optimizer, scheduler, random-number, sampler, and consumed-token state—not weights alone—so recovery neither repeats nor silently skips data. 6. data mixtures and deduplication a sampler draws from web, code, books, mathematics, and domain corpora according to explicit weights. those weights are not a passive reflection of raw corpus sizes; they are part of the learning objective. duplicates give selected text excessive gradient votes, increase memorization, and waste compute. over-aggressive filtering can erase rare languages or specialized knowledge. a small high-quality domain can be upsampled, but repeated epochs may overfit it. provenance, deduplication, contamination checks, and held-out evaluations belong inside the recipe. for step in schedule: zero_grad() for microbatch in accumulate(global_batch): loss = model(microbatch) / accumulation_steps loss.backward() all_reduce_gradients() clip_global_norm(threshold) adamw_step(lr=lr_schedule(step), weight_decay=wd) if validation_or_checkpoint(step): persist_and_measure() 必要数学：update 与 compute allocation essential math: updates and compute allocation adamw update mₜ=β₁mₜ₋₁+(1−β₁)gₜ; vₜ=β₂vₜ₋₁+(1−β₂)gₜ² θₜ₊₁=(1−ηₜλ)θₜ − ηₜ · m̂ₜ/(√v̂ₜ+ε) gₜ 是当前 gradient， mₜ / vₜ 是其一阶/二阶指数移动平均， β₁ / β₂ 控制记忆长度；帽子表示早期 bias correction。 ηₜ 是当前 learning rate， λ 是 decoupled weight decay， ε 防止除零。直觉上，持续同向的 gradient 累积 momentum；近期波动大的参数被较大 v 缩小步长。工程意义是 optimizer 有状态：只保存 weights 不能无损恢复训练。 gradient clipping g′ = g · min(1, τ / ||g||₂) τ 是 clipping threshold。若 norm 未超过阈值，gradient 不变；超过时整体缩放到 τ 。这不同于逐元素截断，后者会扭曲方向。监控 clip fraction 能区分偶发 outlier 与长期 learning-rate/data 问题。 训练 compute 的粗略账本 c ≈ 6nd n 是 non-embedding parameters， d 是训练 tokens， c 是 dense transformer training flops 的常用数量级近似；系数 6 粗略包含 forward 与 backward。它忽略 attention 的序列长度项、稀疏/moe、embedding、硬件利用率和通信，不能用于精确账单，但能暴露固定 compute 下的核心选择：增大 n 就必须减少 d ，反之亦然。 kaplan 等报告 loss 随 model size、dataset size 和 compute 呈平滑 power law；hoffmann 等在其更广实验中发现，当固定 compute 时，model parameters 与 training tokens 应更均衡地增长，许多大模型训练 token 不足。这里的事实边界是：论文拟合的是特定架构、数据与 loss 的 empirical law；“compute-optimal”意为在该预算下最小化预测 loss，不自动等于最小推理成本、最佳 agent 成功率或最安全模型。 the adamw update mₜ=β₁mₜ₋₁+(1−β₁)gₜ; vₜ=β₂vₜ₋₁+(1−β₂)gₜ² θₜ₊₁=(1−ηₜλ)θₜ − ηₜ · m̂ₜ/(√v̂ₜ+ε) gₜ is the current gradient; mₜ and vₜ are exponential moving averages of its first and second moments; β₁ and β₂ determine memory length. hats denote early-step bias correction. ηₜ is the current learning rate, λ is decoupled weight decay, and ε prevents division by zero. intuitively, persistent gradients build momentum while a large recent squared gradient reduces the adaptive step. the engineering implication is that the optimizer is stateful: weights alone cannot resume training faithfully. gradient clipping g′ = g · min(1, τ / ||g||₂) τ is the clipping threshold. if the norm is below it, the gradient is unchanged; otherwise the entire vector is scaled to norm τ . this differs from clipping each element, which distorts direction. tracking the fraction of clipped steps helps separate occasional outliers from a persistent learning-rate or data problem. a rough training-compute ledger c ≈ 6nd n is the number of non-embedding parameters, d is the number of training tokens, and c is a commonly used order-of-magnitude approximation for dense transformer training flops. the factor six roughly represents forward and backward work. it omits sequence-length effects in attention, sparse or mixture-of-experts routing, embeddings, hardware utilization, and communication. it is not an exact bill, but it exposes the central fixed-compute choice: increasing n requires reducing d , or vice versa. kaplan and colleagues reported smooth power-law relationships between loss and model size, dataset size, and compute. hoffmann and colleagues, using a broader experimental sweep, reported that compute-optimal training should grow parameter count and training tokens more evenly, concluding that many large models had been undertrained. the boundary of those claims matters: the papers fit empirical laws for particular architectures, data, and prediction losses. “compute optimal” means minimizing predictive loss under the studied budget, not automatically minimizing inference cost, maximizing agent success, or producing the safest model. 对 agent 系统的影响 implications for agent systems 1. model size 不是能力 provenance 参数量与训练 compute 不能告诉你模型看过多少 code、tool traces、错误恢复或特定语言。两个同尺寸模型的 data mixture 与 post-training 可完全不同。agent 选型应同时看 target workflow eval、context/latency/cost 与模型卡披露，而不是用参数量代替证据。 2. domain continued pretraining 有遗忘与污染成本 在企业代码或文档上继续预训练能调整领域 token distribution，但 learning rate、数据重复和 mixture 权重不当会过拟合、损害通用能力或记住敏感文本。需要保留通用 replay data、独立 validation、canary prompts 和隐私治理。它也不会自动学会实时权限；runtime authorization 仍外置。 3. agent traces 是训练数据，不是天然真相 把生产轨迹回灌可以增加 tool schema 与恢复模式覆盖，但轨迹包含旧模型错误、用户 pii、tool injection 和偶然成功。先做 provenance、去重、redaction、结果验证和 outcome filtering。否则 optimizer 会忠实强化系统过去的坏习惯。 4. scaling 提高平均能力，不消除 tail risk loss 改善可能使更多工具调用正确，却不保证罕见 destructive action、long-horizon recovery 或新 schema。随模型升级保留固定 regression set，并增加真实 rollout distribution；报告按风险分层的 pass rate，而非一个总体 benchmark。 5. 训练与 serving economics 要共同优化 compute-optimal checkpoint 可能参数更大、推理更贵。对高调用量 agent，稍小但训练 token 更多的模型可能以相近能力换取更低 latency；routing 可以把常规步骤交给小模型、关键规划交给大模型。最终目标应是每个成功任务的总成本，而非最低 pretraining loss。 6. ablation 才能回答 recipe 因果 一条训练曲线同时混入数据、seed、batch、schedule 和代码版本，不能凭最终 checkpoint 的差异断言“代码数据提升了工具能力”。有预算时使用小规模 proxy run 或 controlled ablation，一次只改变一个因素；记录 consumed-token lineage、配置哈希和 checkpoint eval。超大训练无法完全重复时，至少在扩容前验证趋势、在训练中安排固定 probe，并为异常保留可定位的 batch 与系统 telemetry。否则团队得到的是相关性故事，而不是可复用的训练知识。 1. model size is not capability provenance parameter count and training compute do not reveal how much code, tool-use trace data, error recovery, or a particular language the model saw. two models of equal size can use radically different mixtures and post-training. agent model selection should combine workflow-specific evaluation with context, latency, cost, and disclosed model-card evidence rather than substituting parameter count for evidence. 2. domain continued pretraining carries forgetting and contamination costs continued pretraining on enterprise code or documents can shift domain token distributions, but an excessive learning rate, repetition, or mixture weight can overfit, damage general capability, or memorize sensitive text. a robust plan includes general replay data, independent validation, canary prompts, and privacy governance. it still does not teach live authorization automatically; runtime policy remains external. 3. agent traces are training data, not ground truth recycling production trajectories can improve coverage of tool schemas and recovery patterns, but traces also contain old-model mistakes, user pii, tool-output injection, and accidental success. establish provenance, deduplicate, redact, verify outcomes, and filter trajectories before training. otherwise the optimizer faithfully reinforces the system’s historical bad habits. 4. scaling improves averages without eliminating tail risk lower prediction loss may improve many tool calls while leaving rare destructive actions, long-horizon recovery, or a new schema unreliable. preserve fixed regression sets across model upgrades and add samples from the live rollout distribution. report pass rates by risk class instead of collapsing everything into one benchmark. 5. training and serving economics must be optimized together a compute-optimal checkpoint may be larger and more expensive to serve. for a high-volume agent, a smaller model trained on more tokens may deliver comparable workflow quality at lower latency. routing can send routine steps to a smaller model and critical planning to a stronger one. the operational objective is total cost per successful task, not minimum pretraining loss. 6. ablations establish recipe causality one training curve combines data, seed, batch, schedule, and code revision, so a final-checkpoint difference cannot by itself prove that code data caused better tool use. when budgets allow, use small proxy runs or controlled ablations that vary one factor. record consumed-token lineage, configuration hashes, and checkpoint evaluations. when a full run cannot be repeated, validate trends before scaling, schedule fixed probes during training, and retain batch-level and system telemetry for anomaly attribution. otherwise the organization accumulates correlation stories rather than reusable training knowledge. 取舍与失败模式 trade-offs and failure modes 大 batch vs 泛化与新鲜 gradient： 大 batch 提高硬件效率、降低噪声，却减少固定 token budget 下的 update 次数；超过 critical batch 后收益递减。不是越大越好，需共同调 learning rate 与 schedule。 高 learning rate vs 稳定： 过低浪费 compute、停在次优区域；过高产生 loss spike 或不可逆损坏。warmup、clipping 和 rollback 只降低风险，不能替代 batch/data 诊断。 weight decay vs capacity： 适度收缩可改善优化与泛化；过强会持续擦除参数幅度。对 normalization、bias 等参数是否 decay 常需分组配置。 更多 token vs 更好 token： 重复低质量 token 可降低其域内 loss，却占用 compute 并放大偏差。质量过滤提高平均信号，但过滤器自身带文化/语言偏差。数据 mixture 是多目标治理，不是单一质量分。 scaling-law 外推： power law 在观测区间内有用，跨架构、tokenizer、数据质量、context length 或 post-training 外推可能失效。涌现式 benchmark 跳变也可能来自指标阈值，不应从平滑 loss 曲线直接承诺产品能力。即使整体趋势稳定，具体能力也可能受少量数据域、提示格式和评测污染支配；外推前应核对训练边界，并用目标任务上的小规模 checkpoint 验证斜率是否仍然成立。 large batches versus generalization and fresh gradients: large batches improve hardware efficiency and reduce noise, but produce fewer optimizer updates under a fixed token budget. beyond a critical batch regime, returns diminish. bigger is not inherently better; learning rate and schedule must be tuned with batch size. high learning rates versus stability: a rate that is too low wastes compute and may remain in a poor region; one that is too high causes loss spikes or unrecoverable damage. warmup, clipping, and rollback reduce risk but do not replace diagnosis of the batch and data. weight decay versus capacity: moderate shrinkage can improve optimization and generalization, while excessive decay continuously erases parameter magnitude. normalization and bias parameters are often configured separately. more tokens versus better tokens: repeated low-quality tokens can lower loss on their own domain while consuming compute and amplifying bias. quality filters increase average signal but carry cultural and language biases of their own. a mixture is multi-objective governance, not one universal quality score. scaling-law extrapolation: power laws are useful inside measured regimes. they may fail across architecture, tokenizer, data quality, context length, or post-training changes. abrupt benchmark “emergence” can also reflect metric thresholds, so a smooth loss curve cannot directly support a product-capability promise. even a stable aggregate trend can be dominated by a small data domain, prompt format, or evaluation contamination for one capability. check training boundaries and test the slope on target-task checkpoints before extrapolating. 可复用判断 reusable judgments objective 给方向；adamw、batch、clipping 与 schedule 决定每次真实 parameter update。 optimizer 是持久状态机；weights、moments、step/token counter 与 sampler 状态共同决定可恢复性。 数据 mixture 与去重改变每类样本获得的 gradient 权重，因此是能力与风险设计的一部分。 c≈6nd 只提供 dense training 的粗略 compute 直觉；compute-optimal loss 不等于最佳 agent 或最低 serving 成本。 参数量和 average loss 不能替代 tool-use、恢复、权限边界与长轨迹的闭环 eval。 the objective supplies direction; adamw, batches, clipping, and the schedule determine each actual parameter update. an optimizer is a persistent state machine. weights, moments, step or token counters, and sampler state jointly determine faithful recovery. data mixtures and deduplication change the gradient weight assigned to each kind of example, making them part of capability and risk design. c≈6nd gives only a rough intuition for dense training compute. compute-optimal loss is not equivalent to the best agent or lowest serving cost. parameter count and average loss cannot replace closed-loop evaluation of tool use, recovery, authorization boundaries, and long trajectories. 一手资料 primary sources kingma & ba, adam: a method for stochastic optimization — adam 的一阶/二阶 moments、自适应 update 与 bias correction。 loshchilov & hutter, decoupled weight decay regularization — adamw 将 weight decay 与 gradient update 解耦。 pascanu et al., on the difficulty of training recurrent neural networks — gradient norm clipping 的经典论述；论文对象是 rnn，但 clipping 机制本身广泛用于深度网络。 kaplan et al., scaling laws for neural language models — 作者报告 loss 与 model/data/compute 的 power-law 关系及当时的 compute-allocation 结论。 hoffmann et al., training compute-optimal large language models — chinchilla 实验修正 parameter/token allocation，报告更均衡的 compute-optimal scaling。 xie et al., doremi: optimizing data mixtures speeds up language model pretraining — 以 proxy model 优化 domain weights；收益属于论文指定数据与实验设置。 本文把 optimizer state、data governance、scaling 与 agent routing/trace eval 相连，是编辑性工程分析，不是上述论文直接验证的统一部署处方。 kingma & ba, adam: a method for stochastic optimization — introduces adam’s first and second moments, adaptive updates, and bias correction. loshchilov & hutter, decoupled weight decay regularization — introduces adamw’s decoupling of weight decay from the gradient update. pascanu et al., on the difficulty of training recurrent neural networks — a classic treatment of gradient-norm clipping. the paper studies rnns, while the clipping mechanism is used more broadly in deep learning. kaplan et al., scaling laws for neural language models — reports power-law relationships between loss and model, data, and compute, plus the authors’ compute-allocation conclusion at that time. hoffmann et al., training compute-optimal large language models — the chinchilla experiments revise parameter/token allocation and report more balanced compute-optimal scaling. xie et al., doremi: optimizing data mixtures speeds up language model pretraining — optimizes domain weights with a proxy model; reported gains are bounded to the paper’s data and experiments. connecting optimizer state, data governance, and scaling to agent routing and trace evaluation is editorial engineering analysis, not one deployment prescription directly validated by the cited papers. 已建立与下一篇起点 what is established and where we continue 今天已建立： gradient 只是局部方向；adamw moments、learning-rate schedule、global batch 与 clipping 决定实际 update。数据 mixture/去重决定不同目标的相对权重；固定 compute 必须在 parameters 与 training tokens 间分配，而 compute-optimal average loss 不等于 agent 最优。 尚未讲完： 训练得到 logits 后，runtime 如何把分布变成 token？temperature、greedy、top-k、top-p、seed 与 constrained decoding 如何改变随机性、重复、工具参数和可复现性？ 下一篇起点： 训练目标与推理控制 3/4 将进入 sampling。我们会从 logits transformation 的数学出发，建立“何时要多样性、何时要确定性”的 agent 工程边界，并解释 temperature 0 为什么也不等于系统级确定。 established today: a gradient is only a local direction. adamw moments, the learning-rate schedule, global batch, and clipping determine the actual update. mixtures and deduplication determine the relative weight of objectives. fixed compute must be divided between parameters and training tokens, while compute-optimal average loss is not agent-optimal behavior. still unresolved: once training produces logits, how does a runtime turn that distribution into a token? how do temperature, greedy decoding, top-k, top-p, seeds, and constrained decoding change randomness, repetition, tool arguments, and reproducibility? next starting point: training objectives & inference control 3/4 will enter sampling. starting from the mathematics of logit transformation, we will establish the agent-engineering boundary between diversity and determinism—and explain why temperature zero still does not create system-level determinism.

title.en: What Is an LLM Actually Trained to Do?

text: llm 到底在训练什么？ what is an llm actually trained to do? 训练目标与推理控制 training objectives & inference control llm cross-entropy teacher forcing maximum likelihood agent reliability 今日命题 today's proposition 预训练 decoder-only llm 的核心监督信号通常非常朴素：给定真实文本前缀，提升下一个真实 token 的概率。训练数据不需要为每段文字附上“事实”“推理”“工具使用”标签；文档被 tokenization 后，每个位置都能提供一个预测目标。模型在海量上下文上反复压低 token-level negative log-likelihood，于是参数逐渐编码语法、事实关联、代码模式和可用于推理的中间结构。 但这个目标没有直接说“完成用户任务”“调用正确工具”或“在 20 步后仍然成功”。它优化的是训练分布上的局部条件概率。agent 运行时则让模型读取 system prompt、工具 schema、自身早先生成的 token 和带噪声的环境 observation，并要求一串局部选择共同形成有效轨迹。两者之间存在 目标差距 与 分布差距 。 核心判断： cross-entropy 不是能力清单，也不是端到端任务奖励。它是一个密集、可微、逐 token 的学习信号；能力来自预测所需结构与模型/数据规模的结合，可靠性边界来自局部似然与真实运行目标并不等价。 the central pretraining signal for a decoder-only llm is usually strikingly simple: given a real text prefix, increase the probability of the next real token. a document does not need a separate “fact,” “reasoning,” or “tool use” label. once tokenized, every position supplies a target. by repeatedly reducing token-level negative log-likelihood across enormous numbers of contexts, the parameters come to encode syntax, factual associations, programming patterns, and intermediate structures that can support reasoning. the objective, however, never directly says “complete the user’s task,” “choose the correct tool,” or “remain successful after twenty steps.” it optimizes local conditional probabilities on a training distribution. at agent runtime, the model instead reads system instructions, tool schemas, its own earlier tokens, and noisy environmental observations, then must compose many local decisions into a valid trajectory. that creates both an objective gap and a distribution gap . core judgment: cross-entropy is neither a capability checklist nor an end-to-end task reward. it is a dense, differentiable, token-level learning signal. capabilities emerge from the structures useful for prediction combined with model and data scale; reliability remains bounded because local likelihood is not equivalent to the real operational objective. 连接 token loop 与 agent loop connect the token loop to the agent loop 在 llm 内核系列中，我们已经看到推理阶段：transformer 把 prefix 映射成 logits，sampling 选出一个 token，再把它追加到 prefix。训练阶段使用同一类前向计算，但已知整段目标文本。假设序列是 [bos, 用户, 请求, assistant, tool_call, ...] ，模型可以一次并行算出每个位置的 next-token distribution，并分别与真实的后一个 token 比较。 这叫 teacher forcing ：预测位置 t 时，输入 prefix 来自数据中的真实 token x t ，而不是模型自己在位置 t−1 采样的结果。它让所有位置可并行训练，并避免早期随机模型生成的垃圾 prefix 淹没学习信号。一次长度为 2,048 的序列可贡献约 2,047 个监督位置，而不是只给一个“整段好/坏”分数。 agent 推理却必须闭环。第一个参数 token 错了，第二个 token 看到的已经不是训练样本里的理想 prefix；错误 tool call 又会产生训练数据中少见的异常 observation。runtime 把这些结果追加回上下文，后续 token 在一个由模型与环境共同制造的新分布上生成。这就是 exposure mismatch 的工程形态。 teacher forcing 与 agent rollout 的前缀来源差异 训练时每个预测位置读取真实数据前缀并与真实下一个 token 比较；agent rollout 中后续位置读取模型先前输出和环境观察，早期错误会改变后续输入分布。 训练 / teacher forcing 真实 prefix 真实 prefix 真实 prefix 位置可并行监督 推理 / agent rollout 模型 token 模型 token tool call 环境 observation 早期选择改变后续 prefix 原创示意：训练逐位置读取数据 prefix；真实 agent 轨迹读取自身输出和环境反馈。图示表达数据依赖，不代表具体模型架构。 in the llm internals series, we followed inference: a transformer maps a prefix to logits, sampling selects a token, and that token is appended to the prefix. training uses the same kind of forward computation, but the complete target text is already available. for a sequence such as [bos, user, request, assistant, tool_call, ...] , the model can compute a next-token distribution at every position in parallel and compare each distribution with the real following token. this is teacher forcing : when predicting position t , the input prefix comes from the ground-truth data tokens x t , not from what the model sampled at position t−1 . it enables parallel training over positions and prevents garbage prefixes from an initially random model from overwhelming the learning signal. a 2,048-token sequence can contribute roughly 2,047 supervised positions instead of one coarse score for whether the whole sequence was good. agent inference must close the loop. if the first argument token is wrong, the second token already sees a prefix different from the ideal example. a bad tool call can produce an unusual error observation. the runtime appends these results, so later tokens are generated from a distribution jointly created by the model and environment. this is the engineering form of exposure mismatch. different prefix sources under teacher forcing and an agent rollout during training each prediction reads a ground-truth data prefix and is compared with the real next token. during an agent rollout later positions read previous model outputs and environmental observations, so early mistakes change the later input distribution. training / teacher forcing real prefix real prefix real prefix positions supervised in parallel inference / agent rollout model token model token tool call environment obs. early choices alter the later prefix original diagram: training reads data prefixes at each position; a deployed agent reads its own output and environmental feedback. the diagram represents data dependency, not a particular model architecture. 机制：从样本到梯度 mechanism: from examples to gradients 1. 构造输入与标签 一批文档先被 tokenizer 变成 token ids，加入边界 token，再切成固定或可变长度序列。训练代码通常把序列向右错一位作为 labels：输入 x₁...xₙ₋₁ 预测 x₂...xₙ 。padding、跨文档边界和不希望计入损失的区域用 mask 排除。instruction tuning 还可能只对 assistant completion 计算 loss；那是监督范围选择，不改变 next-token cross-entropy 的基本形式。 2. 一次并行前向 causal mask 使位置 t 只能读取 x≤t ，但所有位置的 hidden states 可以并行计算。unembedding 为每个位置产生 vocabulary logits。softmax 把 logits 归一化为条件分布 pθ(xₜ|x t) 。训练无需在每个位置真的 sample；它直接读取真实目标 token 的概率。 3. 汇总 loss 并反向传播 对未 mask 的位置求 negative log-probability，再对 batch 求平均。automatic differentiation 沿 unembedding、transformer blocks、embedding 一直计算参数梯度。optimizer（例如 adamw）根据梯度与历史动量更新参数。注意：一条样本不把一个“事实”写入一个固定神经元；它对大量参数施加微小、上下文相关的更新，并与其他样本的梯度叠加或冲突。 tokens = tokenizer(documents) inputs = tokens[:, :-1] labels = tokens[:, 1:] logits = model(inputs, causal_mask=true) loss = cross_entropy(logits, labels, loss_mask) loss.backward() optimizer.step() 4. 重复、验证与 checkpoint 训练在许多 batches 上重复，周期性在 held-out validation data 上计算 loss。validation loss 估计模型对相似但未参与更新的数据的预测质量；它不是事实正确率、agent 成功率或安全性分数。checkpoint 保存权重和 optimizer state，使训练可恢复或比较。最终 base model 仍通常需要 sft 和 preference/alignment 阶段，才能更稳定地把“继续文本”塑造成“遵循请求”。 为什么这种目标能学出复杂能力？因为在多种文本中准确预测下一个 token，常常需要追踪实体、句法、代码状态、世界关联与长距离依赖。目标不显式命名这些结构，却奖励能降低预测误差的内部表示。这个解释支持“能力可由预测学习”，但不证明模型形成了人类相同的概念，也不保证它在 distribution shift 下继续可靠。 1. construct inputs and labels documents are converted to token ids, boundary tokens are inserted, and the stream is packed into fixed- or variable-length sequences. training code commonly shifts a sequence by one position: input x₁...xₙ₋₁ predicts labels x₂...xₙ . a loss mask excludes padding, selected document boundaries, or regions that should not contribute supervision. instruction tuning may compute loss only over assistant completions; that changes which positions are supervised, not the underlying next-token cross-entropy. 2. run one parallel forward pass the causal mask prevents position t from reading beyond x≤t , while hidden states for all positions can still be computed in parallel. the unembedding produces vocabulary logits at every position. softmax normalizes them into conditional distributions pθ(xₜ|x t) . training does not need to sample at each position. it directly reads the probability assigned to the ground-truth target token. 3. aggregate loss and backpropagate negative log-probabilities are averaged over unmasked positions and the batch. automatic differentiation propagates gradients through the unembedding, transformer blocks, and embeddings. an optimizer such as adamw updates parameters using the current gradient and running moment estimates. one example does not write one fact into one designated neuron. it applies small, context-dependent pressure across many parameters, interacting—constructively or destructively—with gradients from other examples. tokens = tokenizer(documents) inputs = tokens[:, :-1] labels = tokens[:, 1:] logits = model(inputs, causal_mask=true) loss = cross_entropy(logits, labels, loss_mask) loss.backward() optimizer.step() 4. repeat, validate, and checkpoint training repeats over many batches and periodically computes loss on held-out validation data. validation loss estimates predictive quality on similar data not used for parameter updates; it is not factual accuracy, agent task success, or a safety score. checkpoints preserve model weights and optimizer state for recovery and comparison. a resulting base model typically still needs supervised instruction tuning and preference or alignment stages to make “continue the text” behave more consistently like “follow the request.” why can this objective teach complex capabilities? across varied text, predicting the next token often requires tracking entities, syntax, program state, world associations, and long-range dependencies. the objective never names those structures; it rewards any internal representation that reduces prediction error. this supports the claim that useful capabilities can be learned through prediction. it does not prove that the model forms human-identical concepts, nor that the learned representations remain reliable under distribution shift. 必要数学：似然、交叉熵与误差复合 essential math: likelihood, cross-entropy, and compounded error 序列概率的因式分解 p θ (x₁,...,x t ) = ∏ t=1 t p θ (x t | x t) xₜ 是第 t 个 token， x t 是此前的真实 prefix， θ 是全部模型参数。chain rule 把整段序列的概率拆成每个位置的条件概率；这不是模型独有假设，而是联合概率的恒等分解。causal transformer 为每一项提供参数化估计。 negative log-likelihood / cross-entropy l(θ) = − (1/n) σ i=1 n log p θ (y i | c i ) n 是未 mask 的训练位置数， cᵢ 是真实 prefix， yᵢ 是真实 next token。若模型给目标 token 概率 0.8，损失约 0.223；给 0.01，损失约 4.605。log 把序列概率的乘积变成和，并强烈惩罚对真实 token 极度自信地判错。对 one-hot 目标，这就是 categorical cross-entropy。最小化它等价于在数据上最大化似然。 perplexity 常定义为 exp(l) ，可直觉化为平均不确定性的有效分支数，但只在相同 tokenizer、数据和 loss mask 下可公平比较。perplexity 从 10 降到 8，不意味着 agent 成功率按 20% 提升；少数关键 action token 的错误可能决定整个轨迹。 局部误差如何变成长轨迹风险 p(all k critical choices correct) ≈ ∏ k=1 k (1 − ε k ) εₖ 是第 k 个关键决策在其实际 rollout prefix 下出错的概率。若粗略假设 20 个关键选择独立且每个 98% 正确，全部正确约为 0.98²⁰≈0.668 。真实错误并不独立：早期错误会改变后续 prefix，可能放大或偶尔被 observation 修复。因此公式不是精确预测，而是说明为什么很低的局部 error rate 也不能直接推出高 long-horizon success。 训练 loss 对所有未 mask token 平均，常见语法 token 占据大量权重；agent eval 却可能把一个罕见工具名、单位或授权选择视为 0/1 成败。工程上需要给关键决策单独的 behavioral eval，而不是用总体 loss 或 perplexity 替代。 factorizing sequence probability p θ (x₁,...,x t ) = ∏ t=1 t p θ (x t | x t) xₜ is token t , x t is the preceding ground-truth prefix, and θ denotes all model parameters. the probability chain rule decomposes a sequence probability into conditional probabilities at each position. this is an identity of joint probability, not a special assumption invented for language models. a causal transformer supplies a parameterized estimate of every factor. negative log-likelihood and cross-entropy l(θ) = − (1/n) σ i=1 n log p θ (y i | c i ) n is the number of unmasked training positions, cᵢ is a ground-truth prefix, and yᵢ is its real next token. assigning the target probability 0.8 produces loss about 0.223; assigning 0.01 produces about 4.605. the logarithm converts the product over sequence probabilities into a sum and strongly penalizes confidently assigning tiny probability to an observed token. with a one-hot categorical target, this is categorical cross-entropy. minimizing it is equivalent to maximum-likelihood estimation on the dataset. perplexity is commonly exp(l) . it can be viewed loosely as an effective branching factor for average uncertainty, but comparisons are meaningful only with the same tokenizer, evaluation data, and loss mask. a perplexity decrease from 10 to 8 does not imply a 20 percent increase in agent success. a few critical action-token errors can determine the whole trajectory. how local error becomes trajectory risk p(all k critical choices correct) ≈ ∏ k=1 k (1 − ε k ) εₖ is the error probability of critical decision k under the prefix actually encountered during rollout. under the deliberately crude assumption that twenty critical choices are independent and each is 98 percent accurate, all are correct only about 0.98²⁰ ≈ 0.668 of the time. real errors
